attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand is approved for Real-Time Bidding (RTB) and programmatic media buying via Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs) such as The Trade Desk. Brands may be excluded due to regulatory restrictions, brand safety policies, or client preference.
attributes.references: IAB RTB Standards; TAG Certified Against Fraud; The Trade Desk - Advertiser Eligibility

attributes.name: regulatory_restrictions
attributes.description: Free-text description of any regulatory or legal advertising restrictions applicable to the brand (e.g., alcohol advertising watershed rules, pharmaceutical fair balance requirements, gambling advertising restrictions). Informs creative compliance review and media placement approvals.
attributes.references: ASA Advertising Standards; FTC Advertising Practices Division; EASA Cross-Border Standards; ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code

attributes.name: safety_level
attributes.description: The brand safety classification tier governing content adjacency restrictions for programmatic and digital media buying. Determines keyword blocklists, content category exclusions, and inventory quality thresholds applied in The Trade Desk and Google Campaign Manager 360.
attributes.references: TAG Brand Safety Standards; IAB Brand Safety Guidelines; GARM Brand Safety Floor

attributes.name: sov_target_pct
attributes.description: The client-agreed target Share of Voice (SOV) percentage for this brand within its competitive category. Used as a KPI benchmark for media planning, campaign performance evaluation, and Nielsen Ad Intel competitive monitoring.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel - SOV Measurement; MRC Audience Measurement Standards; ANA Media Accountability Standards

attributes.name: sub_category
attributes.description: Secondary classification within the brand category providing finer segmentation (e.g., within Personal Care: Skin Care, Hair Care, Deodorants). Supports audience insights, competitive benchmarking via Nielsen Ad Intel, and media planning.
attributes.references: IAB Content Taxonomy 3.0; Nielsen Ad Intel - Sub-Category Classification

attributes.name: tagline
attributes.description: The official marketing tagline or slogan associated with the brand (e.g., 'Just Do It', 'Real Beauty'). Stored as a reference for creative consistency checks and brand compliance reviews.
attributes.references: ASA Advertising Standards; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: target_demographic
attributes.description: Textual description of the brand's primary target audience demographic (e.g., 'Adults 25-54, HHI $75K+, Urban'). Informs audience targeting strategies in The Trade Desk, Nielsen audience measurement, and Comscore cross-platform analytics.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel - Audience Segmentation; Comscore Audience Measurement; MRC Audience Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the brand record was last modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for incremental ETL processing, change data capture, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: website_url
attributes.description: The official public-facing website URL for the brand. Used for digital campaign trafficking, click-through destination validation in Google Campaign Manager 360, and SEO/SEM performance tracking.
attributes.references: IAB VAST/VPAID Standards; Google Campaign Manager 360 - Landing Page Validation

products.name: client_contact
products.description: Individual person associated with an advertiser or agency-managed account — including marketing directors, brand managers, procurement leads, legal contacts, and finance approvers. Captures full name, job title, department, seniority level, email, phone, preferred communication channel, LinkedIn profile, GDPR/CCPA consent status, and opt-out flags. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Contact object. SSOT for all client-side human contacts.

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client contact record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the client_contact data product. Role: MASTER_PARTY.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.advertiser. Business justification: Client contacts are individuals associated with advertiser organizations. Every contact must belong to an advertiser (the client organization they represent). This is a critical missing relationship -

attributes.name: account_role
attributes.description: The contact's strategic role in the client account relationship as classified by the account management team. Used for stakeholder mapping, Account-Based Marketing (ABM) targeting, and relationship health scoring.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Role Object; ANA Account Management Standards; 4As Client Services Standards

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_flag
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has exercised their CCPA right to opt out of the sale or sharing of their personal information. True = opted out. Mandatory for contacts in California. Drives data sharing suppression.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.120; CPRA Amendment; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the contact is primarily based or where their office is located. Used for regional segmentation, event invitations, and on-site meeting logistics.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: contact_source
attributes.description: The originating channel or method through which this contact was first acquired or entered into the CRM system. Used for relationship provenance tracking and business development analytics.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; ANA Data Standards

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the contact record. Indicates whether the contact is actively engaged, temporarily unavailable, or has left the client organisation. Drives CRM hygiene and suppression logic.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: contact_type
attributes.description: Functional classification of the contact's role in the client relationship (e.g., primary day-to-day contact, billing approver, legal signatory, technical integration contact). Drives workflow routing for insertion orders, statements of work, and campaign approvals.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; IAB Insertion Order Standards

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the contact is primarily based. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination (GDPR, CCPA), tax treatment, and regional account assignment.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3 (Territorial Scope); CCPA

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this client contact record was first created in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED marker for data lineage, compliance audit trails, and SLA tracking.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) (Accountability); IAB Data Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: crm_contact_code
attributes.description: Source system identifier for this contact record in Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud / Service Cloud). Used for lineage tracing and cross-system reconciliation with the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; IAB Data Standards

attributes.name: data_subject_request_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether an active data subject request (e.g., right of access, right to erasure, right to rectification) has been submitted by or on behalf of this contact. True = active DSR in progress. Triggers data handling restrictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 15–22; CCPA Section 1798.100; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: departed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact left their role at the client organisation or was otherwise deactivated. Null for active contacts. Used to manage record lifecycle, suppress communications, and trigger successor identification workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Business department or functional unit the contact belongs to within their organisation (e.g., Marketing, Procurement, Legal, Finance). Used to segment contacts for targeted communications and account planning.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; ANA Account Management Standards

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the contact. Used for campaign briefings, insertion order delivery, reporting distribution, and all formal client communications. SSOT sourced from Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given (first) name of the client-side contact individual as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Used for personalised communications, salutations, and account team relationship management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: full_name
attributes.description: Full display name of the contact (typically first_name + last_name) as stored in Salesforce CRM. Used as the canonical human-readable label for the contact across reporting, dashboards, and client-facing documents.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Date
attributes.description: Date on which the contact granted or last updated their GDPR consent. Required for audit and compliance demonstration under GDPR Article 7(1). Null if consent has not been collected or is not applicable.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; GDPR Recital 42; IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF)

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Status
attributes.description: Current GDPR consent status for processing this contact's personal data for marketing and communications purposes. Mandatory for contacts in EU/EEA jurisdictions. Drives suppression and opt-in logic.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; EASA Guidelines; IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF)

attributes.name: is_billing_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is authorised to receive and approve invoices, purchase orders, and financial reconciliation documents. True = billing contact. Used by finance teams for invoice routing and payment approval workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Mediaocean Prisma Billing

attributes.name: is_legal_signatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact has authority to sign contracts, statements of work (SOW), insertion orders (IO), and other legally binding documents on behalf of the client organisation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; IAB Insertion Order Standards; 4As Contract Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this contact is the designated primary point of contact for the client account. True = primary contact. Only one contact per account should hold this designation at any time. Drives default routing for briefs and reports.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title of the contact at their organisation (e.g., Marketing Director, Brand Manager, Procurement Lead, Finance Approver). Drives routing logic for proposals, insertion orders, and campaign approvals.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 country subtag) representing the contact's preferred language for communications and documents (e.g., en-US, fr-FR, de-DE). Drives localisation of reports and correspondence.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ISO 3166-1; GDPR Article 12 (Transparent Communication); Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: last_interaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent recorded interaction (call, email, meeting, or campaign review) between the agency and this contact. Used to identify at-risk relationships and trigger re-engagement workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Object; 4As Client Services Standards

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family (last) name of the client-side contact individual as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Combined with first_name to form the full display name for reporting and correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: linkedin_profile_url
attributes.description: URL of the contact's LinkedIn professional profile. Used by account management and business development teams for relationship intelligence, stakeholder mapping, and pre-meeting research.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: marketing_opt_out_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contact has opted out of receiving marketing and promotional communications from the agency. True = opted out. Applies globally across all channels and overrides channel-specific preferences.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 21; CAN-SPAM Act; CASL; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile phone number for the contact in E.164 international format. Supports SMS-based communications, two-factor authentication for portal access, and urgent out-of-hours escalations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers to record qualitative relationship context, communication preferences, personal interests, or other relevant notes about the contact. Supports personalised relationship management.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: Most recently recorded Net Promoter Score (NPS) provided by this contact in a client satisfaction survey. Integer value from 0 to 10. Used to measure relationship health and identify promoters, passives, and detractors.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); ANA Client Satisfaction Standards; 4As QBR Standards

attributes.name: nps_survey_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent NPS survey response was collected from this contact. Used to determine the currency of the NPS score and schedule the next survey cycle.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); ANA Client Satisfaction Standards

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the contact in E.164 international format. Used for urgent campaign escalations, account management calls, and QBR scheduling.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The contact's stated preferred channel for receiving communications from the agency. Drives outreach strategy for account managers and ensures client satisfaction by respecting communication preferences.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 7 (Consent); 4As Client Services Standards

attributes.name: relationship_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the agency's relationship with this contact was formally established or the contact was first recorded in the CRM. Used for relationship tenure analysis and loyalty recognition in QBRs.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: secondary_email
attributes.description: Alternate or personal business email address for the contact. Used as a fallback communication channel when the primary email is undeliverable or the contact is out of office.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: seniority_level
attributes.description: Seniority classification of the contact within their organisation's hierarchy. Informs escalation paths, approval authority, and relationship investment strategy for account management teams.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: timezone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the contact's primary working location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used to schedule calls, QBRs, and campaign review meetings at appropriate local times.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this client contact record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Used for change detection, incremental ETL processing, and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(2) (Accountability); IAB Data Standards; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

products.name: account_team
products.description: Maps agency-side personnel (account directors, strategists, planners, media buyers, creatives) to specific advertiser accounts. Captures assigned team member reference, role on account (Account Director, Strategic Planner, Media Lead, Creative Director), assignment start and end dates, FTE allocation percentage, primary contact flag, backup coverage, and team status. Enables resource planning, utilization tracking, conflict-of-interest checks, QBR preparation, and client-facing org chart generation.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Account Team / Workfront Resource Assignment

attributes.name: account_team_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each account team assignment record in the advertising agency. Serves as the primary key for this entity.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; 4As Agency Operations Guidelines

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser or agency-managed client account to which this team member is assigned. Anchors the assignment within the client domain hierarchy.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud Account Object; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Account team members are assigned to cost centers for overhead allocation, utilization tracking, and P&L reporting. Essential for agency financial management to track labor costs by client account and

attributes.name: managed_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Account team members often have vendor relationship management responsibilities—e.g., media buyer assigned to manage Google/Meta relationships for specific clients. Tracks vendor stewardship assignmen

attributes.name: primary_account_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency-side personnel record (account director, strategist, planner, media buyer, creative) assigned to this account. Links to the talent domain employee master.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; 4As Agency Staffing Standards

attributes.name: tertiary_account_approved_by_employee_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency employee (typically a Managing Director or Group Account Director) who approved this team assignment. Supports governance, audit trails, and staffing approval workflows.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Governance Standards; Workday HCM Talent Management; Workfront Approval Workflows

attributes.name: account_access_level
attributes.description: The level of access this team member has to the client account record in Salesforce CRM (read, edit, or all). Mirrors the Salesforce AccountTeamMember AccountAccessLevel field and governs data visibility for compliance and conflict-of-interest checks.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud AccountTeamMember Object; GDPR Article 25 Data Protection by Design; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which this account team assignment was formally approved by the designated approver. Used for governance audit trails and staffing compliance reporting.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Governance Standards; Workday HCM; Workfront Approval Workflows

attributes.name: assignment_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this account team assignment, used in Workfront project management and Salesforce CRM for cross-system reference and QBR (Quarterly Business Review) reporting.
attributes.references: Workfront Project Management; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: assignment_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing additional context about the team member's assignment, such as special responsibilities, client preferences, transition notes, or coverage arrangements. Supports account management continuity.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Standards; Workfront Project Management

attributes.name: assignment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the team member's assignment to the account. 'active' indicates currently serving; 'on_leave' indicates temporary absence with backup coverage; 'transitioning' indicates handover in progress; 'inactive' indicates assignment ended; 'pending' indicates assignment approved but not yet started.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; Workday HCM Talent Management; Workfront Resource Planning

attributes.name: assignment_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the team member's assignment to the account: 'dedicated' = exclusively assigned; 'shared' = split across multiple accounts; 'project_based' = assigned for a specific campaign or project; 'interim' = temporary coverage assignment.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Staffing Standards; Workfront Resource Planning; ANA Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: billing_rate_type
attributes.description: Specifies the time unit basis for the billing rate applied to this team member's account assignment (hourly, daily, monthly, or fixed fee). Determines how FTE allocation and time tracking translate to client invoicing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Mediaocean Prisma Billing; 4As Agency Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: billing_rate_usd
attributes.description: The hourly or daily billing rate in USD applied to this team member's time on the client account, as defined in the Statement of Work (SOW) or Master Service Agreement. Used for financial reconciliation and P&L reporting in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Financial Accounting; Mediaocean Prisma Billing; 4As Agency Compensation Guidelines; ANA Agency Financial Management Standards

attributes.name: client_facing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this team member has direct client-facing responsibilities and appears on the client-facing org chart. True = client-facing; False = internal/support role only. Governs inclusion in client communications and org chart generation.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Standards; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud AccountTeamMember Object

attributes.name: conflict_of_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a potential conflict of interest has been identified for this team member's assignment to the account (e.g., simultaneous assignment to a competing advertiser). True = conflict identified; False = no conflict. Triggers compliance review workflow.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Ethics Guidelines; ANA Agency Relationship Standards; FTC Advertising Practices Division; TAG Trustworthy Accountability Group

attributes.name: conflict_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the most recent conflict-of-interest review was conducted for this team member's account assignment. Supports compliance audit trails and periodic review scheduling.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Ethics Guidelines; ANA Agency Relationship Standards; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: conflict_review_outcome
attributes.description: The outcome of the most recent conflict-of-interest review for this assignment. 'cleared' = no conflict found; 'waived' = conflict acknowledged and waived by client; 'escalated' = referred to senior management; 'pending' = review in progress.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Ethics Guidelines; ANA Agency Relationship Standards; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this account team assignment record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; IAB Data Standards; 4As Data Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agency personnel member's assignment to this client account is scheduled to end or actually ended. Null for open-ended assignments. Used for resource planning and transition management.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Staffing Standards; Workday HCM Time Tracking; Workfront Resource Planning

attributes.name: fte_allocation_pct
attributes.description: The percentage of the team member's full-time equivalent (FTE) capacity allocated to this specific client account, expressed as a decimal percentage (e.g., 50.00 = 50%). Supports resource utilization tracking, capacity planning, and P&L cost allocation.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Resource Management Standards; Workday HCM FTE Tracking; SAP S/4HANA PS Project Staffing

attributes.name: is_backup_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this team member serves as the backup coverage contact for the client account when the primary contact is unavailable. True = designated backup; False = not a backup. Supports continuity planning and leave coverage.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; Workfront Resource Planning

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this team member is the designated primary point of contact for the client account. True = primary contact; False = supporting team member. Used for client-facing org chart generation and escalation routing.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud Contact Roles; 4As Account Management Standards; ANA Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date of the most recent formal review of this team member's account assignment, typically conducted during QBR cycles or annual staffing reviews. Supports proactive account management and client satisfaction monitoring.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Standards; ANA QBR Best Practices

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal review of this team member's account assignment. Enables proactive scheduling of staffing reviews and QBR preparation cycles.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Standards; ANA QBR Best Practices

attributes.name: org_chart_display_order
attributes.description: Numeric sequence controlling the display order of this team member within the client-facing org chart for the account. Lower values appear first. Enables structured presentation of the account team hierarchy to clients.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Standards; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud

attributes.name: planned_hours_per_month
attributes.description: The planned number of hours per month this team member is expected to dedicate to this client account, as agreed in the Statement of Work (SOW) or resource plan. Used for utilization tracking and capacity planning in Workfront.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Planning; SAP S/4HANA PS Project Staffing; 4As Agency Resource Management Standards

attributes.name: qbr_presenter_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this team member is designated to present at the client's Quarterly Business Review (QBR). True = QBR presenter; False = not a QBR presenter. Used for QBR preparation and client-facing agenda planning.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Standards; ANA QBR Best Practices; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: The functional role this agency personnel member holds on the client account (e.g., Account Director, Strategic Planner, Media Lead, Creative Director, Account Manager, Media Buyer). Drives org chart generation and responsibility mapping. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Account Director|Strategic Planner|Media Lead|Creative Director|Account Manager|Media Buyer|Digital Strategist|Data Analyst|PR Lead|Brand Strategist — promote to reference product]
attributes.value_regex: Account Director|Strategic Planner|Media Lead|Creative Director|Account Manager|Media Buyer
attributes.references: 4As Agency Role Taxonomy; ANA Agency Relationship Standards; Workfront Resource Planning

attributes.name: salesforce_team_member_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the corresponding AccountTeamMember record in Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud. Supports CRM synchronization, client relationship management, and QBR preparation workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud AccountTeamMember Object; 4As CRM Standards

attributes.name: seniority_level
attributes.description: The seniority classification of the team member within their assigned role on this account (e.g., junior, mid, senior, lead, executive). Used for billing rate determination, resource planning, and QBR staffing reviews.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Staffing Standards; Workday HCM Talent Management; ANA Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agency personnel member formally began their assignment to this client account. Used for tenure tracking, utilization reporting, and conflict-of-interest checks.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Staffing Standards; Workday HCM Time Tracking; Workfront Project Management

attributes.name: team_function
attributes.description: The agency functional discipline this team member represents on the account (account management, media, creative, strategy, analytics, or PR). Enables cross-functional team composition reporting and resource planning by discipline.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Discipline Taxonomy; ANA Agency Relationship Standards; IAB Agency Structure Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this account team assignment record was most recently modified, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports change tracking, data lineage, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 Data Integrity; IAB Data Standards; 4As Data Governance Guidelines

products.name: address
products.description: Physical and mailing addresses associated with advertiser accounts and contacts — including registered office, billing address, shipping address, and regional office locations. Captures address type, street lines, city, state/province, postal code, country (ISO 3166), geocoordinates, address validation status, and effective dates. Supports invoice delivery, legal correspondence, and geo-based audience targeting alignment.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Address / SAP S/4HANA Business Partner Address

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client address record in the advertising agency's client management system. Primary key for the client_address data product.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser or agency client account to which this address belongs. Links the address record to the parent client entity in the client domain.

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual contact person associated with this address, when the address belongs to a specific contact rather than the account-level entity. Nullable for account-level addresses.

attributes.name: address_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the address record. Active addresses are used for current correspondence and billing; unverified addresses have not yet passed validation; invalid addresses failed validation checks; archived addresses are retained for historical reference only.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Address Validation; SAP S/4HANA FI Business Partner

attributes.name: address_type
attributes.description: Classification of the address by its business purpose. Billing addresses are used for invoice delivery and financial correspondence; registered_office is the legal domicile; regional_office supports geo-based audience targeting alignment; mailing is for general correspondence. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: billing|shipping|registered_office|regional_office|mailing|legal — promote to reference product if additional types are needed]
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Business Partner Address; IAB Address Standards

attributes.name: attention_line
attributes.description: Specific person, department, or role name to whom correspondence at this address should be directed (e.g., 'Attn: Accounts Payable', 'Attn: Marketing Director'). Used for invoice delivery and legal correspondence routing within large advertiser organizations.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality name of the address. Used for geo-based audience targeting alignment, regional media planning, and Out-of-Home (OOH) and Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) campaign geo-targeting.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the address (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Determines applicable regulatory frameworks (GDPR for EU countries, CCPA for USA), currency for billing, and international media planning jurisdiction.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR; CCPA; EASA; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this address record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail requirements, data lineage tracking, and compliance with GDPR Article 5 accountability obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); ISO 8601; 4As Data Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: crm_address_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this address record in the Salesforce CRM system (Sales Cloud or Service Cloud). Enables cross-system reconciliation between the lakehouse Silver layer and the operational CRM system of record for client address data.

attributes.name: data_source
attributes.description: Identifies the originating system or method through which this address record was captured. Supports data lineage tracking, ETL (Extract Transform Load) audit trails, and data quality governance across the advertising agency's operational systems of record.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; 4As Data Governance Guidelines

attributes.name: deliverability_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) representing the confidence level that mail or deliveries sent to this address will be successfully received. Derived from postal validation services. Supports data quality governance and prioritization of address re-validation efforts.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; IAB Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: dma_code
attributes.description: Nielsen Designated Market Area (DMA) code associated with the address geography. Used for television and radio media planning, Gross Rating Point (GRP) and Target Rating Point (TRP) calculations, and audience measurement alignment with Nielsen Ad Intel reporting.
attributes.references: Nielsen DMA Codes; MRC Audience Measurement Standards; IAB

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: Date from which this address record is considered valid and active for business use. Supports bi-temporal data management, enabling accurate historical reporting of client address data for audit, legal correspondence, and campaign geo-targeting alignment.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Partner Validity; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: Date after which this address record is no longer valid for active business use. Nullable for currently active addresses. Supports address history management, enabling accurate point-in-time queries for invoice delivery, legal correspondence, and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Partner Validity; GDPR Article 5; ISO 8601

attributes.name: erp_address_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this address record in SAP S/4HANA (FI module - Business Partner). Used for financial reconciliation, invoice routing, and cross-system data lineage between the lakehouse and the ERP system of record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Business Partner (BP) Address

attributes.name: format_type
attributes.description: Indicates the structural format of the address for correct postal formatting and routing. Domestic addresses follow national postal standards; international addresses follow UPU standards; military addresses use APO/FPO/DPO formats; po_box addresses use PO Box routing.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42

attributes.name: gdpr_lawful_basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under GDPR Article 6 for processing this address data. Required for EU/EEA client addresses to demonstrate compliance with GDPR data processing requirements. Applicable when country_code corresponds to an EU/EEA member state.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; EASA; European Advertising Standards Alliance

attributes.name: geocoding_accuracy
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoordinates assigned to this address. Rooftop indicates exact building-level precision; range_interpolated is street-level; geometric_center is centroid of a region; approximate is low-precision. Informs the reliability of geo-based audience targeting and OOH/DOOH proximity analysis.
attributes.references: Google Maps Geocoding API Standards; IAB Location Data Standards

attributes.name: is_billing_default
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address is the default destination for invoice and billing document delivery. Used by Mediaocean Prisma and SAP S/4HANA FI to route financial documents including Insertion Orders (IOs) and billing statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Accounts Receivable; Mediaocean Prisma Billing

attributes.name: is_do_not_mail
attributes.description: Indicates whether this address has been flagged to suppress physical mail correspondence, in compliance with client preferences or regulatory opt-out requirements. Supports compliance with direct mail suppression lists and client communication preferences.
attributes.references: FTC CAN-SPAM Act; GDPR Article 21 (Right to Object); CCPA; DMA (Data & Marketing Association) Guidelines

attributes.name: is_primary
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is the primary address for the client or contact. Only one address per client per address_type should be flagged as primary. Used to determine the default address for invoice delivery and legal correspondence.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Account Object; SAP S/4HANA FI Business Partner

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: Geographic latitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum), ranging from -90 to +90. Enables geo-based audience targeting alignment, proximity analysis for Out-of-Home (OOH) and Digital Out-of-Home (DOOH) media planning, and regional campaign delivery optimization.
attributes.references: ISO 6709; WGS 84; IAB Location Data Standards

attributes.name: line_1
attributes.description: Primary street address line including building number, street name, and suite or unit number. Used for invoice delivery, legal correspondence, and geo-based audience targeting alignment in campaign planning.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: line_2
attributes.description: Secondary address line for additional location details such as floor number, building name, department, or attention line. Supplements address_line_1 for complete physical location identification.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42

attributes.name: line_3
attributes.description: Tertiary address line used for international addresses requiring additional locality or district information, or for extended address details not captured in lines 1 and 2.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: Geographic longitude coordinate of the address in decimal degrees (WGS 84 datum), ranging from -180 to +180. Used in conjunction with latitude for geo-based audience targeting, Designated Market Area (DMA) mapping, and programmatic campaign geo-fencing via Demand-Side Platforms (DSPs).
attributes.references: ISO 6709; WGS 84; IAB Location Data Standards

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context or instructions related to this address, such as delivery access instructions, seasonal address changes, or account management notes relevant to correspondence routing.

attributes.name: po_box
attributes.description: Post Office Box number for clients who receive mail via PO Box rather than a physical street address. Used for mailing and billing correspondence when a physical address is not applicable or preferred by the client.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code of the address. Used for invoice routing, direct mail campaign targeting, geo-based audience segmentation, and Designated Market Area (DMA) alignment in media planning.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; Universal Postal Union (UPU) S42

attributes.name: state_province
attributes.description: State, province, or administrative region of the address using ISO 3166-2 subdivision codes (e.g., US-CA, GB-ENG). Supports regional media buying, regulatory compliance (CCPA for California), and geo-targeted campaign delivery.

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the address location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used for scheduling campaign flights, coordinating media buys across time zones, and ensuring accurate campaign delivery timing for programmatic and broadcast media.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; IAB Ad Scheduling Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this address record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change data capture (CDC), ETL incremental loads, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); ISO 8601; SAP S/4HANA Change Log

attributes.name: validation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the address was last validated against postal authority databases. Used to determine whether re-validation is required based on data freshness policies and to support audit trails for compliance with GDPR and CCPA data accuracy requirements.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; GDPR Article 5 (Accuracy); CCPA

attributes.name: validation_source
attributes.description: Name of the address validation service or system used to verify the address (e.g., USPS CASS, SmartyStreets, Loqate, Google Maps API). Supports audit trails and data quality governance for address accuracy.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; IAB Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: validation_status
attributes.description: Result of the most recent address validation check against postal authority databases. Validated addresses have been confirmed as deliverable; failed addresses contain errors; pending addresses are queued for validation. Supports data quality management for invoice delivery and legal correspondence.
attributes.references: USPS CASS Certification; Universal Postal Union (UPU); IAB Data Quality Standards

products.name: agency_relationship
products.description: Captures the formal relationship between the agency and an advertiser, including relationship type (AOR — Agency of Record, project-based, retainer, roster agency), relationship status, scope of services (media, creative, PR, digital, social), start and end dates, exclusivity flags, governing contract reference, and full relationship state-change history stored as effective-dated event records (AOR wins/losses, scope expansions, renewals, escalations, status transitions with effective dates, triggering events, previous state, new state, and narrative notes). This is the SSOT for both current relationship state and historical relationship lifecycle — no separate history table exists. Supports AOR tracking, pitch history, competitive conflict management, audit trail, and executive relationship lifecycle reporting.

attributes.name: agency_relationship_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the agency-advertiser relationship record. Primary key for this entity. Role classification: MASTER_AGREEMENT — represents a long-running formal binding relationship between the agency and an advertiser.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; 4As Agency Management Best Practices

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser or client organisation that is party to this agency relationship. Links to the client master record in the client domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Object; IAB Data Standards

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing contract or Statement of Work (SOW) that formalises the terms of this agency relationship. Links to the contract master record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Contract Management; ANA Agency Contract Guidelines

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.segment. Business justification: Agency contracts often specify which audience segments the agency is authorized to target or access (e.g., first-party data segments, geographic restrictions). Contractual and data governance requirem

attributes.name: primary_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Agency relationships often designate primary media suppliers or tech platforms used for that client account. Tracks which DSPs, SSPs, or publishers are approved/preferred under specific agency-client

attributes.name: annual_fee_amount
attributes.description: The contracted annual agency fee or retainer amount in the agreed currency for this relationship. Used for P&L reporting, budget management, and financial reconciliation. Applicable for retainer and project-fee structures.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — FI/CO Module; ANA Agency Fee Transparency Standards; 4As Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: aor_designation
attributes.description: Specifies the specific Agency of Record (AOR) designation held by the agency for this client, if applicable. Distinguishes between full-service AOR and discipline-specific AOR designations (media, creative, digital, PR, social). Used for AOR tracking and executive relationship reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: full_service_aor|media_aor|creative_aor|digital_aor|pr_aor|social_aor|none — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 4As Agency of Record (AOR) Classification; ANA AOR Management Guidelines

attributes.name: brand_scope
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of the client's brand names or brand portfolio segments covered under this agency relationship. Distinguishes relationships that cover the full client portfolio from those scoped to specific brands or sub-brands.
attributes.references: 4As Scope of Services Framework; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: client_contact_email
attributes.description: The business email address of the primary client contact for this relationship. Used for direct communication, meeting scheduling, and CRM record maintenance. Subject to GDPR and CCPA data protection requirements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Object; GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: commission_rate_pct
attributes.description: The agreed agency commission rate expressed as a percentage of gross media spend, applicable when the fee structure type is commission_based or hybrid. Used for financial reconciliation in Mediaocean Prisma and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Compensation Guidelines; ANA Media Transparency Report; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: competitive_conflict_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this agency-client relationship involves a known competitive conflict with another client in the agency's portfolio (i.e., the agency serves two competing advertisers in the same category). Critical for conflict management and new business governance.
attributes.references: 4As Conflict of Interest Guidelines; ANA Agency Conflict Management Standards

attributes.name: conflict_category
attributes.description: The product or industry category in which a competitive conflict exists, if the competitive conflict flag is true (e.g., 'Automotive', 'Financial Services', 'FMCG — Beverages'). Used for conflict management reporting and new business screening.
attributes.references: 4As Conflict of Interest Guidelines; IAB Content Taxonomy

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this agency relationship record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; FTC Record Keeping Requirements; IAB Data Standards

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_code
attributes.description: The external identifier of the corresponding Salesforce CRM Opportunity record that originated or tracks this agency-client relationship. Enables bi-directional traceability between the data lakehouse and the CRM system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Opportunity Object; Salesforce Sales Cloud

attributes.name: current_event_type
attributes.description: The type of the most recent state-change event recorded against this relationship. Supports AOR win/loss tracking, scope change management, and executive relationship lifecycle reporting. Full event history is stored as effective-dated event records within this product. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: aor_win|aor_loss|scope_expansion|scope_reduction|renewal|escalation|status_transition|termination|suspension|reinstatement|pitch_initiated — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 4As Relationship Lifecycle Standards; ANA Agency Management Guidelines

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agency-client relationship is scheduled to end or was terminated. Nullable for open-ended relationships. Used for AOR tracking, renewal management, and competitive conflict management. Serves as EFFECTIVE_UNTIL for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA — Contract Validity End

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agency-client relationship formally commenced and became binding. Used for AOR tracking, tenure calculations, and relationship lifecycle reporting. Serves as EFFECTIVE_FROM for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; SAP S/4HANA — Contract Validity Start

attributes.name: estimated_annual_billings
attributes.description: The estimated total annual media billings or revenue associated with this agency-client relationship, in the fee currency. Used for revenue forecasting, P&L reporting, and strategic account prioritisation. Distinct from the contracted annual fee amount.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Financial Reporting Standards; SAP S/4HANA — CO/FI Module; ANA Agency Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: event_effective_date
attributes.description: The business-effective date of the most recent state-change event (e.g., the date an AOR win took effect, the date a scope expansion was agreed). Distinct from the record audit timestamp; used for effective-dated relationship lifecycle reporting.
attributes.references: 4As Relationship Lifecycle Standards; SAP S/4HANA — Effective Dating

attributes.name: event_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative notes providing additional context for the most recent relationship state-change event. Captures qualitative detail such as client rationale, negotiation outcomes, or escalation context. Supports audit trail and executive relationship lifecycle reporting.
attributes.references: 4As Audit Trail Standards; Salesforce CRM — Activity Notes

attributes.name: event_trigger
attributes.description: A brief description of the business event or circumstance that triggered the most recent relationship state change (e.g., 'Client initiated competitive review', 'Scope expanded to include social media', 'Contract renewed for FY2025'). Supports narrative audit trail and executive reporting.
attributes.references: 4As Audit Trail Standards; ANA Agency Management Guidelines

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the annual fee amount and any financial values associated with this relationship (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency financial reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA — FI Module

attributes.name: fee_structure_type
attributes.description: The commercial fee model governing agency compensation under this relationship. Retainer_fee is a fixed recurring payment; commission_based is a percentage of media spend; project_fee is a one-time scoped payment; performance_based ties compensation to KPI outcomes; hybrid combines multiple models.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Compensation Guidelines; ANA Agency Fee Transparency Standards; SAP S/4HANA — CO Module

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic markets or territories covered by this agency-client relationship (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR,DEU,FRA', 'Global'). Uses ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes where applicable. Supports multi-market AOR tracking and competitive conflict management.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IAB Geographic Standards; 4As Global Agency Guidelines

attributes.name: incumbent_agency_name
attributes.description: The name of the previous incumbent agency that held the account prior to this relationship being established, if applicable. Used for competitive intelligence, pitch history analysis, and AOR win/loss reporting.
attributes.references: 4As Competitive Intelligence Standards; Nielsen Ad Intel

attributes.name: is_exclusive
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agency holds an exclusive mandate for the defined scope of services with this advertiser, preventing the client from engaging competing agencies for the same services. Critical for competitive conflict management and AOR governance.
attributes.references: 4As Agency of Record (AOR) Guidelines; ANA Exclusivity Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp at which this agency relationship record was most recently updated. Used for change tracking, data synchronisation with Salesforce CRM, and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity; FTC Record Keeping Requirements; Salesforce CRM — System Modified Date

attributes.name: lead_account_director
attributes.description: The name of the senior agency account director who holds primary responsibility for managing this client relationship. Used for account team assignment, escalation routing, and executive relationship reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Account Team; Workfront — Resource Planning

attributes.name: mediaocean_client_code
attributes.description: The client code assigned to this advertiser in Mediaocean Prisma, the media planning and buying system of record. Used for reconciliation of media plans, insertion orders (IOs), and billing records against this relationship.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma — Client Setup; IAB Insertion Order Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date of the next formal relationship review or Quarterly Business Review (QBR). Used for proactive account management, renewal planning, and executive calendar management.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Performance Review Standards; Salesforce CRM — Activity Management

attributes.name: notice_period_days
attributes.description: The number of calendar days of advance written notice required by either party to terminate or materially modify this agency-client relationship, as specified in the governing contract or Statement of Work (SOW).
attributes.references: ANA Agency Contract Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA — Contract Management

attributes.name: pitch_type
attributes.description: The type of pitch or selection process through which this agency-client relationship was established. Competitive_review is a formal multi-agency pitch; direct_award is a non-competitive appointment; incumbent_retention is a renewal without a formal pitch; rfi_rfp is a formal Request for Information (RFI) or Request for Proposal (RFP) process.
attributes.references: 4As Pitch Process Standards; ANA Agency Search Guidelines

attributes.name: pitch_win_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agency formally won the pitch or competitive review that established this relationship. Used for pitch history tracking, new business reporting, and AOR win/loss analytics.
attributes.references: 4As New Business Reporting Standards; Salesforce CRM — Opportunity Close Date

attributes.name: previous_relationship_status
attributes.description: The relationship status immediately prior to the most recent state-change event. Stored alongside the current status to support audit trail requirements and state-transition reporting without requiring a separate history table.
attributes.references: 4As Audit Trail Standards; FTC Advertising Practices — Record Keeping

attributes.name: primary_client_contact
attributes.description: The name of the primary contact person on the client/advertiser side for this relationship (e.g., CMO, Marketing Director, Brand Manager). Used for account management, communication routing, and CRM record maintenance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Contact Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: relationship_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this agency-client relationship, used in Salesforce CRM, Mediaocean Prisma, and client-facing correspondence (e.g., REL-2024-00123). Serves as the BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Opportunity/Account Relationship; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: relationship_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the agency-client relationship. Active indicates a live, operational engagement; pending indicates a relationship that has been agreed but not yet commenced; suspended indicates a temporary hold; terminated indicates the relationship has ended; under_review indicates a formal review or pitch process is underway. Serves as LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Opportunity Stage; 4As Agency Management Best Practices

attributes.name: relationship_tier
attributes.description: The strategic importance tier assigned to this agency-client relationship based on revenue, strategic value, and growth potential. Strategic denotes top-tier accounts receiving dedicated senior resources; key_account denotes significant accounts; standard denotes routine engagements; emerging denotes new or high-growth potential accounts.
attributes.references: 4As Account Segmentation Framework; ANA Client Tiering Guidelines

attributes.name: relationship_type
attributes.description: Classification of the formal relationship structure between the agency and the advertiser. AOR (Agency of Record) denotes full-service exclusive mandate; project_based is scoped to a single campaign or deliverable; retainer is an ongoing fee-based engagement; roster_agency is a non-exclusive approved supplier; preferred_vendor is a qualified but non-exclusive partner. Serves as CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE for this MASTER_AGREEMENT entity.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Relationship Classification; ANA Agency Roster Management Guidelines

attributes.name: renewal_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agency-client relationship contract is due for renewal or renegotiation. Distinct from the effective end date; used for proactive renewal pipeline management and AOR retention tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA — Contract Management; Salesforce CRM — Renewal Opportunity

attributes.name: review_cycle
attributes.description: The agreed frequency at which the agency-client relationship is formally reviewed, including performance evaluation, scope assessment, and fee renegotiation. Supports Quarterly Business Review (QBR) scheduling and executive relationship lifecycle reporting.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Performance Review Standards; ANA QBR Guidelines

attributes.name: scope_of_services
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of service disciplines covered under this relationship (e.g., media, creative, pr, digital, social, ooh, programmatic, sem, seo). Defines the breadth of the agency mandate and is used for competitive conflict management and scope expansion tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: media|creative|pr|digital|social|ooh|programmatic|sem|seo|analytics|content|influencer — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 4As Scope of Services Framework; ANA Agency Relationship Guidelines; IAB Service Taxonomy

products.name: client_segment
products.description: Classification of advertisers into strategic business segments used for account prioritization, resource allocation, revenue forecasting, and tiered service delivery. Captures segment name (Enterprise, Mid-Market, SMB, Strategic Growth), segmentation criteria and scoring methodology, revenue tier thresholds, industry vertical classification (IAB taxonomy), geographic market, segment owner, review cadence, and segment effective dates. Supports ABM (Account-Based Marketing) strategies, quarterly business reviews, executive portfolio reporting, and new business pitch targeting. Each advertiser is assigned to exactly one primary segment at any point in time.
products.reference: IAB Content Taxonomy / Salesforce Account Segmentation

attributes.name: client_segment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client segment record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Primary key for the client_segment data product.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: abm_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether advertisers in this segment are eligible for Account-Based Marketing (ABM) programs. ABM-eligible segments receive dedicated content personalization, targeted outreach, and bespoke pitch strategies. Drives campaign targeting logic in Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
attributes.references: ANA ABM Framework; Salesforce Marketing Cloud

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) when this segment record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker required for data lineage, GDPR compliance, and Silver Layer data quality monitoring.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; Internal Data Governance Policy; IAB Data Standards

attributes.name: crm_segment_code
attributes.description: External identifier for this segment as recorded in Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud. Enables bidirectional synchronization between the Databricks Silver Layer and the CRM system of record for account assignment and pipeline reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; Internal System Integration Standards

attributes.name: data_privacy_tier
attributes.description: Privacy compliance tier applied to data handling for advertisers in this segment. Standard applies baseline CCPA/GDPR controls; Enhanced applies additional consent management; Strict applies maximum data minimization and opt-in requirements for regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance).
attributes.references: GDPR; CCPA; FTC Advertising Practices Division; NAI Code of Conduct

attributes.name: dedicated_account_team_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether advertisers in this segment require a dedicated account management team (as opposed to a pooled or shared service model). Drives FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) resource planning in Workday HCM and Workfront capacity management.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Best Practices; Workday HCM; Workfront

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this segment definition expires or is superseded. Nullable for open-ended segments. Enables point-in-time segment reconstruction for historical reporting and regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: The date from which this segment definition becomes active and applicable for advertiser classification. Used for temporal validity tracking and historical segment analysis in QBRs and revenue forecasting.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: geographic_market
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the primary geographic market scope of this segment (e.g., USA, GBR, DEU). Used for regional resource allocation, media planning alignment, and compliance with jurisdiction-specific regulations (GDPR, CCPA).
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; GDPR; CCPA; IAB Data Standards

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Broader geographic region grouping for the segment (e.g., North America, EMEA, APAC, LATAM). Supports regional portfolio reporting, executive dashboards, and cross-market resource planning in Workfront and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Internal Regional Taxonomy

attributes.name: iab_industry_vertical_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) Industry Vertical Code
attributes.description: IAB Content Taxonomy category code representing the industry vertical classification of advertisers within this segment (e.g., IAB3 for Business, IAB19 for Technology). Used for competitive analysis, audience targeting alignment, and industry benchmarking via Nielsen Ad Intel and Comscore.
attributes.references: IAB Content Taxonomy v3.0; Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB)

attributes.name: iab_industry_vertical_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) Industry Vertical Name
attributes.description: Human-readable label corresponding to the IAB industry vertical code assigned to this segment (e.g., Automotive, Financial Services, Retail). Supports executive reporting, pitch targeting, and ABM (Account-Based Marketing) strategy alignment.
attributes.references: IAB Content Taxonomy v3.0; Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB)

attributes.name: is_primary_segment
attributes.description: Indicates whether this segment record represents the primary (active) segment assignment for an advertiser at a given point in time. Enforces the business rule that each advertiser is assigned to exactly one primary segment at any point in time. Used in deduplication logic and point-in-time reporting.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; ANA Account Segmentation Framework

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent formal review of this segment's criteria, thresholds, and advertiser assignments was completed. Used to track review compliance and trigger overdue review alerts.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Best Practices; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: min_annual_spend_usd
attributes.description: Minimum annual media and campaign spend (in USD) expected from advertisers assigned to this segment. Used in revenue forecasting, P&L (Profit and Loss) planning, and EBITDA (Earnings Before Interest, Taxes, Depreciation, and Amortization) modeling in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Module; ANA Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this segment definition. Calculated from last_review_date and review_cadence. Used by Workfront project management to schedule QBR preparation tasks and notify segment owners.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Best Practices; Workfront Project Management

attributes.name: owner_email
attributes.description: Corporate email address of the segment owner used for automated review notifications, QBR scheduling, and escalation workflows. Classified as confidential as it identifies an internal employee.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: owner_name
attributes.description: Full name of the internal business owner (typically a Group Account Director or VP of Client Services) responsible for the segment definition, criteria governance, and periodic review. Referenced in Salesforce CRM and Workfront for accountability tracking.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Best Practices; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud

attributes.name: primary_channel_mix
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of primary advertising channels typically utilized by advertisers in this segment (e.g., CTV, DOOH, PPC, OTT, SEM). Informs media planning defaults in Mediaocean Prisma and programmatic buying strategies in The Trade Desk.
attributes.references: IAB Channel Taxonomy; Mediaocean Prisma; The Trade Desk

attributes.name: programmatic_buying_eligible

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_max_usd
attributes.description: Maximum annual advertiser revenue (in USD) for assignment to this segment. Defines the upper bound of the revenue tier. Null for the highest tier (Enterprise) where no upper cap applies. Used in conjunction with revenue_threshold_min_usd for tier boundary enforcement.

attributes.name: revenue_threshold_min_usd

attributes.name: review_cadence

attributes.name: scoring_methodology

attributes.name: scoring_weight_growth_potential

attributes.name: scoring_weight_revenue

attributes.name: scoring_weight_strategic_fit

attributes.references: ANA Account Segmentation Framework; Internal Scoring Model Documentation

attributes.name: segment_code

Serves as the human-readable unique code referenced in Account-Based Marketing (ABM) campaigns and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; IAB Data Standards

attributes.name: segment_description

attributes.name: segment_name

attributes.name: segment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the segment definition. Active segments are in use for account assignment; under_review segments are being evaluated for criteria changes; deprecated segments have been superseded by updated definitions.

attributes.name: segment_tier
attributes.description: Revenue-based tier classification of the advertiser segment used for resource allocation, service level assignment, and account prioritization. Enterprise represents the highest-value accounts; SMB (Small and Medium Business) represents the lowest revenue tier. Strategic Growth identifies high-potential accounts regardless of current revenue.
attributes.references: ANA Account Segmentation Framework; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud Account Tier Field

attributes.name: segment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the segmentation approach used to define this segment. Indicates whether the segment is defined by revenue tier, industry vertical, geographic market, strategic priority, or behavioral attributes. Drives which scoring methodology and criteria apply.

attributes.name: service_tier_level

attributes.name: target_roas_benchmark

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

attributes.name: version_number
