attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising campaign that triggered this NPS survey, applicable for post-campaign survey types. Null for periodic (quarterly/annual) surveys not tied to a specific campaign.
attributes.references: Google Campaign Manager 360; IAB Data Standards

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific client contact (respondent) who submitted this NPS survey response. Links to the contact record in the client domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud) Contact Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.initiative. Business justification: NPS surveys often reference specific project delivery to measure client satisfaction on that work. Critical for project retrospectives, team performance evaluation, and identifying delivery issues tie

attributes.name: primary_nps_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal account manager or client services lead responsible for the client relationship at the time of survey collection. Used for relationship health attribution.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud) User Object; ANA Account Management Standards

attributes.name: survey_wave_id
attributes.description: Reference to the survey wave or batch under which this NPS response was collected (e.g., Q1 2024 Post-Campaign Wave, Annual Relationship Survey). Links to the survey wave definition record.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: anonymized_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the respondent's personal identifiers have been anonymized or pseudonymized in this record (True) in response to a data subject erasure or anonymization request under GDPR/CCPA. When True, contact_id and respondent-identifying fields are nullified.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure); CCPA Section 1798.105; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: at_risk_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NPS response has triggered an at-risk account designation for the associated client (True) or not (False). Set based on score thresholds, trend deterioration, or critical verbatim feedback. Feeds into account health dashboards and retention workflows.
attributes.references: ANA Client Retention Standards; Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud) Account Health Scoring

attributes.name: business_segment
attributes.description: The client business segment classification at the time of survey collection (e.g., enterprise, mid_market, smb, agency, direct). Captured as a snapshot to support segment-level NPS benchmarking and trend analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud) Account Segment; ANA Client Classification Standards

attributes.name: client_tenure_months
attributes.description: The number of months the client has been an active account at the time of survey collection. Captured at survey time to enable cohort analysis of NPS trends by client maturity and relationship longevity.
attributes.references: ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines; Salesforce CRM Account Object

attributes.name: consent_given
attributes.description: Indicates whether the respondent provided explicit consent for their survey response data (including verbatim feedback) to be stored, processed, and used for relationship management and analytics purposes (True = consent given, False = not given or withdrawn). Required for GDPR and CCPA compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing); GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); CCPA Section 1798.100; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this NPS response record was first created in the data platform (Silver Layer ingestion timestamp). Serves as the audit trail creation marker and supports data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Confidentiality)

attributes.name: crm_survey_record_code
attributes.description: The native record identifier from Salesforce CRM (Marketing Cloud or Service Cloud Survey module) for this NPS response. Enables bidirectional traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Marketing Cloud) Survey Object; Salesforce CRM (Service Cloud) Feedback Management

attributes.name: data_processing_basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under GDPR Article 6 for processing the personal data contained in this NPS response (e.g., consent, legitimate_interest, contract, legal_obligation). Required for regulatory compliance documentation and data subject rights management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawfulness of Processing); EASA Privacy Standards; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: follow_up_date
attributes.description: The date on which the follow-up action with the client contact was completed or is scheduled. Used to measure response time to detractor/passive feedback and track SLA compliance for client recovery actions.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Service Cloud) Activity Object; ANA Account Management Standards

attributes.name: follow_up_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes recorded by the account team following the client follow-up conversation. Documents the outcome of the recovery or reinforcement discussion, commitments made, and next steps agreed with the client.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Service Cloud) Activity Notes; ANA Account Management Standards

attributes.name: follow_up_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NPS response requires a follow-up action by the account team (True) or not (False). Typically set to True for detractors and passives with critical verbatim feedback. Drives the follow-up workflow in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: Net Promoter System (Bain & Company / Satmetrix); Salesforce CRM (Service Cloud) Case Management

attributes.name: follow_up_status
attributes.description: Current status of the follow-up action triggered by this NPS response: pending (action required but not started), in_progress (account team engaged), completed (follow-up conversation concluded), not_required (no action needed), escalated (escalated to senior leadership or executive sponsor).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Service Cloud) Case Object; ANA Account Management Standards

attributes.name: improvement_suggestion
attributes.description: Open-text field capturing the respondent's specific suggestions for service or relationship improvement, collected as a secondary open-ended question in the NPS survey. Distinct from verbatim_feedback which explains the score.
attributes.references: ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The client's industry vertical classification at the time of survey (e.g., Automotive, CPG, Financial Services, Retail, Technology, Healthcare). Enables vertical-level NPS benchmarking against industry norms and competitive positioning.
attributes.references: IAB Content Taxonomy; ANA Industry Classification Standards

attributes.name: nps_score
attributes.description: The raw NPS rating provided by the respondent on a 0-10 scale: 0-6 = Detractor, 7-8 = Passive, 9-10 = Promoter. This is the principal quantitative outcome of the survey and the core metric for client satisfaction trending and relationship health scoring.
attributes.references: Net Promoter System (Bain & Company / Satmetrix); ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines; MRC Measurement Standards

attributes.name: qbr_linked_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this NPS response has been formally linked to and presented in a Quarterly Business Review (QBR) session with the client (True) or not (False). Supports QBR preparation workflows and tracks which responses have been actioned in formal client review meetings.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Standards; ANA Client Services Best Practices

attributes.name: relationship_aspect
attributes.description: The specific dimension of the client-agency relationship being rated in the secondary question (e.g., strategic_counsel, creative_quality, responsiveness, reporting, media_execution, overall_value). Enables multi-dimensional satisfaction analysis.
attributes.references: ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: relationship_aspect_rating
attributes.description: Secondary rating (1-5 scale) capturing the respondent's satisfaction with a specific relationship dimension (e.g., strategic counsel, creative quality, responsiveness, reporting transparency) as defined by the survey wave. Complements the primary NPS score with dimensional insight.
attributes.references: ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: reminder_count
attributes.description: The number of reminder communications sent to the respondent before they submitted (or declined) the survey. Used to assess survey fatigue, optimize reminder cadence, and contextualize response quality.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Marketing Cloud) Journey Builder; ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: respondent_category
attributes.description: Classification of the respondent based on their NPS score: promoter (score 9-10), passive (score 7-8), detractor (score 0-6). Derived classification stored for operational use in segmentation, at-risk identification, and follow-up routing without requiring score recalculation.
attributes.references: Net Promoter System (Bain & Company / Satmetrix); ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: respondent_role
attributes.description: The functional role of the survey respondent within the client organization (e.g., decision_maker, day_to_day, executive_sponsor, procurement, finance). Enables role-stratified NPS analysis to identify satisfaction gaps across stakeholder levels.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud) Contact Role; ANA Account Management Standards

attributes.name: response_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the NPS survey response: submitted (complete response received), partial (respondent started but did not complete), declined (respondent explicitly opted out), expired (survey link expired before completion), invalidated (response flagged as invalid for data quality reasons).
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Service Cloud) Survey Object; ANA Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: response_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time (ISO 8601 with timezone offset) at which the respondent submitted the NPS survey response. Used for response latency analysis and audit trail.
attributes.references: ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines; GDPR Article 5 (data accuracy)

attributes.name: survey_channel
attributes.description: The delivery channel through which the NPS survey was administered to the respondent (e.g., email link, web portal, phone interview, in-person QBR, SMS). Supports channel effectiveness analysis.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: survey_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the NPS survey was sent or administered to the respondent. Used as the principal business event date for trend analysis and wave alignment.
attributes.references: ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines; IAB Data Standards

attributes.name: survey_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date after which the survey link or invitation is no longer valid for response submission. Used to manage response windows, flag expired non-responses, and calculate response rate denominators.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Marketing Cloud) Survey Module; ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: survey_invitation_sent_timestamp
attributes.description: The precise date and time the NPS survey invitation was dispatched to the respondent. Used to calculate response latency (time from invitation to submission) and to manage survey expiry windows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Marketing Cloud) Journey Builder; ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: survey_language
attributes.description: The ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 region code) in which the survey was presented and the response was collected (e.g., en, en-US, fr-FR, de-DE). Supports multilingual client portfolio management.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; GDPR Article 12 (communication in clear language)

attributes.name: survey_response_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this NPS response, used in client communications, follow-up tracking, and CRM cross-referencing (e.g., NPS-2024Q1-001234). Distinct from the internal surrogate key.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM (Service Cloud) Survey Object; ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: survey_type
attributes.description: Classification of the NPS survey by its trigger or cadence: post_campaign (collected after campaign completion), quarterly (scheduled quarterly relationship check), annual (annual relationship review), ad_hoc (unscheduled), onboarding (new client), offboarding (departing client). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: post_campaign|quarterly|annual|ad_hoc|onboarding|offboarding — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud Survey Module

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time this NPS response record was last modified in the data platform, including follow-up status updates, anonymization actions, or data corrections. Supports audit trail and change tracking.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Confidentiality)

attributes.name: verbatim_feedback
attributes.description: The open-text qualitative feedback provided by the respondent explaining their NPS score. Captures the 'why' behind the rating and is used for sentiment analysis, theme identification, and account team coaching. May contain client-sensitive commentary.
attributes.references: Net Promoter System (Bain & Company / Satmetrix); GDPR Article 5; ANA Client Satisfaction Measurement Guidelines

products.name: preference
products.description: Stores advertiser-level and contact-level preferences governing how the agency engages with the client — including preferred communication channels, reporting cadence, invoice delivery method, language preference, currency preference, time zone, approval workflow preferences, and data sharing consent flags (GDPR/CCPA). Enables personalized service delivery and compliance with client-specific engagement protocols.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Account Preferences / GDPR Consent Management

attributes.name: preference_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client preference record in the Databricks Silver Layer. Serves as the primary key for the client_preference data product.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser or agency-managed client account for whom these preferences are defined. Links to the master client record in the client domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud — Account Object

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to audience.segment. Business justification: Advertisers specify excluded audience segments in account preferences (e.g., competitor employees, sensitive demographics, brand safety exclusions). Operational requirement for respecting client targe

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific client contact person for whom contact-level preferences are recorded. Nullable when preferences apply at the account level rather than an individual contact.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud — Contact Object

attributes.name: approval_turnaround_days
attributes.description: Number of business days the client requires to review and approve submitted materials (creative, media plans, insertion orders). Used to set SLA expectations and project timelines in Workfront.
attributes.references: Workfront Project Management; 4As Standard Client Service Agreements

attributes.name: approval_workflow_type
attributes.description: Defines the client's required approval workflow structure for creative assets, media plans, and campaign changes. Drives routing logic in Workfront project management and proofing modules.
attributes.references: Workfront Approval Workflow Configuration; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: audience_data_usage_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client permits the agency to use their first-party audience data for targeting, lookalike modelling, or cross-campaign analytics. Governs use of client data in DMP/CDP platforms.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA; IAB Data Transparency Standards; NAI Code of Conduct

attributes.name: brand_safety_tier
attributes.description: Client's required brand safety classification level governing which content categories and environments are permissible for ad placement. 'strict' applies the most restrictive exclusion lists; 'custom' uses a client-defined inclusion/exclusion list. Configured in The Trade Desk and Google Campaign Manager 360.
attributes.references: IAB Brand Safety Standards; TAG Brand Safety Certification; GARM Brand Safety Floor

attributes.name: budget_alert_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of campaign budget consumption at which the agency should proactively alert the client. For example, a value of 80.00 means the client is notified when 80% of the approved budget has been spent.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Management; IAB Ad Campaign Management Standards

attributes.name: competitive_reporting_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client permits the agency to include their campaign data in aggregated competitive intelligence reports (e.g., Share of Voice analysis using Nielsen Ad Intel). Some clients restrict inclusion in benchmarking studies.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel; Comscore; ANA Data Ethics Guidelines

attributes.name: consent_capture_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which the client's data sharing consent (GDPR/CCPA) was formally captured or last updated. Required for regulatory audit trails demonstrating lawful basis for data processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the consent notice or privacy policy under which the client's data sharing consent was obtained. Enables tracking of consent against specific policy versions for GDPR and CCPA compliance audits.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this client preference record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail entry point for the record lifecycle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: creative_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires formal approval of all creative assets before trafficking and delivery. When true, creative assets must pass through the client approval workflow in Workfront before being trafficked in Google Campaign Manager 360.
attributes.references: Workfront DAM; Google Campaign Manager 360 Trafficking; ASA Advertising Standards

attributes.name: crm_record_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier of the corresponding client preference or contact record in Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud or Service Cloud). Enables bidirectional synchronisation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the operational CRM system.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud — Account/Contact Object

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent_ccpa
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Data Sharing Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has opted in or out of data sharing under CCPA regulations. A value of false indicates the client has exercised their right to opt out of the sale or sharing of personal information.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.120; FTC Advertising Practices Division; NAI Code of Conduct

attributes.name: data_sharing_consent_gdpr
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Sharing Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has provided consent for the agency to share their data with third-party partners and platforms under GDPR requirements. Must be captured and honoured for all clients operating in EU/EEA jurisdictions.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 (Lawful Basis); GDPR Article 7 (Conditions for Consent); EASA

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this preference record becomes active and should be applied to client engagement workflows. Supports temporal versioning of client preferences when preferences change over time.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: effective_until
attributes.description: The date on which this preference record expires or is superseded. Nullable for open-ended preferences. When populated, the system should apply the next active preference record after this date.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: fraud_verification_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client mandates third-party ad fraud verification (e.g., IAS, DoubleVerify, MOAT) on all programmatic and digital campaigns. When true, fraud verification tags must be applied in Google Campaign Manager 360 trafficking.
attributes.references: TAG Certified Against Fraud; IAB Tech Lab; MRC Invalid Traffic Standards

attributes.name: invoice_delivery_method
attributes.description: Client's preferred method for receiving invoices and billing statements. Drives invoice dispatch workflows in SAP S/4HANA FI and Mediaocean Prisma billing modules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Billing Configuration; Mediaocean Prisma Billing

attributes.name: invoice_format
attributes.description: Preferred electronic or physical format for invoice documents. Supports structured e-invoicing standards (EDI X12, UBL) as well as traditional PDF and CSV formats per client procurement requirements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; IAB Standard Terms and Conditions

attributes.name: io_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires explicit approval of each Insertion Order (IO) before media commitments are finalized. Governs the IO sign-off workflow in Mediaocean Prisma.
attributes.references: IAB Standard Insertion Order Terms; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: media_plan_approval_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client requires formal sign-off on media plans before buying activity commences. When true, media plans must be approved before Insertion Orders (IOs) are executed in Mediaocean Prisma.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Media Planning; IAB Standard Terms and Conditions

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account managers to capture nuanced client engagement preferences, special instructions, or contextual notes that cannot be expressed through structured fields (e.g., 'CEO prefers no calls before 10am', 'Client requires all reports in French regardless of campaign market').
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud — Account Notes; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: pacing_alert_enabled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client has opted in to receive automated campaign pacing alerts when delivery is tracking significantly above or below the planned schedule. Drives alert configuration in The Trade Desk and Google Campaign Manager 360.
attributes.references: The Trade Desk Bid Management; Google Campaign Manager 360 Reporting

attributes.name: preference_scope
attributes.description: Indicates whether this preference record applies at the advertiser account level or at an individual contact level. Drives how the preference is applied during client engagement workflows.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud — Account/Contact Object Model

attributes.name: preference_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this preference record. 'active' means the preference is in force; 'superseded' means a newer record has replaced it; 'pending_review' means awaiting client confirmation.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The client's preferred channel for day-to-day agency communications, including status updates, approvals, and general correspondence. Used by account management teams to route outreach appropriately.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Standards; Salesforce CRM Marketing Cloud — Preference Center

attributes.name: preferred_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code representing the client's preferred billing and reporting currency (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). Used in SAP S/4HANA FI and Mediaocean Prisma for invoice generation and budget reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: preferred_dsp
attributes.description: The client's preferred or mandated Demand-Side Platform (DSP) for programmatic media buying (e.g., 'The Trade Desk', 'DV360', 'Amazon DSP'). Governs platform selection during media planning in Mediaocean Prisma.
attributes.references: IAB Programmatic Standards; The Trade Desk; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: preferred_kpi_set
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or named KPI template identifying the client's primary campaign performance metrics for reporting (e.g., 'CTR,CPA,ROAS,VTR'). Drives default dashboard configuration and report templates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CTR|CPA|ROAS|VTR|CPM|CPC|GRP|TRP|SOV|ROI — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Measurement Guidelines; MRC Audience Measurement Standards; Google Campaign Manager 360

attributes.name: preferred_language_code
attributes.description: IETF BCP 47 language tag representing the client's preferred language for all agency communications, reports, and documents (e.g., 'en-US', 'fr-FR', 'de-DE'). Enables localized service delivery.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47; GDPR Article 12 (Transparency); EASA Cross-Border Complaints Handling

attributes.name: preferred_meeting_format
attributes.description: Client's preferred format for scheduled meetings such as Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), campaign briefings, and creative reviews. Informs account team logistics planning.

attributes.name: preferred_timezone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier representing the client's local time zone (e.g., 'America/New_York', 'Europe/London'). Used to schedule meetings, report delivery, and campaign flight times in the client's local context.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; IAB Ad Campaign Management Standards

attributes.name: report_delivery_channel
attributes.description: The channel through which campaign performance reports and analytics outputs are delivered to the client. Supports automated distribution via email, client portal, API push, or SFTP file transfer.
attributes.references: IAB Measurement Guidelines; Mediaocean Prisma Reporting Configuration

attributes.name: report_format
attributes.description: Preferred file or presentation format for campaign performance reports delivered to the client. Ensures reports are produced in the format the client's team can consume most efficiently.

attributes.name: reporting_cadence
attributes.description: Frequency at which the client expects to receive campaign performance reports and analytics dashboards. Drives automated report scheduling in Google Campaign Manager 360 and internal analytics platforms.
attributes.references: IAB Measurement Guidelines; MRC Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: third_party_data_sharing_allowed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the client permits the agency to share campaign data, audience segments, or performance data with third-party vendors such as DSPs, DMPs, or CDPs. Governs data flows to platforms like The Trade Desk.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28 (Data Processor); CCPA; IAB Data Transparency Standards; TAG

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this client preference record was most recently modified. Used for change tracking, synchronisation with Salesforce CRM, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: viewability_standard
attributes.description: The viewability measurement standard the client requires for campaign reporting and buying guarantees. 'mrc' applies MRC viewability definitions; 'groupm' applies GroupM's elevated viewability thresholds; 'custom' uses client-negotiated thresholds.
attributes.references: MRC Viewability Standards; IAB Measurement Guidelines; Comscore

products.name: competitive_conflict
products.description: Tracks competitive conflict declarations between advertiser accounts — identifying situations where the agency serves competing brands in the same product category or market. Captures conflicting advertiser pair (both advertiser references), product category (using IAB content taxonomy), conflict type (direct competitor, indirect/adjacent, category overlap), geographic scope of conflict, declaration date, declaring party, resolution approach (Chinese wall/information barrier, client waiver, account resignation, category carve-out, team separation), resolution status, responsible account director, board-level approval reference, and review/expiry date. Critical for AOR compliance, new business pitch eligibility screening, ethical account management, and agency E&O insurance requirements.
products.reference: 4As Agency Conflict of Interest Guidelines / ANA Standards

attributes.name: competitive_conflict_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each competitive conflict declaration record. Primary key for the competitive_conflict data product.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; 4As Agency Management Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_competitive_advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the first advertiser (incumbent client) in the competitive conflict pair. Typically the existing Agency of Record (AOR) client whose category exclusivity may be at risk.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the account director responsible for managing and resolving this competitive conflict. This individual is accountable for client communications, resolution implementation, and board-level escalation as required.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; Salesforce CRM Service Cloud

attributes.name: workfront_task_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Workfront project management task or work item tracking the resolution activities for this competitive conflict. Links conflict management to the agency's project management and resource planning workflows.
attributes.references: Workfront Project Management; 4As Agency Management Guidelines

attributes.name: aor_contract_clause
attributes.business_glossary_term: Agency of Record (AOR) Contract Clause Reference
attributes.description: Reference to the specific clause(s) in the Agency of Record (AOR) contract(s) that govern competitive conflict obligations for this declaration. Used by legal and account management teams to assess contractual exposure and resolution requirements.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards; Agency E&O Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: board_approval_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier for the board-level or senior leadership approval document authorizing the selected resolution approach. Required for 'critical' severity conflicts and account resignations. Links to governance documentation in the agency's document management system.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; Agency E&O Insurance Requirements; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: client_a_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which Advertiser A (the incumbent client) was formally notified of the competitive conflict declaration. Required for AOR compliance and contractual notification obligations.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: client_a_waiver_date
attributes.description: The date on which Advertiser A formally granted a written waiver accepting the agency's representation of the competing Advertiser B. Null if no waiver was granted or if resolution_approach is not 'client_waiver'.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: client_b_notification_date
attributes.description: The date on which Advertiser B (the challenger or prospective client) was formally notified of the competitive conflict declaration. Required for new business pitch eligibility screening and AOR compliance.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: client_b_waiver_date
attributes.description: The date on which Advertiser B formally granted a written waiver accepting the agency's representation of the competing Advertiser A. Null if no waiver was granted or if resolution_approach is not 'client_waiver'.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: conflict_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the competitive conflict, including the specific products, services, or campaigns that create the conflict, the business rationale for the conflict classification, and any relevant context for resolution decision-making. Classified as confidential due to sensitive client business information.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: conflict_reference_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric reference code assigned to this conflict declaration, used in correspondence with clients, legal counsel, and board-level approval documentation. Format: CC-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: conflict_severity
attributes.description: Business-assessed severity level of the competitive conflict, used to prioritize resolution actions and escalation paths. 'critical' typically requires board-level approval or account resignation; 'high' requires senior leadership review; 'medium' may be resolved via information barriers; 'low' may be managed with standard team separation.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: conflict_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the competitive conflict declaration. 'declared' indicates newly identified conflict; 'under_review' indicates active assessment in progress; 'resolved' indicates a resolution approach has been implemented; 'waived' indicates client has granted a formal waiver; 'escalated' indicates board-level or legal escalation; 'expired' indicates the conflict review period has lapsed without resolution.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Conflict of Interest Policy Standards

attributes.name: conflict_type
attributes.description: Classification of the nature of the competitive conflict between the two advertiser accounts. 'direct_competitor' indicates brands competing for the same customers in the same category; 'indirect_adjacent' indicates brands in adjacent categories with overlapping audiences; 'category_overlap' indicates partial product category overlap; 'channel_overlap' indicates conflict limited to specific media channels; 'geographic_overlap' indicates conflict limited to specific geographic markets. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: direct_competitor|indirect_adjacent|category_overlap|channel_overlap|geographic_overlap — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Conflict of Interest Policy Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this competitive conflict record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail entry point for the conflict declaration lifecycle.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); 4As Agency Management Guidelines

attributes.name: crm_record_code
attributes.description: The unique record identifier from Salesforce CRM (Sales Cloud) where this competitive conflict is tracked as part of the account management and client services workflow. Enables traceability between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; 4As Agency Management Guidelines

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: The date on which the competitive conflict was formally declared and entered into the agency's conflict management system. Serves as the start of the conflict review clock for AOR compliance and E&O insurance purposes.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; FTC Advertising Practices Division; Agency E&O Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: declaring_party
attributes.description: The party who formally identified and declared the competitive conflict. 'agency' indicates internal agency conflict screening; 'client_a' or 'client_b' indicates the conflict was raised by one of the affected advertisers; 'legal_counsel' indicates identification by agency legal team; 'new_business_team' indicates identification during pitch eligibility screening.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: eo_insurance_notified
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Insurance Notified Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agency's Errors and Omissions (E&O) insurance carrier has been formally notified of this competitive conflict declaration. Required for high and critical severity conflicts to preserve insurance coverage.
attributes.references: Agency E&O Insurance Requirements; 4As Agency Management Guidelines

attributes.name: geographic_markets
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of specific country codes (ISO 3166-1 alpha-3) or market identifiers where the competitive conflict applies when geographic_scope is 'regional', 'national', or 'local'. Example: 'USA,CAN,GBR'. Null when geographic_scope is 'global'.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3; IAB Geo Targeting Standards

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic extent of the competitive conflict. 'global' indicates the conflict applies across all markets; 'regional' indicates conflict is limited to a multi-country region; 'national' indicates conflict is limited to a single country; 'local' indicates conflict is limited to specific cities or DMAs (Designated Market Areas).
attributes.references: IAB Geo Targeting Standards; 4As Agency Management Guidelines

attributes.name: iab_category_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) Content Category Code
attributes.description: Product category code from the IAB Content Taxonomy (e.g., IAB2 for Automotive, IAB9-30 for Video Games) that defines the competitive product category in which the conflict exists. Enables standardized category-level conflict screening across the agency portfolio.
attributes.references: IAB Content Taxonomy v3.0; IAB Tech Lab Standards

attributes.name: iab_category_name
attributes.business_glossary_term: Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) Content Category Name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the IAB content taxonomy category corresponding to iab_category_code (e.g., 'Automotive', 'Consumer Electronics'). Provides business-friendly label for reporting and conflict screening dashboards.
attributes.references: IAB Content Taxonomy v3.0; IAB Tech Lab Standards

attributes.name: information_barrier_implemented
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal information barrier (Chinese wall) has been implemented between the account teams serving the two conflicting advertisers. True when system access controls, physical separation, and data governance protocols are in place per the resolution approach.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; GDPR Article 25 (Data Protection by Design); TAG Brand Safety Standards

attributes.name: legal_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which the agency's legal counsel completed their formal review of the competitive conflict and provided a written opinion or clearance. Null if legal_review_required is False or review is still in progress.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: legal_review_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this competitive conflict requires formal review by the agency's legal counsel before a resolution approach can be approved. Typically set to True for critical severity conflicts, account resignations, or conflicts involving active litigation.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; FTC Advertising Practices Division; Agency E&O Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this competitive conflict declaration is next scheduled for formal review by the account director and relevant stakeholders. Supports ongoing monitoring of resolved conflicts and ensures timely renewal or closure of conflict records.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: pitch_eligibility_blocked
attributes.business_glossary_term: New Business Pitch Eligibility Blocked Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this active competitive conflict blocks the agency from participating in new business pitches involving either of the conflicting advertiser categories. True when the conflict is unresolved and pitch participation would violate AOR obligations or client contracts.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: resolution_approach
attributes.description: The approved method selected to manage or resolve the competitive conflict. 'chinese_wall' (information barrier) restricts data and personnel access between account teams; 'client_waiver' indicates the affected client has formally waived the conflict; 'account_resignation' indicates the agency will resign one of the conflicting accounts; 'category_carve_out' limits the agency's scope for one client to exclude the conflicting category; 'team_separation' establishes dedicated, non-overlapping account teams.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Conflict of Interest Policy Standards; Agency E&O Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the competitive conflict was formally resolved, a waiver was granted, or an account resignation was executed. Null if the conflict is still under review or declared but unresolved.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the resolution process, key decisions, client communications, and any conditions or limitations attached to the approved resolution approach. Classified as confidential due to sensitive client and legal information.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards

attributes.name: review_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date by which the conflict declaration must be reviewed, renewed, or formally closed. Used to trigger automated review reminders and ensure ongoing AOR compliance. Typically set 12 months from declaration_date or per client contract terms.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Guidelines; ANA Client-Agency Relationship Standards; Agency E&O Insurance Requirements

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this competitive conflict record was most recently modified. Tracks the latest update to any field in the conflict declaration, supporting audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); 4As Agency Management Guidelines

products.name: revenue_target
products.description: Annual and quarterly revenue targets set for each advertiser account, broken down by service line (media, creative, digital, PR). Captures target period, target amount, currency, service line, target type (gross revenue, net revenue, fee income), target owner (account director), and target status. Supports P&L management, QBR preparation, and account growth planning. Distinct from actual billed revenue owned by the finance domain.
products.reference: Salesforce CRM Forecast / SAP S/4HANA CO-PA

attributes.name: revenue_target_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client revenue target record in the silver layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser account for which this revenue target is set. Links to the client.advertiser master record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud — Account Object

attributes.name: approver_employee_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee (typically a Managing Director or Finance Business Partner) who approved this revenue target. Supports audit trail and governance requirements for P&L sign-off.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Authorization; Internal P&L Governance; 4As Financial Management Guidelines

attributes.name: client_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_brand. Business justification: Revenue targets in advertising agencies are frequently set at brand level within advertiser accounts, not just advertiser-level. Enables brand-specific revenue forecasting, pipeline management, accoun

attributes.name: finance_budget_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.budget. Business justification: Revenue targets drive budget allocation decisions and resource planning. Account directors set client revenue targets that inform budget approvals, headcount planning, and investment decisions for cli

attributes.name: primary_revenue_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the account director or senior account manager who owns and is accountable for achieving this revenue target. Used for performance management, QBR accountability, and Workday HCM talent performance review alignment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR — Worker Object; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud — Owner Field

attributes.name: account_growth_rate_pct
attributes.description: The year-over-year or period-over-period percentage growth rate embedded in this target relative to the prior comparable period's target. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.1500 = 15%). Used in account growth planning and QBR target-setting rationale.
attributes.references: ANA Agency Compensation Guidelines; Internal Account Growth Planning Framework

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the revenue target was formally approved by the designated approver. Marks the transition from pending_approval to approved status and is used in audit trails for P&L governance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Approval Workflow; Internal P&L Governance

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Account team's assessed confidence in achieving this revenue target: high (strong pipeline, contracted SOW coverage), medium (pipeline in progress, partial SOW coverage), low (speculative, dependent on new business wins). Used in risk-adjusted P&L forecasting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud Forecast Category; Internal P&L Governance

attributes.name: contracted_sow_coverage_pct
attributes.business_glossary_term: Contracted Statement of Work (SOW) Coverage Percentage
attributes.description: The proportion of the revenue target already covered by signed Statements of Work (SOW) or Insertion Orders (IO) at the time of target setting or last update. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6500 = 65%). Supports pipeline risk assessment and P&L confidence scoring.
attributes.references: IAB Insertion Order Standards; Mediaocean Prisma SOW Management; ANA Agency Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: cost_centre_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA CO cost centre code to which this revenue target is allocated for internal P&L management and financial reporting. Enables drill-down from agency-level P&L to individual account team cost centres.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Centre Accounting; GAAP/IFRS Segment Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this revenue target record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for data lineage and governance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); Internal Data Governance Standard

attributes.name: crm_opportunity_code
attributes.description: The Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud Opportunity record ID linked to this revenue target, where the target originates from or is tracked against a specific sales opportunity. Enables traceability from target to pipeline to closed-won revenue.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud — Opportunity Object

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the target_amount is denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency advertiser portfolios and cross-market P&L consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Multi-Currency Configuration

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter to which this target applies (Q1–Q4). Populated when target_period_type is 'quarterly'; null for annual targets. Used in QBR preparation and quarterly pacing analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Period; Internal QBR Governance

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The four-digit fiscal year to which this revenue target applies (e.g., 2025). Aligns with the SAP S/4HANA FI fiscal year calendar for P&L management and budget reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP/IFRS Reporting Period

attributes.name: fx_rate_applied
attributes.description: The exchange rate used to convert target_amount to target_amount_usd at the time of target creation or last revision. Stored for auditability and variance analysis when FX rates fluctuate during the target period.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Exchange Rate Table; ISO 4217

attributes.name: is_stretch_target
attributes.description: Indicates whether this target is designated as a stretch (aspirational) target above the base committed target. True = stretch target used for incentive compensation modelling; False = base committed target used for P&L planning. Supports Workday HCM talent performance review and bonus calculation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management — Performance Goals; ANA Agency Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for account team commentary on the revenue target, including assumptions, dependencies, client commitments, or QBR talking points. Not used for structured data; supports qualitative context in account growth planning.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Best Practices; Internal QBR Governance

attributes.name: original_target_amount
attributes.description: The initial revenue target amount set at the start of the period before any revisions. Preserved for variance analysis comparing original plan vs. revised plan vs. actual billed revenue. Populated only when revision_number > 0.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Version Management; ANA Agency Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the revenue target period ends. Defines the boundary for target attainment measurement and QBR reporting cycles.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS Revenue Recognition (ASC 606 / IFRS 15); SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the revenue target period begins. Used to align target pacing with actual billed revenue from the finance domain and to support time-series analytics.
attributes.references: GAAP/IFRS Revenue Recognition (ASC 606 / IFRS 15); SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: pipeline_amount
attributes.description: The total value of identified but not yet contracted revenue opportunities in the Salesforce CRM pipeline that are expected to contribute to this target. Distinct from target_amount (the committed plan) and actual billed revenue. Supports gap-to-target analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud — Opportunity Pipeline; Internal P&L Governance

attributes.name: profit_centre_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA CO profit centre code associated with this revenue target, enabling segment-level P&L reporting by business unit, geography, or service line. Supports EBITDA reporting and management accounting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Centre Accounting; GAAP/IFRS Segment Reporting (IFRS 8)

attributes.name: revision_number
attributes.description: Sequential integer indicating how many times this revenue target has been revised (0 = original). Enables version tracking of target changes throughout the fiscal period, supporting variance analysis between original and revised targets.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Version Management; Internal P&L Governance

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation for why the revenue target was revised (e.g., client budget reduction, scope expansion, new service line added, market conditions). Supports QBR narrative and P&L variance commentary.
attributes.references: Internal P&L Governance; 4As Account Management Best Practices

attributes.name: roas_target
attributes.description: The target Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) ratio associated with this revenue target, where applicable (primarily for performance-based media service lines). Expressed as a multiplier (e.g., 4.0000 = $4 revenue per $1 ad spend). Used in digital performance optimization and KPI alignment with The Trade Desk programmatic buying.
attributes.references: IAB Performance Marketing Standards; The Trade Desk Bid Management KPIs

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: The agency service line to which this revenue target is attributed: media (Media Planning and Buying), creative (Creative Development and Production), digital (Digital Marketing and Performance Optimization), pr (Public Relations and Communications), analytics (Data Analytics and Audience Insights), strategy (Brand Strategy and Positioning). Enables service-line-level P&L reporting.
attributes.references: 4As Service Line Classification; ANA Agency Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: target_amount
attributes.description: The gross or net revenue target value set for the advertiser account for the specified period and service line, expressed in the currency defined by currency_code. This is the planned figure; actual billed revenue is owned by the finance domain. Core input for P&L management and account growth planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Planning; ANA Agency Compensation Guidelines; GAAP/IFRS ASC 606

attributes.name: target_amount_usd
attributes.description: The revenue target amount converted to US Dollars (USD) using the exchange rate applied at the time of target setting. Enables cross-currency portfolio aggregation and global P&L reporting without requiring runtime FX conversion.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Translation; ISO 4217

attributes.name: target_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for this revenue target record, used in Quarterly Business Review (QBR) reporting, P&L management, and cross-system reconciliation with SAP S/4HANA CO module.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO — Profit Center Planning; Internal Naming Convention

attributes.name: target_name
attributes.description: Human-readable label for this revenue target, typically combining the advertiser name, service line, and target period (e.g., 'Acme Corp — Media — FY2025 Q1'). Used in QBR decks and account growth planning documents.

attributes.name: target_owner_name
attributes.description: Display name of the account director or account manager who owns this revenue target. Stored denormalized for reporting convenience in QBR decks and P&L dashboards without requiring a join to the talent domain.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Best Practices; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud

attributes.name: target_period_type
attributes.description: Granularity of the target period: annual (full fiscal year), quarterly (fiscal quarter), or monthly (calendar month). Determines how the target_amount is interpreted and how actuals are paced against it in QBR reporting.
attributes.references: ANA Agency Compensation Guidelines; Internal P&L Governance

attributes.name: target_setting_method
attributes.description: The methodology used to derive this revenue target: top_down (allocated from agency-level P&L plan), bottom_up (built from individual campaign and SOW estimates), negotiated (agreed bilaterally with client), market_indexed (benchmarked against market growth indices such as Nielsen Ad Intel competitive data).
attributes.references: ANA Agency Compensation Guidelines; Nielsen Ad Intel Market Intelligence

attributes.name: target_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the revenue target record. draft: being authored; pending_approval: submitted for sign-off; approved: signed off by account director and finance; active: in-period and being tracked; revised: superseded by a revised target; closed: period ended; cancelled: target withdrawn. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: draft|pending_approval|approved|active|revised|closed|cancelled — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud Opportunity Stage; Internal P&L Governance

attributes.name: target_type
attributes.description: Classification of the revenue target by income recognition method: gross_revenue (total billings before agency commission deduction), net_revenue (billings net of media costs), fee_income (project or retainer fees), commission_income (media commission earned), retainer_fee (recurring fixed-fee arrangement). Drives P&L line allocation in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: IAB Revenue Recognition Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA FI Revenue Accounting

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this revenue target record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for change detection in ETL pipelines and audit trail completeness.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity and Accountability); Internal Data Governance Standard

products.name: client_consent_record
products.description: Authoritative record of data privacy consents and opt-in/opt-out elections captured from client contacts and advertiser organizations. Tracks consent type (marketing communications, data processing, third-party sharing), consent basis (GDPR Article 6, CCPA opt-out), consent date, expiry date, consent channel, withdrawal date, and the specific data processing purpose. Ensures regulatory compliance with GDPR, CCPA, and applicable advertising privacy standards.
products.reference: GDPR Article 7 / CCPA Section 1798.120 / IAB Transparency & Consent Framework (TCF)

attributes.name: client_consent_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each client consent record in the advertising platform. Primary key for the client_consent_record data product.
attributes.references: IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF) v2.2; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser organisation whose consent record this is. Links to the client.advertiser master entity.

attributes.name: client_contact_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual contact (person) at the advertiser organisation who provided or withdrew consent. Supports GDPR data subject rights management.

attributes.name: ccpa_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether CCPA/CPRA applies to this consent record based on the data subject's California residency or the processing context. True if CCPA obligations apply; False otherwise. Drives CCPA-specific opt-out and data deletion workflows.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.100; CPRA Amendment; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: consent_basis
attributes.description: The legal basis under which consent or data processing is justified. Maps to GDPR Article 6 lawful bases (consent, legitimate interest, contract performance) or CCPA opt-out/opt-in mechanisms, or CAN-SPAM compliance. Drives regulatory reporting and audit obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act 2003; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: consent_channel
attributes.description: The channel or interface through which consent was captured or recorded. Supports audit trail requirements and channel-specific compliance obligations (e.g., GDPR Article 7 demonstrability). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web_form|email|crm_portal|paper|api|phone|in_person — promote to reference product if additional channels are required]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); IAB TCF v2.2; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: consent_date
attributes.description: The precise date and time (with timezone offset) at which the data subject provided consent or the consent record was first captured. This is the principal business event timestamp for the consent lifecycle. Required for GDPR Article 7 demonstrability.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); CCPA Section 1798.100; IAB TCF v2.2

attributes.name: consent_proof_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or URL pointing to the stored evidence of consent (e.g., screenshot of consent form, signed document ID in DAM, email confirmation message ID, API request log ID). Required for GDPR Article 7(1) demonstrability. May reference a Workfront DAM asset or document management system record.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); ICO Consent Guidance; TAG Trustworthy Accountability Group

attributes.name: consent_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible alphanumeric reference number assigned to this consent record, used in regulatory correspondence, audit trails, and data subject access requests. Format: CNS- followed by 8–16 alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); IAB TCF v2.2 Section 3

attributes.name: consent_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the consent record. Active indicates valid consent in force; withdrawn indicates the data subject has revoked consent; expired indicates the consent has passed its expiry date; pending indicates awaiting confirmation; refused indicates the data subject explicitly declined.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(3); CCPA Section 1798.120; IAB TCF v2.2

attributes.name: consent_type
attributes.description: Classification of the specific consent category captured. Distinguishes between marketing communications consent, data processing consent, third-party data sharing consent, profiling, retargeting, and analytics use. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: marketing_communications|data_processing|third_party_sharing|profiling|retargeting|analytics — promote to reference product if additional types are required]
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(a); CCPA Section 1798.120; IAB TCF v2.2 Purpose definitions

attributes.name: consent_version
attributes.description: Version identifier of the privacy notice, consent form, or cookie banner under which this consent was obtained (e.g., v1.0, v2.3). Enables tracking of consent obtained under different notice versions for regulatory audit and re-consent workflows when notices are updated.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 13/14; IAB TCF v2.2 Section 3.1; ICO Consent Guidance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time at which this consent record was first created in the system. Audit field supporting data lineage, regulatory demonstrability, and GDPR Article 7 record-keeping obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7(1); ISO 8601; IAB TCF v2.2

attributes.name: crm_consent_record_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Consent Record ID
attributes.description: The native record identifier for this consent record in Salesforce CRM (Marketing Cloud or Service Cloud). Enables bi-directional synchronisation between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational CRM system of record for consent management.
attributes.references: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Consent Management; GDPR Article 7

attributes.name: data_categories_covered
attributes.description: Comma-separated list or structured description of the personal data categories covered by this consent record (e.g., 'email address, browsing behaviour, device identifiers, location data'). Required for GDPR Article 13/14 transparency and maps to IAB TCF data category definitions.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 4, 9, 13, 14; IAB TCF v2.2; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: data_subject_jurisdiction
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 or alpha-3 country code representing the jurisdiction of the data subject at the time consent was captured. Determines which regulatory framework (GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, PIPEDA, etc.) governs this consent record and associated data processing obligations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140; ISO 3166-1; NAI Code of Conduct

attributes.name: double_opt_in_confirmed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent was confirmed via a double opt-in mechanism (e.g., email confirmation link clicked). True if double opt-in confirmation was received. Provides stronger demonstrability of consent under GDPR Article 7 and is required for certain marketing communication channels.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ICO Consent Guidance; CAN-SPAM Act 2003

attributes.name: double_opt_in_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Double Opt-In Confirmation Date and Time
attributes.description: The precise date and time at which the double opt-in confirmation was received (e.g., confirmation link clicked). Null if double opt-in was not used or not yet confirmed. Supports audit trail for GDPR Article 7 demonstrability.

attributes.name: effective_from
attributes.description: The date from which this consent record becomes operationally effective and data processing under this consent may commence. May differ from consent_date if there is a confirmation or cooling-off period.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which this consent record expires and must be renewed or re-confirmed. Null indicates open-ended consent with no defined expiry. Supports periodic consent refresh workflows mandated by GDPR best practice and IAB TCF guidelines.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; ICO Consent Guidance; IAB TCF v2.2

attributes.name: gdpr_applicable
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Applicable Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether GDPR applies to this consent record based on the data subject's jurisdiction or the processing context. True if GDPR obligations apply; False otherwise. Drives GDPR-specific processing rules and data subject rights workflows.

attributes.name: iab_tcf_consent_string
attributes.business_glossary_term: IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF) Consent String
attributes.description: The encoded IAB TCF v2.2 consent string representing the data subject's vendor and purpose consent selections. Used by DSPs, SSPs, and DMPs to enforce consent downstream in programmatic advertising supply chains. Null for non-digital or non-programmatic consent records.
attributes.references: IAB TCF v2.2; IAB Europe Consent Framework; GDPR Article 6

attributes.name: iab_tcf_version
attributes.business_glossary_term: IAB Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF) Version
attributes.description: Version of the IAB Transparency and Consent Framework under which the TCF consent string was generated. Required for correct decoding and downstream enforcement of the consent string in programmatic advertising systems.
attributes.references: IAB TCF v2.2; IAB Europe Consent Framework

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device from which consent was captured (for digital channels). Used as part of the consent audit trail to demonstrate the origin of consent. Classified as confidential PII as IP addresses may identify individuals in certain jurisdictions under GDPR.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4(1); CJEU Case C-582/14 (Breyer); ICO Consent Guidance

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, annotations, or operational notes related to this consent record. May include details of regulatory correspondence, data subject access request references, or account management observations. Not used for structured data.

attributes.name: opt_in_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the consent record represents an affirmative opt-in (True) or an opt-out election (False). Distinguishes between opt-in consent models (GDPR default) and opt-out models (CCPA default). Critical for determining permissible data processing activities.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6(1)(a); CCPA Section 1798.120; IAB TCF v2.2

attributes.name: privacy_notice_url
attributes.description: URL of the privacy notice or consent form presented to the data subject at the time consent was captured. Provides an auditable link to the exact notice version shown, supporting GDPR Article 13/14 transparency and demonstrability requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Articles 13, 14; FTC Privacy Policy Requirements; CCPA Section 1798.100

attributes.name: processing_purpose
attributes.description: Specific, granular description of the data processing activity for which consent was obtained, as required by GDPR Article 13/14 transparency obligations. Examples include: 'Delivery of targeted programmatic advertising via DSP', 'Audience segmentation for lookalike modelling', 'Cross-channel attribution reporting'. Free-text field aligned to the IAB TCF purpose taxonomy.

attributes.name: renewal_reminder_sent_date

attributes.name: suppression_list_flag

attributes.name: updated_timestamp

products.name: client_onboarding
products.description: Tracks the formal onboarding lifecycle for new advertiser accounts — from signed contract through operational readiness. Captures onboarding status (initiated, in-progress, blocked, completed), kickoff date, system provisioning milestones (billing code creation in SAP, project management setup in Workfront/Monday, DAM access provisioning, analytics dashboard creation), assigned onboarding lead, required documentation checklist (W-9/W-8BEN, credit application, signed MSA receipt, brand guidelines receipt, media authorization forms), SLA target days, actual completion date, go-live confirmation, and post-onboarding satisfaction check. Ensures no new client falls through operational cracks between sales handoff and first campaign activation.

products.name: client_engagement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual engagement between an advertiser and a talent profile. It captures the commercial terms, usage rights, exclusivity constraints, and performance metadata for each advertiser-talent relationship. Each record links one advertiser to one talent profile with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific engagement, including negotiated rates, role assignments, contract duration, and usage rights that vary by advertiser-talent combination.. Existence Justification: In advertising agency operations, advertisers engage multiple talent profiles across different campaigns, roles, and time periods (e.g., a CPG brand may engage 5 influencers for a product launch, 3 art directors for seasonal campaigns, and 2 media specialists on retainer). Conversely, talent profiles work with multiple advertisers throughout their career and often simultaneously (e.g., a freelance art director may have active engagements with 3 different advertisers, an influencer may partner with 5 non-competing brands). Each engagement is a distinct contractual relationship with its own negotiated rate, usage rights, exclusivity terms, role assignment, and contract duration.

attributes.name: client_engagement_id
attributes.description: Primary key for client_engagement

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the advertiser (client) who is engaging the talent for campaign work

attributes.name: engagement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for this engagement record in the Silver Layer lakehouse

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the talent profile being engaged for the advertiser's campaign work

attributes.name: agreed_rate
attributes.description: The negotiated billing rate for this specific advertiser-talent engagement, which may differ from the talent's standard day_rate_usd due to volume discounts, retainer terms, or client-specific pricing. Used for project costing and invoice generation.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or email of the approver (typically talent director, finance controller, or account director) who authorized this engagement. Used for audit trail and approval workflow compliance.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this engagement was approved and moved to active status. Used for SLA tracking and engagement velocity reporting.

attributes.name: client_engagement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the engagement. Active engagements are eligible for campaign assignment and time tracking. Drives workflow routing and capacity planning visibility.

attributes.name: contract_reference

attributes.name: created_date

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The contracted end date or expiry date of the engagement. Used for renewal workflows, capacity forecasting, and contract expiration alerts. Null for open-ended retainer engagements.

attributes.name: engagement_type
attributes.description: The contractual nature of the engagement, determining billing structure, legal terms, and workflow routing. Drives rate card application and contract template selection.

attributes.name: exclusivity_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this engagement includes exclusivity restrictions preventing the talent from working with competing advertisers or brands during the engagement period. Used for conflict checking and compliance monitoring.

attributes.name: exclusivity_scope
attributes.description: Defines the scope of exclusivity restrictions when exclusivity_flag is true (e.g., 'category exclusive - automotive', 'brand exclusive - competitor brands only', 'full exclusive - all brands'). Used for conflict checking workflows.

attributes.name: rate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the agreed_rate (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Must align with advertiser preferred_currency or be explicitly agreed in contract terms.

attributes.name: role_title
attributes.description: The specific role or job title under which the talent is engaged for this advertiser (e.g., 'Senior Art Director', 'Brand Ambassador', 'CTV Media Specialist'). May differ from the talent's primary_discipline to reflect client-specific role assignments.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The effective start date of the engagement contract. Used for capacity planning, availability calculations, and contract compliance reporting.

attributes.name: usage_rights_included
