products.description: Tracks creative adaptations — derivative versions of a master creative asset adapted for different formats, channels, languages, markets, or audience segments. products.name: proof_review
products.description: This association product represents the formal review event between a client contact and a creative proof. It captures each stakeholder's individual review decision, role in the approval process, and feedback contribution. Each record links one client contact to one proof with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific review participation.. Existence Justification: In advertising creative approval workflows, proofs are reviewed by multiple client stakeholders across different functional roles (brand managers, legal reviewers, product managers, finance approvers) and across multiple review rounds. Each client contact reviews many proofs over time as campaigns progress. The business actively manages these review assignments, tracks individual reviewer decisions and turnaround times, and reports on approval bottlenecks by stakeholder role.

products.name: asset_budget_allocation
products.description: This association product represents the allocation relationship between creative assets and budget lines in advertising campaign financial management. It captures the multi-use cost allocation model where a single creative asset (hero video, key visual) is reused across multiple budget lines (TV flight, digital campaign, social media phase) and where a single budget line funds production of multiple assets in batch. Each record links one creative asset to one budget line with usage period, allocated spend, actual spend, and usage type that exist only in the context of this specific asset-budget pairing.. Existence Justification: In advertising operations, creative assets are routinely reused across multiple budget lines to maximize production ROI—a hero video produced for TV may be repurposed for digital, social, and OOH campaigns, each with separate budget lines and usage periods. Conversely, a single budget line (e.g., 'Q2 Social Media Production') often funds batch production of multiple assets (carousel ads, stories, reels). The business actively manages these allocations to track per-asset-per-budget-line spend attribution, usage periods, and cost efficiency metrics for margin analysis and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: actual_spend

attributes.name: allocated_amount
attributes.description: The portion of the budget line amount allocated to this specific creative asset. Used for multi-asset cost distribution and asset-level profitability analysis.

attributes.name: allocation_percentage
attributes.description: The percentage of the asset's total production cost allocated to this budget line. Used when a single asset's cost is split across multiple budget lines based on usage intensity or media weight.

products.name: segment_activation
products.description: This association product represents the activation contract between an audience segment and an insertion order. It captures the operational configuration for how a specific segment is targeted within a specific IO flight, including bid adjustments, frequency controls, budget allocation, and flight timing. Each record links one segment to one insertion order with attributes that exist only in the context of this media activation relationship. This is the authoritative record for segment-level media buying parameters and performance tracking.. Existence Justification: In advertising operations, insertion orders routinely activate multiple audience segments simultaneously (demographic + behavioral + lookalike targeting), and high-value segments are reused across multiple insertion orders for different campaigns, flights, and media vendors. Each segment-IO pairing requires its own operational configuration including bid modifiers, frequency caps, impression allocations, budget splits, and segment-specific flight dates that cannot be stored on either the segment master record or the insertion order contract record.

attributes.name: segment_activation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this segment activation record. Primary key.

attributes.name: audience_segment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the audience segment being activated in this insertion order

attributes.name: contract_insertion_order_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Segment Activation - Contract Insertion Order Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the insertion order authorizing this segment activation

attributes.name: activation_end_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific segment stops being targeted within this insertion order. May differ from the IO flight_end_date if segments are phased out or rotated during the campaign. Segment-level flight control.

attributes.name: activation_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this specific segment becomes active for targeting within this insertion order. May differ from the IO flight_start_date if segments are phased in during the campaign flight. Segment-level flight control.

attributes.name: activation_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of this segment activation. active: segment is live and serving; paused: temporarily stopped; completed: activation period ended; cancelled: activation terminated before completion. Independent of both segment.status and io_status.

attributes.name: allocated_budget
attributes.description: Portion of the insertion order's total_authorized_spend allocated to this segment. Used for budget pacing and segment-level ROI tracking. Sum of allocated_budget across all segments should not exceed the IO's total_authorized_spend.

attributes.name: allocated_impressions
attributes.description: Number of impressions allocated to this segment within the insertion order's total committed impressions. Used for pacing and delivery forecasting. Sum of allocated_impressions across all segments should not exceed the IO's committed_impressions.

attributes.name: bid_modifier
attributes.description: Multiplier applied to the base bid rate for this segment within this insertion order. Values >1.0 increase bids for high-value segments; values <1.0 decrease bids. Example: 1.25 means bid 25% higher for this segment. This is segment-specific bid optimization within the IO's rate structure.

attributes.name: created_date
attributes.description: Timestamp when this segment activation record was created in the system. Audit trail for activation setup.

attributes.name: frequency_cap
attributes.description: Maximum number of impressions to serve to a single user within this segment for this insertion order during the frequency cap window. Prevents over-exposure and controls user experience. Enforced at the segment-IO level, independent of campaign-level frequency caps.

attributes.name: frequency_cap_window_hours
attributes.description: Time window in hours over which the frequency cap is enforced. Example: frequency_cap=3 with window=24 means max 3 impressions per user per 24 hours for this segment-IO combination.

attributes.name: last_modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that last modified this segment activation. Audit trail for changes.

attributes.name: last_modified_date
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this segment activation record. Tracks changes to bid modifiers, frequency caps, or budget allocations.

attributes.name: segment_priority
attributes.description: Priority ranking for this segment within the insertion order when multiple segments are activated. Lower numbers indicate higher priority for impression allocation and bid decisioning. Used by DSPs and ad servers to resolve conflicts when a user qualifies for multiple segments.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier of the person or process that created this segment activation. Audit trail for accountability.

products.name: segment_usage
products.description: This association product represents the operational assignment and activation of audience segments within agency project initiatives. It captures which segments are targeted in which initiatives, the role each segment plays (primary target, exclusion list, lookalike seed, suppression), budget allocation per segment, activation timing, and performance tracking. Each record links one segment to one initiative with attributes that exist only in the context of this specific usage relationship. This is the SSOT for segment-level campaign planning, budget allocation, and activation orchestration across the agency's project portfolio.. Existence Justification: In advertising agency operations, initiatives routinely target multiple audience segments simultaneously (e.g., a brand awareness campaign targeting 'High-Income Millennials', 'Urban Parents', and 'Tech Early Adopters'), and individual segments are reused across multiple initiatives over time (e.g., the 'High-Value Customers' segment used in retention, upsell, cross-sell, and win-back initiatives). Agencies actively manage these segment-initiative assignments as operational records, tracking which segments are used in which initiatives, the tactical role each segment plays (primary target vs. exclusion vs. lookalike seed), budget allocated per segment, activation dates, and performance metrics (impressions, clicks, conversions) at the segment-initiative level.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for this segment usage record. Primary key.

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the audience segment being used in this initiative

attributes.description: Reference to the employee (audience strategist, media planner, or project manager) who created this segment usage assignment.

attributes.name: activation_status
attributes.description: Current activation state of this segment within the initiative: planned (not yet live), activated (currently targeting), paused (temporarily stopped), completed (initiative ended), cancelled (removed from initiative). Identified in detection phase as core relationship data.

attributes.description: The tactical role this segment plays within the initiative: primary_target (main audience), secondary_target (additional reach), exclusion (negative targeting), lookalike_seed (modeling source), suppression (frequency cap), control_group, or test_group. Identified in detection phase as core relationship data.

attributes.name: usage_start_date
attributes.description: Date when this segment was first activated or is planned to be activated for this initiative. Identified in detection phase as core relationship data.

products.name: vendor_agreement
products.description: This association product represents the contractual relationship between a commercial agreement and a supplier/vendor. It captures supplier-specific commercial terms, pricing models, spend commitments, and performance targets that exist only in the context of a specific agreement-supplier pairing. Each record links one agreement to one supplier with relationship-specific attributes such as effective dates, committed spend, pricing structure, payment terms, and SLA targets. This enables master service agreements (MSAs) to cover multiple vendors with distinct terms per vendor, and allows suppliers to participate in multiple agreements across different agency entities or advertiser subsidiaries.. Existence Justification: In advertising agency operations, master service agreements (MSAs) frequently cover multiple media vendors or technology platform suppliers with distinct commercial terms per vendor—different pricing models (CPM vs. fixed fee), spend commitments, SLA targets, and payment terms. Conversely, large suppliers (e.g., Google, Meta, Comcast) maintain separate agreements with multiple agency entities, advertiser subsidiaries, or holding company divisions. The business actively manages these vendor agreements as distinct contractual relationships, tracking supplier-specific performance, spend pacing, and compliance within the context of each agreement.

attributes.description: Unique identifier for this vendor agreement association record. Primary key.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the master commercial agreement record

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the supplier/vendor master record

attributes.name: auto_renewal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor-specific agreement automatically renews at expiry. May differ from master agreement auto-renewal settings for individual vendor relationships.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this vendor-specific agreement. May differ from master agreement currency for international vendor relationships.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor-specific agreement becomes legally binding and enforceable. May differ from the master agreement effective date when vendors are added to an existing MSA.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor-specific agreement terminates. May differ from the master agreement expiry date for phased vendor onboarding/offboarding.

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Supplier-specific payment terms negotiated under this agreement (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, prepayment required). May differ from standard supplier payment terms or master agreement defaults.

attributes.name: performance_tier
attributes.description: Supplier performance classification under this agreement based on historical delivery, compliance, and relationship quality. Drives preferential treatment, volume commitments, or probationary status.

attributes.name: pricing_model
attributes.description: Commercial pricing structure for this supplier under this agreement. CPM = Cost Per Mille, CPC = Cost Per Click, CPA = Cost Per Acquisition, CPV = Cost Per View. Different suppliers within the same MSA may have different pricing models.

attributes.name: signed_date
attributes.description: Date when this vendor-specific agreement or addendum was executed by all parties.

attributes.name: sla_target
attributes.description: Service Level Agreement performance target specific to this supplier under this agreement. Examples: 99.9% uptime, 24-hour response time, viewability threshold, brand safety score minimum.

attributes.name: total_committed_spend
attributes.description: Total monetary value committed to this specific supplier under this agreement over the full term. Represents the supplier-specific spend commitment within a multi-vendor MSA.

attributes.name: vendor_agreement_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this vendor-specific agreement. Allows individual vendor relationships to be suspended or terminated while the master agreement remains active with other vendors.

products.name: cost_center

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date the vendor payable was posted to the general ledger. Determines the accounting period for financial reporting and may differ from invoice date for period-end accruals.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Status of the three-way reconciliation process between vendor invoice, media buy order, and actual delivery. Pending indicates awaiting reconciliation, matched indicates full agreement, discrepancy indicates variance requiring investigation, resolved indicates discrepancy closed, escalated indicates dispute requiring management intervention.

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.business_glossary_term: SAP Financial Accounting (FI) Vendor Invoice Document Number
attributes.description: The SAP S/4HANA FI document number for the vendor invoice posting. Links the payable to the general ledger entry and enables full financial audit trail.

attributes.name: sequential_liability_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payable is subject to sequential liability rules, where the agency is liable for vendor payment only after receiving payment from the client. Critical for cash flow management and risk mitigation in media buying.
attributes.references: American Association of Advertising Agencies (4As) Sequential Liability Guidelines

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The total tax amount included in the vendor payable (e.g., sales tax, VAT, GST). Required for tax reporting and compliance with jurisdictional tax regulations.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of tax withheld from the vendor payment as required by tax regulations. Reduces the net payment amount and must be remitted to tax authorities.

products.name: payment
products.description: Records of actual cash payments made to vendors (AP disbursements) and received from clients (AR receipts), serving as the SSOT for all cash movement events. Captures payment reference number, payment date, payment direction (inbound/outbound), payment method (ACH, wire, check, credit card), payer/payee reference, linked invoice or payable reference, payment amount, currency, exchange rate applied, bank account reference, clearing document number, SAP FI payment document number, reconciliation status, and value date. Supports cash flow forecasting, bank reconciliation, DSO/DPO calculation, and working capital management.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment transaction record. Primary key for the payment entity.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client or advertiser associated with this payment. Populated for inbound AR receipts and client-related outbound payments.

attributes.name: bank_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the bank account from which the payment was debited (outbound) or to which it was credited (inbound). Links to the agency's cash management system.

attributes.name: client_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.client_invoice. Business justification: Payments can be AR receipts from clients applied to client invoices. The existing invoice_id FK points to vendor.invoice for AP disbursements; this new FK handles client payment receipts. Enables trac

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the invoice being settled by this payment. Links payment to the originating billing document for reconciliation.

attributes.name: media_insertion_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to media.media_insertion_order. Business justification: Payments allocated to insertion orders for cash flow tracking and payment reconciliation in media finance operations.

attributes.name: original_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original payment record that this payment reverses. Populated only when is_reversal is True.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor, publisher, or supplier associated with this payment. Populated for outbound AP disbursements.

attributes.name: vendor_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.vendor_payable. Business justification: Payments to vendors settle vendor payables (AP liabilities). This FK links the payment to the vendor payable record it is settling, enabling AP aging and payment application tracking. The existing inv

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: The gross monetary value of the payment transaction in the specified currency. Represents the total cash movement before any adjustments.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was approved. Null if not yet approved or if approval is not required.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment has been approved for processing: pending approval (awaiting authorization), approved (authorized for execution), or rejected (denied by approver).

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the person who approved the payment for processing. Used for audit trail and segregation of duties compliance.

attributes.name: bank_transaction_reference
attributes.description: The unique transaction identifier assigned by the bank or payment processor. Used for bank reconciliation and dispute resolution.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The interface or channel through which the payment was initiated or received: online portal, mobile app, direct bank transfer, lockbox service, manual entry by AP/AR clerk, or API integration.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: The document number assigned during the clearing process in the financial system. Links payment to the clearing entry that offsets the receivable or payable.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code representing the currency in which the payment was made (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP, JPY).

attributes.name: direction
attributes.description: Indicates whether this is a payment received from a client (inbound/AR receipt) or a payment made to a vendor (outbound/AP disbursement).

attributes.name: discount_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of any early payment discount or settlement discount applied to this payment. Null if no discount was taken.

attributes.name: exchange_rate
attributes.description: The foreign exchange rate applied to convert the payment amount to the agency's functional currency. Null for payments in functional currency.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year in which this payment was recorded. Used for period-based financial reporting.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this payment was recorded, based on the payment date. Used for financial period reporting and year-end closing.

attributes.name: functional_currency_amount
attributes.description: The payment amount converted to the agency's functional currency using the exchange rate. Used for consolidated financial reporting and P&L (Profit and Loss) analysis.

attributes.name: is_reversal
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this payment is a reversal of a previous payment transaction. True if this is a reversal entry, False otherwise.

attributes.name: memo
attributes.description: Free-text memo or notes field providing additional context about the payment. May include invoice references, campaign details, or special instructions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this payment record was last modified. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: payee_name
attributes.description: The name of the party receiving the payment. For inbound payments, this is the agency entity. For outbound payments, this is the vendor, publisher, or supplier.

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: The name of the party making the payment. For inbound payments, this is the client or advertiser. For outbound payments, this is the agency entity.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment transaction was executed or received. This is the business event date for cash flow recognition.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The financial instrument or mechanism used to execute the payment: ACH (Automated Clearing House), wire transfer, check, credit card, debit card, or electronic transfer.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment: pending (initiated but not cleared), cleared (funds transferred), failed (transaction rejected), cancelled (voided before clearing), reversed (funds returned after clearing), or reconciled (matched to invoice/payable).

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment purpose: invoice payment (standard settlement), advance payment (prepayment), refund (return of funds), rebate (volume discount payment), commission (agency fee), or retainer (upfront fee).

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the payment was successfully reconciled to its corresponding invoice or bank statement. Null if not yet reconciled.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payment has been matched to its corresponding invoice, payable, or bank statement entry: unreconciled (no match), partially reconciled (partial match), fully reconciled (complete match), or disputed (discrepancy identified).

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known unique reference number assigned to this payment transaction for tracking and reconciliation purposes. Used in bank statements and remittance advice.

attributes.name: remittance_advice_reference
attributes.description: Reference number or identifier from the remittance advice document accompanying the payment. Used to match payment to specific invoices or line items.

attributes.name: sap_payment_document_number
attributes.description: The payment document number generated in SAP S/4HANA FI module. Primary reference for integration with the ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) system.

attributes.name: terms
attributes.description: The contractual payment terms applicable to this payment (e.g., Net 30, Net 60, 2/10 Net 30). Indicates the agreed-upon payment schedule and any early payment discounts.

attributes.name: value_date
attributes.description: The date on which the funds become available in the receiving account or are debited from the paying account. Used for cash position and liquidity management.

attributes.name: withholding_tax_amount
attributes.description: The amount of tax withheld from the payment as required by tax regulations. Common for cross-border payments and vendor payments subject to withholding.

products.name: journal_entry
products.description: General ledger journal entries recording all financial transactions in the agency's books per SAP S/4HANA FI, including standard postings, accruals with auto-reversal, reversals, reclassifications, and intercompany entries. Captures journal entry number, posting date, document date, fiscal period, fiscal year, entry type (standard, accrual, reversal, intercompany, reclassification), posting status, total debit amount, total credit amount, currency, reference document, accrual-specific fields (reversal date, reversal status, estimated amount flag, accrual type: expense/revenue/media cost/production cost), created by, approved by, and SAP FI document number. Serves as the SSOT for all ledger postings including period-end accruals, supporting EBITDA tracking, period-end close processes, and financial statement preparation.

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry record. Primary key for the journal entry entity.

attributes.name: accrual_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.accrual. Business justification: Journal entries are created to post accruals at period-end and to reverse them in subsequent periods. This FK links the JE to the accrual record it is posting or reversing, enabling audit trail and ac

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the client (advertiser) associated with this journal entry. Used for client-level revenue recognition and billing reconciliation. Null for internal or non-client entries.

attributes.name: amendment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.amendment. Business justification: Significant contract amendments trigger accounting adjustments via journal entries for deferred revenue, accruals, or revenue recognition changes.

attributes.name: brand_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand.brand_profile. Business justification: Financial postings for brand-specific accruals, allocations, or adjustments require brand attribution for accurate brand P&L. Supports brand-level financial reporting, brand profitability consolidatio

attributes.name: buy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to media.media_buy. Business justification: Journal entries post media buy expenses for financial reporting and cost recognition in general ledger accounting.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the advertising campaign associated with this journal entry. Used to link financial postings to campaign performance and margin analysis. Null for non-campaign-related entries.
attributes.references: Campaign Domain; Mediaocean Prisma Campaign Billing

attributes.name: click_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to performance.click_event. Business justification: Click-based revenue/cost journal entries require click volume evidence for accurate financial reporting and accrual accounting.

attributes.name: client_invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.client_invoice. Business justification: Journal entries are created to record client invoices (AR receivables) in the general ledger when invoices are issued. This FK links the JE to the client invoice record it is posting, enabling AR subl

attributes.name: contract_milestone_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.milestone. Business justification: Milestone completion triggers accrual reversals or revenue recognition journal entries; finance links JEs to milestones for audit trail and ASC 606 compliance.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entries at header level may have default cost center attribution. Adding cost_center_id FK replaces natural key reference.

attributes.name: credit_memo_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.credit_memo. Business justification: Journal entries are created to post credit memos to the general ledger (both AR credits to clients and AP credits from vendors). This FK links the JE to the credit memo it is posting, enabling audit t

attributes.name: financial_close_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.financial_close. Business justification: Journal entries are posted as part of financial close processes and period-end activities. This FK links the JE to the financial close period it belongs to, enabling close workflow tracking and ensuri

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Journal entry header may have primary GL account reference. Adding gl_account_id FK replaces natural key reference (gl_account_code).

attributes.name: intercompany_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.intercompany_transaction. Business justification: Journal entries are created to record intercompany transactions between legal entities within the agency holding group. This FK links the JE to the intercompany transaction record it is posting, enabl

attributes.name: media_insertion_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to media.media_insertion_order. Business justification: Journal entries reference insertion orders for expense posting, accruals, and financial statement preparation in media accounting.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.payment. Business justification: Journal entries are created to record payment transactions (both AP disbursements and AR receipts) in the general ledger. This FK links the JE to the payment record it is posting, enabling cash reconc

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.revenue_recognition. Business justification: Journal entries are created to recognize revenue per revenue recognition schedules and performance obligations. This FK links the JE to the revenue recognition record it is posting, enabling complianc

attributes.name: vendor_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.vendor_payable. Business justification: Journal entries are created to record vendor payables (AP liabilities) in the general ledger when invoices are received. This FK links the JE to the vendor payable record it is posting, enabling AP su

attributes.name: accrual_reversal_date
attributes.description: For accrual-type entries, the date on which the accrual will be automatically reversed. Typically the first day of the following fiscal period. Null for non-accrual entries.
attributes.references: GAAP Accrual Accounting; SAP S/4HANA FI Accrual Reversal

attributes.name: accrual_reversal_status
attributes.description: Status of the automatic reversal for accrual entries: not_applicable (non-accrual entry), pending (scheduled for reversal), reversed (reversal completed), or failed (reversal encountered an error).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accrual Management; Internal Controls

attributes.name: accrual_type
attributes.description: For accrual entries, the category of accrual: expense (general operating expenses), revenue (deferred or unbilled revenue), media_cost (media buy accruals), production_cost (creative production accruals), or not_applicable (non-accrual entry).
attributes.references: GAAP Accrual Categories; Advertising Industry Accrual Practices

attributes.name: approved_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who approved this journal entry for posting. Null if no approval workflow is required or if entry is still pending approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Approval Workflow; Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry was approved for posting. Null if no approval is required or if entry is still pending approval.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Approval Workflow; Internal Controls

attributes.name: batch_reference
attributes.description: The batch identifier for grouped journal entries posted together in a single batch run. Used for batch-level reconciliation and error tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Batch Input; Internal Processing Standards

attributes.name: company_code
attributes.description: The legal entity or company code within the corporate structure to which this journal entry belongs. Used for multi-entity consolidation and reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code; GAAP Consolidation Standards

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who created this journal entry in the accounting system. Used for audit trail and accountability.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI User Tracking; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP) indicating the transaction currency for this journal entry.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Management

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: The date of the source document or transaction that triggered this journal entry. May differ from posting date for backdated or forward-dated entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Date; IFRS Accounting Standards

attributes.name: entry_type
attributes.description: Classification of the journal entry indicating the nature of the posting: standard (regular operational postings), accrual (period-end accruals with auto-reversal), reversal (reverses a prior entry), intercompany (cross-entity transactions), reclassification (reallocation between accounts), or adjustment (corrective postings).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Types; GAAP Accounting Standards

attributes.name: estimated_amount_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator (True/False) denoting whether the amounts in this journal entry are estimates (True) or actuals (False). Common for accruals where final invoice amounts are not yet known.
attributes.references: GAAP Estimation Principles; SAP S/4HANA FI Accrual Logic

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: The fiscal period (e.g., 01, 02, ..., 12, or 13 for year-end adjustments) to which this journal entry is assigned. Used for period-end close and financial statement preparation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Period; GAAP Period Close Requirements

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year (e.g., 2023, 2024) to which this journal entry belongs. Combined with fiscal_period, this determines the reporting period for financial statements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year; GAAP Reporting Standards

attributes.name: intercompany_partner_entity
attributes.description: For intercompany entries, the legal entity code or name of the counterparty entity within the corporate group. Null for non-intercompany entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Intercompany Accounting; GAAP Consolidation Standards

attributes.name: journal_entry_description
attributes.description: Free-text description providing business context for the journal entry, such as the nature of the transaction, campaign reference, or accounting rationale.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Header Text; Internal Documentation Standards

attributes.name: journal_entry_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique journal entry document number assigned by the accounting system. Used for external reference and audit trails.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or comments providing supplementary context, audit explanations, or special instructions related to this journal entry.
attributes.references: Internal Documentation Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Long Text

attributes.name: original_journal_entry_number
attributes.description: For reversal-type entries, the journal entry number of the original entry being reversed. Null for non-reversal entries.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Document Link; GAAP Reversal Traceability

attributes.name: posted_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry was posted to the general ledger. Null if entry is still in draft or pending approval status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Log; GAAP Posting Requirements

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: The date on which the journal entry was posted to the general ledger. This is the effective date for financial reporting and determines the fiscal period assignment.
attributes.references: GAAP Revenue Recognition; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date

attributes.name: posting_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the journal entry: draft (not yet posted), posted (committed to the general ledger), reversed (entry has been reversed), cancelled (entry voided before posting), or pending_approval (awaiting authorization).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Status; Internal Controls Framework

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: The profit center code for internal profitability analysis and segment reporting. Used for EBITDA tracking and P&L reporting by business unit.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Profit Center Accounting; Internal P&L Reporting

attributes.name: reclassification_reason
attributes.description: For reclassification entries, a textual explanation of why the reallocation between accounts was necessary. Null for non-reclassification entries.
attributes.references: Internal Accounting Policy; SAP S/4HANA FI Reclassification

attributes.name: reference_document_number
attributes.description: External reference number linking this journal entry to a source document such as an invoice, purchase order, media insertion order (IO), or contract. Used for audit trail and reconciliation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reference Field; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: reversal_journal_entry_number
attributes.description: The journal entry number of the reversing entry that offsets this original entry. Null if this entry has not been reversed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Document Link; GAAP Reversal Traceability

attributes.name: reversed_by_user
attributes.description: User ID or name of the individual who reversed this journal entry. Null if entry has not been reversed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI User Tracking; Internal Audit Standards

attributes.name: reversed_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this journal entry was reversed. Null if entry has not been reversed.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Log; GAAP Reversal Standards

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: The native SAP S/4HANA FI document number for this journal entry, used for system-to-system reconciliation and traceability back to the source ERP system.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: The name or code of the upstream system that originated this journal entry (e.g., SAP S/4HANA, Mediaocean Prisma, Workday HCM). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.
attributes.references: Data Governance Framework; ETL Source Tracking

attributes.name: total_credit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all credit amounts across all line items in this journal entry. Must equal total_debit_amount per double-entry accounting principles.
attributes.references: GAAP Double-Entry Accounting; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Logic

attributes.name: total_debit_amount
attributes.description: The sum of all debit amounts across all line items in this journal entry. Must equal total_credit_amount per double-entry accounting principles.
attributes.references: GAAP Double-Entry Accounting; SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Logic

products.name: journal_entry_line
products.description: Individual debit and credit line items within a general ledger journal entry. Captures journal entry reference, line number, GL account code, cost center, profit center, debit amount, credit amount, currency, posting key, assignment reference, campaign reference, tax code, and line item text. Enables drill-down from financial statements to source transactions and supports cost allocation across campaigns and accounts.
products.reference: SAP FI Journal Entry Line Item

attributes.name: journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the journal entry line item. Primary key for the journal entry line product.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI General Ledger Line Item

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client account associated with this line item. Supports client-level revenue recognition and margin analysis.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account; SAP S/4HANA Customer Master

attributes.name: brand_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand.brand_profile. Business justification: Individual GL line items need brand attribution for detailed brand-level financial reporting and consolidation. Required for brand P&L drill-down, brand cost allocation transparency, and supporting br

attributes.name: buy_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to media.media_buy. Business justification: Journal entry lines post buy-level expenses for detailed GL accounting and financial statement line-item support.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising campaign associated with this line item. Enables campaign-level cost allocation and ROI analysis.
attributes.references: Campaign Management; SAP S/4HANA PS Project

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Journal entry lines are allocated to cost centers for management accounting. Adding cost_center_id FK replaces natural key reference.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Every journal entry line posts to a GL account - this is the core double-entry bookkeeping relationship. Adding gl_account_id FK replaces natural key reference and removes redundant gl_account_name (r

attributes.name: journal_entry_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent journal entry header. Links this line item to its containing journal entry document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Journal Entry Header

attributes.name: media_insertion_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to media.media_insertion_order. Business justification: Journal entry lines detail insertion order-level postings for granular accounting and audit trail in financial systems.

attributes.name: reversed_line_journal_entry_line_id
attributes.description: Reference to the original journal entry line that this entry reverses. Null if this is not a reversal entry.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Reversal Document Reference

attributes.name: assignment_reference
attributes.description: Free-text assignment field used for grouping related line items, linking to external references, or supporting reconciliation processes.

attributes.name: baseline_date
attributes.description: Baseline date for payment terms calculation. Used to determine due dates and cash discount periods for payables and receivables.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms; Accounts Payable/Receivable

attributes.name: business_area_code
attributes.description: Business area for cross-company code reporting and segment analysis. Enables consolidated P&L by business line or service offering.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Business Area Accounting

attributes.name: clearing_date
attributes.description: Date on which this line item was cleared (matched with offsetting entry). Null for open items. Supports accounts payable and receivable reconciliation.

attributes.name: clearing_document_number
attributes.description: Document number of the clearing entry that closed this line item. Null for open items. Links payments to invoices and supports reconciliation.

attributes.name: created_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who created this journal entry line. Supports audit trails, segregation of duties, and SOX compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI User Audit; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this journal entry line record was first created in the system. Supports audit trails and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Audit Trail; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: credit_amount
attributes.description: Credit amount for this line item in the transaction currency. Null or zero if the line is a debit entry.
attributes.references: GAAP Double-Entry Accounting; SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the transaction amounts. Supports multi-currency accounting and foreign exchange reconciliation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Management

attributes.name: debit_amount
attributes.description: Debit amount for this line item in the transaction currency. Null or zero if the line is a credit entry.
attributes.references: GAAP Double-Entry Accounting; SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item

attributes.name: document_date
attributes.description: Date of the source document (invoice, receipt, etc.) that originated this line item. May differ from posting date for backdated or forward-dated entries.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Two-character document type code that classifies the journal entry (e.g., SA for G/L account document, DR for customer invoice, KR for vendor invoice). Controls number ranges and posting rules.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Document Type Configuration

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month) within the fiscal year for this line item. Enables monthly P&L reporting and budget variance analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Period; GAAP Reporting Periods

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this line item is posted. Supports period-based financial reporting and year-end closing processes.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Fiscal Year Variant; GAAP Reporting Periods

attributes.name: line_item_text
attributes.description: Descriptive text providing additional context for the line item. Used for audit trails, reconciliation notes, and financial statement drill-down.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item Text Field

attributes.name: line_number
attributes.description: Sequential line number within the journal entry. Determines the ordering of line items within a single journal entry document.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Line Item Numbering

attributes.name: local_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the company code local currency used in financial statements.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Company Code Configuration

attributes.name: local_currency_credit_amount
attributes.description: Credit amount converted to the company code local currency for consolidated financial reporting and P&L analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Translation; GAAP Reporting

attributes.name: local_currency_debit_amount
attributes.description: Debit amount converted to the company code local currency for consolidated financial reporting and P&L analysis.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Translation; GAAP Reporting

attributes.name: modified_by_user
attributes.description: User ID of the person who last modified this journal entry line. Supports audit trails and change management.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI User Audit; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this journal entry line record was last modified. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Change Document; SOX Compliance

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: Payment terms code defining due date calculation and cash discount conditions for vendor and customer line items.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Payment Terms Configuration

attributes.name: posting_date
attributes.description: Date on which the line item is posted to the general ledger. Determines the fiscal period and affects financial statement balances.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Posting Date; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: posting_key

attributes.name: profit_center_code

attributes.name: reference_key
attributes.description: Reference key for external system integration and cross-system reconciliation. May contain invoice numbers, purchase order numbers, or other source document identifiers.

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this line item is a reversal of a previous entry. Supports audit trails and error correction processes.

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Tax amount calculated for this line item in the transaction currency. Supports tax reconciliation and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Calculation; GAAP Tax Accounting

attributes.name: tax_code
attributes.description: Tax code that determines the tax rate and tax account for this line item. Supports VAT, sales tax, and other jurisdiction-specific tax calculations.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Configuration; GAAP Tax Accounting

attributes.name: trading_partner_code

attributes.name: value_date

attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Cash Management; Treasury Operations

products.name: revenue_recognition
products.description: Records governing when and how agency revenue is recognized from client contracts, retainers, and project-based engagements per ASC 606 / IFRS 15 standards. Captures contract reference, performance obligation description, recognition method (straight-line, milestone, percentage-of-completion), recognition start/end date, total contract value, recognized amount to date, deferred revenue amount, recognition status, fiscal period, and SAP FI revenue recognition document reference. Critical for accurate P&L reporting.

attributes.name: revenue_recognition_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the revenue recognition record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client (advertiser) for whom revenue is being recognized.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client contract or Statement of Work (SOW) that governs this revenue recognition event.

attributes.name: brand_profile_id

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising campaign associated with this revenue recognition, if applicable.

attributes.name: click_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to performance.click_event. Business justification: Performance-based contracts with click KPIs require click delivery evidence for revenue recognition under ASC 606.

attributes.name: client_invoice_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client invoice associated with this revenue recognition event, if revenue has been billed.

attributes.name: conversion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to performance.conversion_event. Business justification: Performance obligations for CPA/CPL contracts depend on conversion delivery as evidence of performance obligation satisfaction.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Revenue recognition is attributed to cost centers for P&L reporting. Adding cost_center_id FK replaces natural key reference.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Revenue recognition records post to specific GL revenue accounts. Adding gl_account_id FK replaces natural key reference.

attributes.name: media_insertion_order_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to media.media_insertion_order. Business justification: Revenue recognized against insertion orders for agency commission and service fees - fundamental revenue accounting in advertising.

attributes.name: performance_kpi_target_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to performance.performance_kpi_target. Business justification: Revenue recognition for performance contracts depends on meeting KPI targets; ASC 606 performance obligations require target linkage.

attributes.name: adjustment_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for any adjustment, reversal, or correction made to the revenue recognition record. Required when recognition status is adjusted or reversed.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the finance manager or controller who approved this revenue recognition entry, ensuring compliance with ASC 606 and internal controls.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue recognition entry was approved by the finance manager or controller.
attributes.references: Internal Financial Controls and Approval Workflow

attributes.name: contract_reference_number
attributes.description: External business identifier for the contract or Statement of Work (SOW) document.
attributes.references: ASC 606 - Revenue from Contracts with Customers

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue recognition record was first created in the system. Part of audit trail for data lineage and compliance.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this revenue recognition record (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: deferred_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Amount of revenue that has been billed or received but not yet recognized, representing the contract liability. Calculated as total contract value minus recognized amount to date.

attributes.name: fiscal_period
attributes.description: Fiscal period (month or quarter) within the fiscal year when revenue is recognized, typically 1-12 for monthly periods or 1-4 for quarterly periods.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter (1-4) within the fiscal year for quarterly business review (QBR) and financial reporting purposes.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year in which this revenue recognition event occurs, used for financial reporting and Profit and Loss (P&L) aggregation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI - Fiscal Year Variant

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this revenue recognition record is currently active (True) or has been superseded or voided (False). Used for soft deletes and historical tracking.

attributes.name: milestone_date
attributes.description: Date when the milestone was achieved or is expected to be achieved, triggering revenue recognition for milestone-based contracts.

attributes.name: milestone_name
attributes.description: Name or description of the milestone achieved that triggers revenue recognition, applicable when recognition method is milestone-based.

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who last modified this revenue recognition record. Part of audit trail for accountability.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this revenue recognition record was last modified. Updated whenever any field changes. Part of audit trail for data lineage.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, comments, or context regarding this revenue recognition event, including any special considerations or exceptions.

attributes.name: percentage_complete
attributes.description: Percentage of completion for this performance obligation, used when recognition method is percentage-of-completion. Value between 0.00 and 100.00.

attributes.name: performance_obligation_description
attributes.description: Detailed description of the specific performance obligation being fulfilled (e.g., media planning services, creative production, campaign execution, retainer services).

attributes.name: profit_center_code
attributes.description: Profit center code in SAP S/4HANA CO for segment reporting and Earnings Before Interest Taxes Depreciation and Amortization (EBITDA) tracking.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Profit Center Accounting

attributes.name: recognition_end_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue recognition is expected to complete for this performance obligation, typically aligned with contract end date or service completion.

attributes.name: recognition_method
attributes.description: Method used to recognize revenue for this performance obligation per accounting standards. Straight-line for retainers, milestone for project-based, percentage-of-completion for long-term campaigns, point-in-time for discrete deliverables.

attributes.name: recognition_start_date
attributes.description: Date when revenue recognition begins for this performance obligation, typically aligned with contract effective date or service commencement.

attributes.name: recognition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the revenue recognition record. Pending indicates not yet started, in-progress for ongoing recognition, completed when fully recognized, deferred for postponed recognition, reversed for corrections, adjusted for amendments.

attributes.name: recognized_amount_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative revenue amount recognized to date for this performance obligation. Updated as revenue is recognized over time or at point in time.

attributes.name: revenue_type
attributes.description: Classification of revenue stream type. Retainer for ongoing monthly fees, project for fixed-price engagements, commission for percentage-based fees, media markup for agency margin on media buys, production for creative services, consulting for advisory services, performance fee for outcome-based compensation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: retainer|project|commission|media_markup|production|consulting|performance_fee — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: sap_fi_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI document number for the revenue recognition posting, providing traceability to the general ledger entry.

attributes.name: sap_fi_posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the revenue recognition entry was posted in SAP S/4HANA FI general ledger.

attributes.name: service_line
attributes.description: Agency service line or business unit delivering the performance obligation (e.g., Media Planning, Creative Services, Digital Marketing, Account Management, Data Analytics).

attributes.name: total_contract_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value allocated to this specific performance obligation from the contract. Represents the transaction price allocated per ASC 606 Step 4.

attributes.name: unbilled_revenue_amount
attributes.description: Amount of revenue recognized but not yet billed to the client, representing a contract asset or accrued revenue.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or name of the person who created this revenue recognition record. Part of audit trail for accountability.

products.name: media_cost_reconciliation
products.description: Reconciliation records matching planned media costs (from IOs and media plans) against actual vendor invoices and third-party delivery confirmations from Mediaocean Prisma, Google Campaign Manager 360, and DSP platforms. Captures media buy reference, IO number, planned cost, billed cost, delivered impressions, reconciled amount, variance amount, variance reason (under-delivery, rate discrepancy, make-good), reconciliation status (open, in-dispute, cleared), billing period, vendor reference, and Mediaocean Prisma reconciliation document number. Core to sequential liability management and client billing integrity.

attributes.name: media_cost_reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the media cost reconciliation record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: brand_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand.brand_profile. Business justification: Media cost reconciliations compare planned vs actual spend by brand to ensure accurate brand-level cost accounting. Critical for brand budget variance analysis, brand profitability accuracy, and resol

attributes.name: buy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the media buy that this reconciliation record pertains to. Links to the media buy master record.

attributes.name: click_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to performance.click_event. Business justification: Click discrepancy reconciliation between ad server and publisher systems; financial adjustments require linking to click events.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: FK to finance.cost_center

attributes.name: delivery_pacing_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to performance.delivery_pacing. Business justification: Pacing data informs reconciliation of planned vs actual delivery and spend; variance analysis requires pacing metrics.

attributes.name: impression_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to performance.impression_event. Business justification: Media cost reconciliation compares planned vs actual impressions; core use case requires linking reconciliation records to actual delivery events.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Identifier for the media vendor or publisher who provided the media inventory and submitted the invoice.

attributes.name: vendor_payable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.vendor_payable. Business justification: Media cost reconciliations match planned media costs against actual vendor invoices and result in vendor payables being created or adjusted. This FK links the reconciliation to the resulting vendor pa

attributes.name: viewability_measurement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to performance.viewability_measurement. Business justification: Viewability discrepancies drive make-goods and financial adjustments; reconciliation requires linking to viewability measurement data.

attributes.name: actual_cpm
attributes.description: The actual cost per thousand impressions calculated from billed cost and delivered impressions. Calculated as (billed_cost_amount / delivered_impressions) * 1000.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the person who approved the final reconciled amount. Used for accountability and audit trail.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reconciliation was formally approved for payment processing and client billing. Represents the completion of the reconciliation workflow.

attributes.name: billed_cost_amount
attributes.description: The actual cost amount invoiced by the vendor for the media delivery. Represents the vendor's claim for payment based on delivered impressions or placements.

attributes.name: billing_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the billing period covered by this reconciliation record. Defines the conclusion of the media delivery window being reconciled.

attributes.name: billing_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the billing period covered by this reconciliation record. Defines the beginning of the media delivery window being reconciled.

attributes.name: cpm_variance
attributes.description: The difference between planned CPM and actual CPM. Used to identify rate discrepancies and pricing issues.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reconciliation record was first created in the system. Represents the start of the reconciliation lifecycle.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this reconciliation record. Ensures consistent currency handling across multi-currency campaigns.

attributes.name: delivered_impressions
attributes.description: The actual number of impressions delivered by the vendor as confirmed by third-party ad serving platforms (Google Campaign Manager 360, DSP platforms). Used for delivery variance calculation.

attributes.name: dispute_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this reconciliation record is currently under dispute. True indicates active dispute; False indicates no dispute or resolved dispute.

attributes.name: dispute_opened_date
attributes.description: Date when a dispute was formally opened for this reconciliation record. Null if no dispute has been raised.

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes documenting the dispute resolution process, including vendor communications, adjustments made, and final agreement terms.

attributes.name: dispute_resolved_date
attributes.description: Date when the dispute was formally resolved and the reconciliation was cleared. Null if dispute is still open or no dispute was raised.

attributes.name: gl_posting_date
attributes.description: Date when the reconciled amount was posted to the general ledger in SAP S/4HANA FI. Used for financial period closing and P&L reporting.

attributes.name: impression_variance
attributes.description: The difference between planned impressions and delivered impressions. Positive values indicate over-delivery; negative values indicate under-delivery.

attributes.name: impression_variance_percentage
attributes.description: The impression variance expressed as a percentage of planned impressions. Calculated as (impression_variance / planned_impressions) * 100. Used for delivery performance tracking.

attributes.name: io_number
attributes.description: The insertion order number associated with this media buy. Unique identifier for the IO document authorizing the media placement.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reconciliation record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: make_good_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator of whether this reconciliation includes make-good impressions provided by the vendor to compensate for under-delivery or quality issues.

attributes.name: make_good_impressions
attributes.description: Number of additional impressions provided by the vendor as make-good compensation. Null or zero if no make-good was provided.

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: Date by which payment to the vendor is due based on contract payment terms. Used for accounts payable scheduling and cash flow management.

attributes.name: planned_cost_amount
attributes.description: The originally planned media cost as specified in the insertion order and media plan. Represents the budgeted amount for this media buy.

attributes.name: planned_cpm
attributes.description: The planned cost per thousand impressions as negotiated in the media buy. Used as the baseline rate for cost reconciliation.

attributes.name: planned_impressions
attributes.description: The number of impressions originally planned and contracted in the insertion order. Used as the baseline for delivery reconciliation.

attributes.name: reconciled_amount
attributes.description: The final agreed-upon cost amount after reconciliation adjustments, dispute resolution, and variance analysis. This is the amount approved for payment and client billing.

attributes.name: reconciliation_document_number
attributes.description: Unique document number generated by Mediaocean Prisma for this reconciliation transaction. Used for audit trail and cross-system reference.

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow status of the reconciliation record. Tracks the lifecycle from initial variance detection through dispute resolution to final clearance and payment approval.

attributes.name: third_party_verification_date
attributes.description: Date when the third-party verification data was received or confirmed. Used for audit trail and data freshness tracking.

attributes.name: third_party_verification_source
attributes.description: Name of the third-party ad serving or verification platform that provided the delivered impressions data (e.g., Google Campaign Manager 360, The Trade Desk, Nielsen, Comscore).

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The difference between planned cost and reconciled amount. Positive values indicate over-billing or over-delivery; negative values indicate under-delivery or cost savings.

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance amount expressed as a percentage of the planned cost. Calculated as (variance_amount / planned_cost_amount) * 100. Used for threshold-based alerting and variance reporting.

attributes.name: variance_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating the primary reason for the cost variance. Used for root cause analysis and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: variance_reason_description
attributes.description: Detailed free-text explanation of the variance reason, including context, supporting evidence, and resolution notes. Provides audit trail for financial reconciliation.

attributes.name: vendor_reference
attributes.description: External reference identifier provided by the media vendor or publisher for this billing cycle. May include invoice number or billing statement reference.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: The date on which this accrual is scheduled to be reversed, typically the first day of the subsequent accounting period. Accruals are reversed when the actual invoice or payment is received and recorded.

attributes.name: variance_percentage

Captures close period reference, fiscal year, fiscal period, close type (monthly, quarterly, annual), close status (open, in-progress, pending-review, closed), close checklist items (accruals posted, bank reconciliations complete, media cost reconciliations cleared, intercompany eliminations done, revenue recognized, AR/AP subledger reconciled), task owner assignments, target close date, actual close date, days to close KPI, sign-off by controller, sign-off by CFO, SAP FI period lock status, audit trail reference, and close commentary. Essential for SOX 404 compliance, Big 4 audit readiness, and ensuring timely financial reporting per holding company deadlines.

products.name: budget_approval
products.description: This association product represents the approval authority relationship between budget and worker. It captures the multi-level approval workflow where budgets require sign-off from multiple authorized approvers (department heads, finance controllers, CFO) and workers can approve multiple budgets within their authority limits. Each record links one budget to one worker with approval authority level, delegation periods, approval limits, and notification preferences that exist only in the context of this approval relationship.. Existence Justification: Budget approval workflows in advertising agencies operate as a multi-level authorization process where a single budget requires sign-off from multiple approvers at different authority levels (department head, finance controller, CFO), and each worker can approve multiple budgets within their delegated authority limits. The approval relationship itself carries operational data including approval authority level, delegation periods (start/end dates), approval limit amounts, and notification preferences that belong to neither the budget nor the worker alone but to the specific approval authority assignment.

attributes.name: approval_limit_amount
attributes.description: The maximum budget amount this worker is authorized to approve in the budgets currency. Amounts exceeding this limit require escalation to higher authority levels. Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: assigned_by

attributes.name: assigned_date

attributes.name: delegation_start_date
attributes.description: The date when this workers approval authority for this budget becomes effective. Supports temporary delegation scenarios (e.g., during manager absence). Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

attributes.name: is_active
attributes.description: Indicates whether this approval authority assignment is currently active (true) or has been revoked/expired (false). Used to manage approval workflow routing.

attributes.name: notification_preference
attributes.description: The workers preferred notification channel for budget approval requests related to this specific budget (email, SMS, Slack, Teams). Explicitly identified in detection phase relationship data.

Integrates with Workday HCM and Workfront resource management.
