attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; USCIS I-9 Requirements; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The frequency at which the worker is compensated. Drives payroll run scheduling in Workday HCM Payroll and SAP S/4HANA FI. 'project_based' applies to freelancers and contractors paid upon milestone or project completion.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The worker's base compensation rate as stored in Workday HCM Payroll. For FTEs this represents annual salary; for freelancers and contractors this represents the agreed hourly or daily rate. Used for budget forecasting, P&L reporting, and SOW cost estimation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; SAP S/4HANA CO; 4As Compensation Benchmarks

attributes.name: pay_rate_currency
attributes.description: The ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the worker's pay rate (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency payroll processing and international contractor management.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI; Workday HCM Payroll

attributes.name: personal_email
attributes.description: The worker's personal email address used for onboarding communications, offboarding notifications, and contact when work email is unavailable (e.g., for freelancers and contractors).

attributes.name: preferred_name
attributes.description: The name the worker prefers to be addressed by in day-to-day agency operations, project assignments, and internal communications. May differ from legal name.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: standard_weekly_hours
attributes.description: The contracted or expected number of working hours per week for the worker. Used for capacity planning in Workfront resource management, overtime threshold calculations, and FTE equivalency reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; Workfront Resource Management; FLSA Overtime Regulations

attributes.name: talent_specialization
attributes.description: The worker's primary creative or technical specialization relevant to advertising and marketing production (e.g., Art Director, Copywriter, Director of Photography, Influencer, Actor, Motion Designer, Media Planner, Programmatic Trader, Data Analyst). Used for talent matching and resource allocation in Workfront.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; Workfront Resource Management; 4As Job Classification Standards

attributes.name: tax_classification
attributes.description: The IRS or applicable tax authority classification governing how the worker is compensated and taxed. Determines payroll withholding obligations, 1099 reporting requirements, and SAP S/4HANA FI vendor setup for corp-to-corp engagements.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15-A; IRS Form 1099-NEC; SAP S/4HANA FI; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_country
attributes.description: The primary country tax jurisdiction for the worker expressed as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code. Determines applicable tax treaties, withholding rates, and payroll processing rules in SAP S/4HANA FI.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IRS Publication 515; OECD Model Tax Convention; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_state
attributes.description: The state or province tax jurisdiction for the worker (e.g., NY, CA, TX for US workers). Used for state income tax withholding, nexus determination, and multi-state payroll compliance in SAP S/4HANA Payroll.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 15; SAP S/4HANA FI; CCPA

attributes.name: termination_date
attributes.description: The date the worker's employment or engagement with the agency ended, as recorded in Workday HCM. Null for active workers. Triggers offboarding workflows, system access revocation, and final payroll processing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: termination_reason
attributes.description: The categorized reason for the worker's departure from the agency. Used for attrition analytics, workforce planning, and compliance reporting. Null for active workers.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; 4As Talent Standards

attributes.name: visa_expiry_date
attributes.description: The expiration date of the worker's visa or work permit. Used to trigger renewal workflows and ensure continuous work authorization compliance. Null for workers with unrestricted authorization.
attributes.references: USCIS I-9 Requirements; UK Right to Work Checks; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: visa_type
attributes.description: The type of visa or work permit held by the worker where applicable (e.g., H-1B, L-1, O-1, Tier 2, EU Blue Card). Null for workers with unrestricted work authorization. Used for immigration compliance tracking.
attributes.references: USCIS Visa Classifications; UK Home Office; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: work_arrangement
attributes.description: The worker's approved work location arrangement. Impacts tax nexus determination, facilities planning, and collaboration tool provisioning. Particularly relevant for multi-jurisdiction agencies operating under GDPR and CCPA.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: work_authorization_status
attributes.description: The current work authorization status of the worker in their primary work jurisdiction. Critical for compliance with immigration laws and I-9/right-to-work verification requirements. Triggers alerts when visa or permit expiry is approaching.
attributes.references: USCIS I-9 Requirements; UK Right to Work Checks; GDPR Article 9; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: work_email
attributes.description: The agency-issued or primary professional email address for the worker. Used for system access provisioning, Workfront project assignments, and internal communications.

attributes.name: work_permit_ref
attributes.description: Document reference identifier for the worker's work permit or right-to-work documentation stored in the agency's DAM or Workday HCM document vault. Used for immigration compliance audits and I-9 reverification tracking.
attributes.references: USCIS I-9 Requirements; UK Right to Work Checks; Workfront DAM; GDPR Article 9

attributes.name: workday_worker_reference
attributes.description: The native worker identifier assigned by Workday HCM Core HR module. Used for system-of-record cross-referencing and integration with Workday Payroll, Time Tracking, and Talent Management modules.

attributes.name: worker_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the worker record within the agency. Drives access provisioning, payroll processing, and resource availability in Workfront. 'pending_onboard' indicates pre-start date; 'on_leave' covers parental, medical, and sabbatical leave.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; Workfront Resource Management

products.name: position
products.description: Authorized headcount positions within the agency organizational structure — including job title, department, discipline (e.g., Art Director, Media Planner, Account Manager, Copywriter), seniority level, FTE/contractor classification, and budgeted vs. filled status. Sourced from Workday HCM position management.

attributes.name: position_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for an authorized headcount position within the agency organizational structure. Primary key sourced from Workday HCM position management.

attributes.name: acquisition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the active job requisition in Workday HCM Recruiting associated with filling this open position. Links position management to the talent acquisition workflow.

attributes.name: address_id
attributes.description: Reference to the physical or virtual office location where the position is based. Supports geographic workforce distribution reporting and compliance with local labor regulations.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the SAP S/4HANA cost center to which the position's labor costs are allocated. Enables financial reporting, P&L attribution, and budget reconciliation at the department or client level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Cost Center Accounting

attributes.name: headcount_plan_id
attributes.description: Reference to the annual or quarterly headcount plan under which this position was authorized. Links to the agency's workforce planning cycle in SAP S/4HANA or Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Headcount Planning; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: incumbent_worker_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.worker. Business justification: Position can be filled by a worker (the incumbent). This is the current occupant of the position. One position has one current incumbent; one worker can hold one primary position at a time. The FK col

attributes.name: job_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the standardized Workday HCM job profile that defines the competencies, qualifications, and pay range associated with this position. Enables consistent role definition across the agency.

attributes.name: position_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency department to which this position belongs (e.g., Creative, Media, Account Management, Analytics, PR). Links to the department master in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: position_supervisory_org_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Workday HCM supervisory organization unit that owns this position. Defines the management hierarchy and reporting structure within the agency.

attributes.name: reports_to_position_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier of the parent position in the organizational hierarchy to which this position reports. Enables org chart traversal, span-of-control analysis, and management reporting.

attributes.name: available_for_overlap
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position allows an overlap period where both an outgoing and incoming worker can be simultaneously active. True = overlap permitted; False = single occupancy only. Supports transition planning.

attributes.name: budgeted_annual_salary
attributes.description: The approved annual salary budget allocated for this position in the agency headcount plan. Used for P&L, EBITDA reporting, and budget reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA. Expressed in the agency's base currency.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Management; Agency P&L Reporting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this position record was first created in the system of record (Workday HCM). Used for audit trail, data lineage, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the budgeted salary and compensation values associated with this position (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency agency operations.

attributes.name: discipline
attributes.description: Functional discipline or craft area of the position within the agency (e.g., Art Direction, Copywriting, Media Planning, Media Buying, Account Management, Strategy, Data Analytics, Public Relations, Production, Digital Marketing). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: art_direction|copywriting|media_planning|media_buying|account_management|strategy|data_analytics|public_relations|production|digital_marketing|brand_strategy|project_management — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Workforce Standards; 4As Agency Workforce Classification

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this position is authorized and active within the agency organizational structure. Used for workforce planning, budget activation, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Effective Dating; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Nature of the employment arrangement for the position — full-time, part-time, fixed-term, or casual. Distinct from worker_type; governs scheduling, benefits, and labor law compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Employment Type; FLSA; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which this position is scheduled to be eliminated or closed. Null for permanent positions. Used for fixed-term headcount planning and budget forecasting.

attributes.name: fte_capacity
attributes.description: The authorized FTE capacity of the position expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0 = full-time, 0.5 = half-time). Used for resource planning, capacity planning, and FTE headcount reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM FTE Management; 4As Agency Workforce Standards

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the labor cost of this position is directly billable to a client account or Statement of Work (SOW). True = billable; False = non-billable overhead. Drives client billing and P&L attribution.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Billing; SAP S/4HANA PS Project Billing; SOW

attributes.name: is_budgeted
attributes.description: Indicates whether this position has an approved budget allocation in the agency's annual headcount plan. True = budgeted; False = unbudgeted or pending approval. Used for P&L and EBITDA reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO Budget Management; Agency P&L Reporting

attributes.name: is_critical_role
attributes.description: Flags whether this position is designated as a critical or key role within the agency's talent strategy. Critical roles receive priority in succession planning and talent acquisition pipelines.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Management; 4As Talent Strategy

attributes.name: is_filled
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is currently occupied by an active worker. True = filled; False = vacant. Supports headcount gap analysis and capacity planning in Workfront resource management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; Workfront Resource Planning

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad grouping of related job functions within the agency (e.g., Creative, Media, Client Services, Technology, Finance, Operations). Used for compensation benchmarking, career pathing, and workforce analytics in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Family; IAB Workforce Classification

attributes.name: max_incumbents
attributes.description: The maximum number of workers that can simultaneously occupy this position. Typically 1 for standard positions; may be greater for shared or pooled roles. Enforced in Workday HCM position restrictions.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this position record was last modified in the system of record (Workday HCM). Supports change tracking, data quality monitoring, and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: pay_grade
attributes.description: Compensation grade or band assigned to the position, defining the salary range and benefits tier. Confidential business data used for compensation benchmarking and P&L management. Sourced from Workday HCM compensation structure.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Management; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: position_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the position as assigned in Workday HCM (e.g., POS-ART001). Used for cross-system referencing, reporting, and integration with Workfront resource management.

attributes.name: position_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the position within the agency headcount plan. Open = authorized and vacant; Filled = occupied by a worker; Frozen = authorized but hiring suspended; Eliminated = decommissioned; Proposed = pending budget approval.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Status; SAP S/4HANA CO Headcount Planning

attributes.name: seniority_level
attributes.description: Seniority classification of the position within the agency hierarchy, indicating career level and scope of responsibility. Used for resource planning, compensation benchmarking, and capacity planning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: junior|mid|senior|lead|director|vp|c_level — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; 4As Agency Workforce Classification

attributes.name: standard_hours_per_week
attributes.description: The standard contracted working hours per week for this position. Used for time tracking, capacity planning, and overtime compliance in Workday HCM and Workfront resource management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Scheduled Weekly Hours; FLSA

attributes.name: target_fill_date
attributes.description: The target date by which an open position should be filled. Used by talent acquisition teams to track recruiting timelines and manage agency capacity gaps.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; Workfront Resource Planning

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Official job title associated with the position as defined in the agency organizational structure (e.g., Art Director, Media Planner, Account Manager, Copywriter, Creative Director). Sourced from Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Position Management; IAB Workforce Standards

attributes.name: work_arrangement
attributes.description: The approved work arrangement for the position — on-site, remote, or hybrid. Reflects post-pandemic workforce policies and impacts resource planning and office capacity management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Work Space; Agency Workforce Policy

attributes.name: workday_position_reference
attributes.description: The native position identifier from the Workday HCM source system. Used for system-of-record traceability, ETL reconciliation, and integration with Workfront resource management.

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the position by employment arrangement — Full-Time Equivalent (FTE), contractor, freelancer, intern, or agency temp. Drives payroll processing, benefits eligibility, and FTE headcount reporting in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; FLSA Classification; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: workfront_role_reference
attributes.description: The corresponding job role identifier in Workfront resource management that maps to this position. Enables cross-system resource allocation, capacity planning, and project staffing.

products.name: talent_profile
products.description: Skills, competencies, certifications, portfolio credits, and specialization metadata for each worker — including creative disciplines, media channel expertise (SEM, programmatic, OOH, CTV), software proficiencies (Adobe CC, The Trade Desk, CM360), language capabilities, and award history. For influencer talent: social platform handles, follower counts per platform (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, X), engagement rates, audience demographics, content niche/vertical, past brand partnerships, exclusivity restrictions, and influencer tier classification (nano, micro, macro, mega). Distinct from the worker identity record; captures the full professional capability and market-value dimension across all talent types including external influencers with platform-specific commercial attributes.

attributes.name: talent_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the talent profile record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for this entity. Role classification: MASTER_RESOURCE — this entity represents a professional capability and market-value profile for a worker or influencer managed by the agency.

attributes.name: brand_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand.brand_profile. Business justification: Talent profiles track brand specialization and certification for specific brand identities. Agencies need to match talent with brand expertise for staffing decisions, pitch teams, and client presentat

attributes.name: primary_talent_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent worker identity record (employee, freelancer, contractor, influencer, actor, photographer, director, or crew member). This profile is distinct from the identity record and captures professional capability dimensions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Worker Object; Workfront Resource Management

attributes.name: audience_primary_age_range
attributes.description: The dominant age demographic of the influencer's audience, used for campaign audience targeting alignment and media planning. Sourced from platform analytics dashboards. Applicable to influencer talent type only.
attributes.references: IAB Audience Measurement Standards; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines; COPPA (Children's Online Privacy Protection Act)

attributes.name: audience_primary_gender
attributes.description: The dominant gender composition of the influencer's audience (male, female, or mixed when no single gender exceeds 60%). Used for campaign audience alignment and GRP/TRP planning. Applicable to influencer talent type only.
attributes.references: IAB Audience Measurement Standards; MRC Audience Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: availability_status
attributes.description: Current resource availability status for campaign assignment and capacity planning. Sourced from Workfront resource management and Workday HCM time-off records. Used by resource planners to staff campaigns.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; Workday HCM - Time Tracking

attributes.name: award_count
attributes.description: Total number of industry awards won by the talent (e.g., Cannes Lions, Clio Awards, D&AD, One Show, Effie Awards). Used as a market-value indicator for talent positioning, new business pitches, and rate negotiations.
attributes.references: Cannes Lions International Festival of Creativity; Clio Awards; D&AD; Effie Awards

attributes.name: capacity_hours_per_week
attributes.description: Standard weekly available hours for campaign work, used in Workfront resource planning and FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) capacity calculations. For part-time or fractional workers, reflects contracted hours.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; Workday HCM - Time Tracking; 4As Resource Planning Standards

attributes.name: certification_expiry_date
attributes.description: The earliest expiry date among the talent's active certifications. Used to trigger renewal workflows and ensure compliance with client contractual requirements for certified practitioners.
attributes.references: IAB Certification Programs; Google Ads Certification Renewal Policy

attributes.name: certifications
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of active professional certifications held by the talent (e.g., Google Ads Certified|IAB Digital Media Buying|Meta Blueprint|The Trade Desk Edge Academy|HubSpot Inbound). Used for compliance verification and capability credentialing.
attributes.references: IAB Certification Programs; Google Ads Certification; MRC Accreditation

attributes.name: content_niche
attributes.description: The primary content category or vertical the influencer creates content in (e.g., beauty, fitness, gaming, finance, travel, food, fashion, technology, parenting). Used for brand-audience alignment and campaign targeting strategy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: beauty|fitness|gaming|finance|travel|food|fashion|technology|parenting|lifestyle — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Content Taxonomy v3.0; ANA Influencer Marketing Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the talent profile record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail, data lineage, and GDPR data subject request processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30 (Records of Processing Activities); Workday HCM - Audit Trail

attributes.name: day_rate_usd
attributes.description: The standard daily billing rate for the talent in US Dollars. Used for project cost estimation, SOW budgeting, and P&L management. For FTE employees, this is the internal cost rate; for freelancers and contractors, this is the contracted rate.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO - Cost Center Accounting; Mediaocean Prisma - Rate Management; 4As Compensation Benchmarking

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: The professional or stage name by which the talent is known in the market and on creative briefs, campaign credits, and influencer contracts. May differ from legal name on the worker identity record.
attributes.references: IAB - Talent Identification Standards; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: engagement_rate
attributes.description: Average engagement rate (likes + comments + shares divided by impressions or followers) across the influencer's primary platform, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0325 = 3.25%). A key KPI for influencer selection and CPM/CPA rate negotiation. Applicable to influencer talent type only.
attributes.references: IAB Influencer Marketing Measurement Standards; MRC Social Media Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: exclusivity_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the current exclusivity restriction expires, enabling the talent to work with competing brands. Used to trigger availability alerts and plan future campaign assignments.
attributes.references: 4As Talent Contract Standards; SAP S/4HANA PS - Contract Management

attributes.name: exclusivity_restrictions
attributes.description: Description of any active brand category exclusivity restrictions on the talent (e.g., 'exclusive to automotive category through 2025-12-31', 'no competing beverage brands'). Critical for conflict-of-interest checks during campaign staffing and IO execution. Applicable primarily to influencer and on-screen talent.
attributes.references: 4As Talent Contract Standards; ANA Brand Safety Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA PS - Contract Management

attributes.name: influencer_tier
attributes.description: Industry-standard tier classification for influencer talent based on total follower count across platforms: nano (<10K), micro (10K–100K), macro (100K–1M), mega (>1M). Drives influencer rate card selection, campaign eligibility, and brand partnership strategy. Null for non-influencer talent types.
attributes.references: IAB Influencer Marketing Standards; ANA Influencer Marketing Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: instagram_handle
attributes.description: The talent's Instagram social media handle (username prefixed with @). Used for influencer campaign trafficking, audience verification, and platform-specific performance tracking. Applicable to influencer talent type only.
attributes.references: IAB Influencer Marketing Standards; FTC Endorsement Guidelines

attributes.name: language_capabilities
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of languages the talent can work in professionally, using ISO 639-1 codes (e.g., en|es|fr|de|zh). Essential for multilingual campaign staffing and international client servicing.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; GDPR Article 12 (communication language requirements)

attributes.name: media_channel_expertise
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of media channels in which the talent has demonstrated expertise (e.g., SEM|programmatic|OOH|CTV|DOOH|social|print|radio). Used for campaign staffing and capability gap analysis. Stored as a delimited string per Silver Layer conventions; normalized in Gold Layer.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Media Buying Standards; MRC Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: notable_award_names
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of the most significant industry awards won by the talent (e.g., Cannes Lions Gold|D&AD Black Pencil|Effie Gold). Used in agency credentials, pitch decks, and talent marketing materials.
attributes.references: Cannes Lions; D&AD; Effie Awards; Clio Awards

attributes.name: notable_brand_credits
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of notable brand or client names the talent has worked with in prior campaigns. Used for capability demonstration in new business pitches and talent positioning. Excludes current client names subject to confidentiality.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Credentials Standards; ANA Brand Safety Guidelines

attributes.name: past_brand_partnerships
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of notable past brand partnership names for influencer talent (e.g., Nike|L'Oreal|Samsung). Used for brand alignment assessment, conflict-of-interest screening, and influencer credentialing in pitch materials.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guidelines; ANA Influencer Marketing Guidelines; IAB Influencer Marketing Standards

attributes.name: portfolio_url
attributes.description: URL to the talent's professional portfolio, showreel, or Digital Asset Management (DAM) collection in Workfront. Used during pitching, new business development, and talent acquisition evaluation.
attributes.references: Workfront DAM; IAB Creative Quality Standards

attributes.name: primary_discipline
attributes.description: The principal creative or functional discipline of the talent (e.g., Art Direction, Copywriting, Motion Design, Media Planning, Programmatic Buying, Account Management, Photography, Film Direction). Used for resource planning and capability matching in Workfront. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: art_direction|copywriting|motion_design|media_planning|programmatic_buying|account_management|photography|film_direction|strategy|data_analytics — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 4As Talent Competency Framework; Workfront Resource Management

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the talent profile record. Active profiles are eligible for campaign assignment and resource planning. Inactive or archived profiles are retained for historical reporting and rights audit purposes.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Worker Status; Workfront Resource Management

attributes.name: rate_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the talent's day rate (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency rate management for international talent and global campaign staffing.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI - Currency Management

attributes.name: seniority_level
attributes.description: Professional seniority classification used for rate card assignment, billing tier determination, and resource planning capacity calculations. Aligns with Workday HCM job grade levels. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: junior|mid|senior|lead|director|vp|c_level — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Job Profile; 4As Compensation Benchmarking

attributes.name: software_proficiencies
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of software tools and platforms the talent is proficient in (e.g., Adobe CC|The Trade Desk|CM360|Salesforce|Workfront|Mediaocean Prisma|Google Analytics|DV360). Critical for project staffing and tool-specific campaign execution.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Skills; Adobe Creative Cloud; The Trade Desk; Google Campaign Manager 360

attributes.name: specialization
attributes.description: Secondary or niche specialization within the primary discipline (e.g., CTV/OTT media buying, DOOH planning, SEM campaign management, influencer strategy, brand identity design). Enables granular capability matching for complex campaign requirements.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Media Buying Certification; 4As Competency Framework

attributes.name: talent_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the talent worker type, determining applicable rate cards, rights management rules, and compliance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: employee|freelancer|contractor|influencer|actor|photographer|director|production_crew — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Worker Type Classification; 4As Talent Classification Standards

attributes.name: tiktok_handle
attributes.description: The talent's TikTok social media handle. Used for influencer campaign trafficking, content verification, and short-form video performance analytics. Applicable to influencer talent type only.
attributes.references: IAB Influencer Marketing Standards; FTC Endorsement Guidelines

attributes.name: total_follower_count
attributes.description: Aggregate follower count across all active social media platforms for influencer talent. Used for influencer tier classification, CPM rate card assignment, and campaign reach estimation. Refreshed periodically from platform APIs.
attributes.references: IAB Influencer Marketing Measurement Standards; MRC Social Media Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent update to the talent profile record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for data freshness monitoring, change detection in ETL pipelines, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 30; Workday HCM - Audit Trail; Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed

attributes.name: usage_rights_expiry_date
attributes.description: The date on which the talent's current usage rights grant expires. After this date, creative assets featuring the talent may not be used without renegotiation. Triggers rights renewal workflows and asset retirement processes.
attributes.references: 4As Talent Contract Standards; SAP S/4HANA PS - Rights Management

attributes.name: usage_rights_summary
attributes.description: Summary of the talent's granted usage rights for creative assets produced (e.g., 'digital worldwide 2 years', 'broadcast North America 1 year', 'social media unlimited'). Governs how produced creative assets may be deployed across channels and geographies. Critical for rights management and compliance.
attributes.references: 4As Talent Contract Standards; SAP S/4HANA PS - Rights Management; GDPR Article 6 (lawful basis for data use)

attributes.name: x_handle
attributes.description: The talent's X (formerly Twitter) social media handle. Used for influencer campaign trafficking and social listening integration. Applicable to influencer talent type only.
attributes.references: IAB Influencer Marketing Standards; FTC Endorsement Guidelines

attributes.name: years_of_experience
attributes.description: Total years of professional experience in the talent's primary discipline. Used for rate benchmarking, capability assessment, and talent acquisition scoring.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Work Experience; 4As Talent Benchmarking

attributes.name: youtube_channel_url
attributes.description: The talent's YouTube channel URL. Used for influencer campaign trafficking, video content verification, and CTV/OTT audience analytics. Applicable to influencer talent type only.
attributes.references: IAB Influencer Marketing Standards; FTC Endorsement Guidelines

products.name: talent_engagement
products.description: Contractual engagement record for each talent assignment — covering engagement type (FTE employment, freelance SOW, contractor agreement, influencer partnership, production crew booking), start/end dates, engagement status (draft, active, on-hold, completed, terminated), billing arrangement (hourly, day rate, project fee, retainer, usage-based), agreed rate, currency, and the client campaign or project it supports. Bridges talent identity to commercial work and serves as the commercial spine linking worker availability to project delivery.

attributes.name: talent_engagement_id
