attributes.description: Indicates whether the allocated hours for this resource are billable to the client. True: hours are client-billable; False: hours are internal/non-billable (e.g., new business pitches, internal projects, overhead). Critical for financial reconciliation and client invoicing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Mediaocean Prisma Billing; 4As Financial Management Standards

attributes.name: booking_type
attributes.description: Indicates the commitment level of the resource booking. Hard Book: firm, committed allocation; Soft Book: provisional hold subject to confirmation; Option: first right of refusal on the worker's availability. Critical for production scheduling and talent management.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; 4As Production Scheduling Standards; ANA Talent Management Guidelines

attributes.name: call_time
attributes.description: For production shoot assignments: the scheduled time the worker is required to report to the set or location (call time). Null for non-production office-based assignments. Critical for production crew scheduling and logistics.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; AICP Production Standards; 4As Production Guidelines

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this resource allocation record was first created in the system. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED timestamp for audit trail and data lineage purposes.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); TAG Data Transparency Standards

attributes.name: crew_role_designation
attributes.description: For production shoot assignments: the specific on-set crew role designation (e.g., Director of Photography, Gaffer, Key Grip, Production Assistant, Makeup Artist, Wardrobe Stylist). More granular than worker_role and specific to production context. Null for non-production assignments. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: director_of_photography|gaffer|key_grip|production_assistant|makeup_artist|wardrobe_stylist|sound_mixer|camera_operator — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: AICP Production Standards; 4As Production Guidelines; IATSE Union Classifications

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the bill_rate and cost_rate for this allocation (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency agency operations and financial consolidation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217; SAP S/4HANA FI; EASA Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: The agency department or practice area to which the worker belongs for this allocation (e.g., Creative, Strategy, Media, Account Management, Production, Analytics, Technology). Used for departmental capacity planning and cross-departmental resource sharing.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; 4As Agency Structure Standards

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker's allocation to the project or campaign ends. Nullable for open-ended allocations. Used for capacity planning and resource release scheduling. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_UNTIL date for this allocation.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; Workday HCM Time Tracking

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for resource managers to capture additional context, special instructions, or conditions associated with this allocation (e.g., 'Worker available mornings only', 'Subject to union call sheet requirements', 'Pending client SOW approval').

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Numeric priority ranking for this allocation when a worker has multiple concurrent assignments (1 = highest priority). Used by resource managers to resolve scheduling conflicts and determine which project takes precedence for the worker's time.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; 4As Resource Planning Standards

attributes.name: shoot_location
attributes.description: For production shoot assignments: the physical location or studio address where the production takes place (e.g., 'Studio A - Soho, NYC', 'Location: Malibu Beach, CA'). Null for office-based project work. Used for crew logistics and travel planning.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; AICP Production Standards

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the worker's allocation to the project or campaign begins. Used for capacity planning, scheduling, and utilization reporting. Serves as the EFFECTIVE_FROM date for this allocation.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; Workday HCM Time Tracking

attributes.name: total_allocated_hours
attributes.description: The total number of hours allocated for the entire duration of this assignment (from start_date to end_date). Calculated at booking time and stored for scheduling and billing purposes. Distinct from allocated_hours_per_week which is the weekly rate.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; Workday HCM Time Tracking; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this resource allocation record was last modified. Serves as the RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED timestamp for change tracking, incremental ETL processing, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); TAG Data Transparency Standards

attributes.name: utilization_target_percentage
attributes.description: The target billable utilization percentage for this worker on this allocation, as set by resource management. Used to measure actual vs. planned utilization and inform capacity planning decisions. Distinct from allocation_percentage which reflects scheduled capacity.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; 4As Agency Operations Standards; ANA Talent Management Guidelines

attributes.name: wbs_code
attributes.description: The SAP Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code identifying the specific project phase or deliverable to which this allocation is assigned. Enables granular project cost tracking and financial reconciliation at the deliverable level.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS; PMI WBS Standards; 4As Project Management Standards

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the worker's employment relationship for this allocation. Full-Time Equivalent (FTE): salaried employee; Freelancer: independent creative professional; Contractor: third-party contracted resource; Influencer: paid social/content talent; Talent: on-screen actor/model/spokesperson; Crew: production crew member (grip, gaffer, PA, etc.).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; FTC Advertising Practices; IAB Influencer Marketing Standards

attributes.name: wrap_time
attributes.description: For production shoot assignments: the scheduled time the worker is expected to complete their duties and wrap for the day. Null for non-production assignments. Used for crew scheduling, overtime calculation, and production logistics.
attributes.references: Workfront Resource Management; AICP Production Standards; 4As Production Guidelines

products.name: timesheet
products.description: Time tracking records submitted by workers — containing both header-level metadata (pay period, submission date, approval status, approver, submission method) and line-level entries (hours per project/campaign/cost center, activity type such as creative production, media planning, client meetings, or admin, billable vs. non-billable classification, overtime hours, task-level project codes, and date of work). Each timesheet encompasses all individual time entries for a pay period. Sourced from Workday HCM Time Tracking module. Foundation for client billing, payroll processing, utilization reporting, and granular cost allocation to campaigns and clients. Supports multi-project, multi-jurisdiction time capture with jurisdiction-specific overtime rules and holiday calendars.

attributes.name: timesheet_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each timesheet record. Serves as the primary key for the timesheet entity in the Workday HCM Time Tracking module silver layer.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client (advertiser) for whom the majority of work on this timesheet was performed. Used for client-level billing reconciliation and account profitability reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; 4As Agency Operations Standards

attributes.name: approver_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or supervisor who approved or rejected this timesheet. Links to the worker/employee master record for the approving party.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; 4As Agency Operations Standards

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Reference to the primary cost center against which the worker's time is charged for this pay period. Supports P&L reporting and granular cost allocation in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling); ANA Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: holiday_calendar_id
attributes.description: Reference to the jurisdiction-specific holiday calendar applied to this timesheet for holiday hours identification and overtime rule application. Supports multi-jurisdiction time capture.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; EU Working Time Directive; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.initiative. Business justification: Timesheets capture hours worked by workers; linking to initiative enables project-level cost accounting, billing reconciliation, utilization reporting by project, and labor cost actuals for project bu

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the organizational department to which the worker belongs for this pay period. Used for internal cost allocation and utilization reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: original_timesheet_id
attributes.description: For amended timesheets (is_amended = true), references the original timesheet record that this amendment supersedes. Null for original submissions. Supports audit trail and payroll adjustment reconciliation.

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the payroll processing run in which this timesheet's hours were included. Populated after payroll processing. Used for payroll reconciliation and audit traceability back to SAP S/4HANA payroll runs.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: resource_allocation_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.resource_allocation. Business justification: Timesheet hours are logged against a specific resource allocation (the planned booking). One timesheet references one allocation; one allocation can have many timesheets over its duration. This links

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Statement of Work (SOW) or contract under which the worker's time is being billed. Links timesheet hours to contractual scope and budget for client billing validation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud; Mediaocean Prisma; IAB SOW Standards

attributes.name: task_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.task. Business justification: Timesheets often capture task-level time detail for granular tracking. Linking enables task cost actuals calculation, earned value analysis, task completion validation, and detailed project accounting

attributes.name: timesheet_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (employee, freelancer, contractor, or production crew member) who submitted this timesheet. Links to the talent/worker master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current workflow lifecycle state of the timesheet. Drives payroll processing eligibility and client billing readiness. Values: draft (in progress), submitted (pending review), approved (cleared for payroll/billing), rejected (returned for correction), recalled (withdrawn by worker after submission).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; 4As Agency Operations Standards

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the approving manager approved the timesheet. Null if not yet approved. Used for approval cycle-time analytics and payroll processing triggers.

attributes.name: billable_hours
attributes.description: Total hours within this timesheet classified as billable to clients. Foundation for client invoicing, ROAS analysis, and agency utilization rate calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; IAB Billing Standards; 4As Agency Operations Standards

attributes.name: billing_rate
attributes.description: The hourly rate at which the worker's billable time is charged to clients for this pay period. Used in conjunction with billable_hours to calculate client invoice amounts. Confidential commercial rate data.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma; IAB Billing Standards; 4As Agency Operations Standards

attributes.name: cost_rate
attributes.description: The internal hourly cost rate for the worker during this pay period, used for P&L analysis, margin calculation, and cost allocation to campaigns and clients. Confidential internal financial data.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA CO (Controlling); ANA Financial Reporting Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the timesheet record was first created in the system (typically when the worker initiates a draft). Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the timesheet lifecycle.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to the worker's compensation for this timesheet period. Supports multi-currency payroll processing for global agency operations.

attributes.name: holiday_hours
attributes.description: Total hours worked on public holidays within this pay period, as determined by the jurisdiction-specific holiday calendar. Used for holiday pay premium calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); EU Working Time Directive

attributes.name: is_amended
attributes.description: Indicates whether this timesheet is an amendment to a previously approved timesheet. Amended timesheets trigger payroll adjustment processing and client billing correction workflows.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: is_late_submission
attributes.description: Indicates whether the timesheet was submitted after the defined deadline for the pay period. Used for compliance monitoring, payroll delay risk management, and manager escalation workflows.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; 4As Agency Operations Standards

attributes.name: jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The regulatory jurisdiction governing overtime rules, holiday calendars, and labor law compliance for this timesheet. Typically an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code or a state/province code (e.g., US-CA, GB, DE). Determines which overtime thresholds and holiday schedules apply.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); EU Working Time Directive; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the timesheet record was most recently updated. Tracks the full edit history anchor for change data capture (CDC) in the Databricks silver layer pipeline.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; GDPR Article 5 (data integrity and accountability)

attributes.name: non_billable_hours
attributes.description: Total hours within this timesheet classified as non-billable (internal meetings, training, admin, business development). Used for overhead cost analysis and FTE utilization benchmarking.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; 4As Agency Operations Standards

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Total overtime hours recorded in this timesheet, calculated per applicable jurisdiction-specific overtime rules. Drives overtime pay calculations in payroll and flags capacity issues in resource planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); EU Working Time Directive

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period covered by this timesheet. Together with pay_period_start_date defines the billing and payroll window.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period covered by this timesheet. Used to align time entries with payroll cycles and client billing periods.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: pay_period_type
attributes.description: The frequency classification of the pay period covered by this timesheet. Determines payroll processing cadence and aligns with Workday HCM payroll group configurations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver when rejecting a timesheet. Null for approved or pending timesheets. Used for worker feedback and compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the worker formally submitted the timesheet for approval. Used for compliance tracking against submission deadlines and late-submission reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; ANA Agency Compliance Guidelines

attributes.name: submission_method
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the timesheet was submitted. Supports audit and system integration analysis. Values: web (Workday web portal), mobile (Workday mobile app), api (programmatic submission via API integration), manual_entry (back-office data entry).

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the worker submitted the timesheet. Provides audit trail for SLA compliance and payroll cut-off adherence.

attributes.name: timesheet_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for the timesheet, used in payroll processing, client billing, and audit references. Formatted as TS-{YYYY}-{NNNNNN}.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; IAB Billing Standards

attributes.name: total_hours
attributes.description: Sum of all hours recorded across all time entries within this timesheet for the pay period. Used as the header-level control total for payroll processing and utilization reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act)

attributes.name: utilization_rate
attributes.description: The ratio of billable hours to total hours for this timesheet period (billable_hours / total_hours). A key FTE productivity KPI used in agency capacity planning, QBR reporting, and resource optimization. Stored as a decimal (e.g., 0.7500 = 75%).
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Standards; ANA Agency Performance Benchmarks

attributes.name: wip_code
attributes.description: The Work in Progress (WIP) accounting code associated with this timesheet for financial reconciliation. Used in SAP S/4HANA project accounting to track unbilled labor costs against active client engagements.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA PS (Project System); 4As Agency Financial Standards

attributes.name: worker_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the worker at the timesheet header level to provide context for the pay period's time allocation. May include project status updates, absence explanations, or billing clarifications.

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the worker submitting the timesheet. Determines applicable overtime rules, billing rates, and payroll processing logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: fte|freelancer|contractor|influencer|actor|photographer|director|production_crew — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; FLSA (Fair Labor Standards Act); IR35 (UK Contractor Regulations)

products.name: payroll_record
products.description: Processed payroll records for FTE and contractor workers — including gross pay, net pay, deductions, tax withholdings, benefits contributions, pay period, pay date, payment method, and payroll run status. Sourced from Workday HCM Payroll module. SSOT for compensation disbursement history.

attributes.name: payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each processed payroll record in the Workday HCM Payroll module. Primary key for the payroll_record data product. TRANSACTION_HEADER role — canonical entity for compensation disbursement history.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Labor cost allocation: Payroll costs must be allocated to cost centers for departmental P&L reporting, budget variance analysis, and client billing/cost recovery. Standard practice in advertising agen

attributes.name: original_payroll_record_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the original payroll record that this record corrects or reverses. Null for original records. Enables audit trail reconstruction for payroll corrections and compliance investigations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 404

attributes.name: payroll_run_id
attributes.description: Reference to the payroll run batch that generated this record. A single payroll run processes all eligible workers for a given pay period and company code.

attributes.name: worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the worker (FTE employee, freelancer, contractor, actor, photographer, director, or production crew member) for whom this payroll record was processed. Links to the talent/worker master record in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: bank_account_last4
attributes.description: Last four digits of the worker's bank account number to which direct deposit was made. Stored for reconciliation and worker inquiry resolution without exposing full account details. Full account data is managed in Workday HCM.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; PCI DSS; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: base_pay_amount
attributes.description: The fixed salary or hourly wage component of gross pay for the pay period, excluding variable compensation such as overtime, bonuses, and commissions. Used for FTE cost benchmarking and P&L labor cost analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: benefits_deduction_amount
attributes.description: Total employee-paid benefits contributions deducted in this pay period, including health insurance premiums, dental, vision, life insurance, and flexible spending account (FSA) contributions. Sourced from Workday HCM Benefits module elections.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Benefits Module; IRS Section 125

attributes.name: bonus_amount
attributes.description: Discretionary or performance-based bonus payment included in this pay period disbursement. May reflect campaign performance bonuses, new business win incentives, or annual performance awards tied to KPI achievement.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Variable compensation earned based on sales or account revenue performance, included in this pay period. Applicable to account managers and business development staff whose compensation includes commission on client billings or new business.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA CO

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this payroll record was first created in the Workday HCM Payroll module. RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED field for the TRANSACTION_HEADER. Formatted as yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX per platform convention.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts in this payroll record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency payroll processing for international talent and production crews.

attributes.name: employer_tax_contribution
attributes.description: Total employer-side payroll tax obligations for this worker in this pay period, including employer FICA (Social Security and Medicare match) and FUTA/SUTA contributions. Used for total labor cost reporting in SAP S/4HANA CO.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA CO; IRS Publication 15

attributes.name: federal_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of federal income tax withheld from the worker's gross pay in this pay period. Calculated based on the worker's W-4 elections and applicable IRS tax tables. Required for IRS Form W-2 and 941 reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 15; IRS Form 941

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI general ledger account code for the payroll expense posting. Maps payroll disbursements to the correct expense accounts in the agency's chart of accounts for financial reporting.

attributes.name: gross_pay_amount
attributes.description: Total compensation earned by the worker before any deductions, taxes, or withholdings for the pay period. Includes base salary/wages, overtime, bonuses, commissions, and allowances. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET for this transaction.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA CO; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: hours_worked
attributes.description: Total regular hours worked by the worker during the pay period as recorded in Workday HCM Time Tracking or Workfront resource management. Used for hourly rate reconciliation, project cost allocation, and FLSA compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; Workfront Resource Planning; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: is_off_cycle
attributes.description: Indicates whether this payroll record was generated as part of an off-cycle payroll run (e.g., termination pay, correction run, bonus payout) rather than the standard scheduled payroll cycle. Off-cycle runs require additional approval in Workday HCM.

attributes.name: medicare_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee portion of Medicare (HI) tax withheld in this pay period, including the Additional Medicare Tax for high earners where applicable. Required for IRS Form W-2 reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 15; Affordable Care Act

attributes.name: net_pay_amount
attributes.description: The take-home amount disbursed to the worker after all deductions, tax withholdings, and benefits contributions have been subtracted from gross pay. Represents the actual cash transferred to the worker. Core component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA FI; GAAP ASC 420

attributes.name: overtime_hours
attributes.description: Number of hours worked beyond the standard scheduled hours in the pay period that qualify for overtime pay. Sourced from Workday HCM Time Tracking. Required for FLSA compliance and production cost reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Time Tracking; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: overtime_pay_amount
attributes.description: Compensation paid for hours worked beyond the standard work schedule in the pay period. Relevant for production crews, shoot days, and campaign crunch periods. Tracked separately for FLSA compliance and project cost allocation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: pay_date
attributes.description: The actual date on which compensation was disbursed to the worker. This is the BUSINESS_EVENT_TIMESTAMP (date-precision) for the payroll transaction — the real-world event date when funds were released.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: pay_frequency
attributes.description: The cadence at which the worker is paid. Drives payroll run scheduling and annualization of compensation figures for P&L reporting and FTE cost analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: pay_period_end_date
attributes.description: The last calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll record. Defines the closing boundary of the earnings window.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: pay_period_start_date
attributes.description: The first calendar date of the pay period covered by this payroll record. Together with pay_period_end_date, defines the earnings window for gross pay calculation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: pay_rate
attributes.description: The worker's compensation rate applicable for this pay period — expressed as hourly rate for non-exempt workers or as the annualized salary divided by pay periods for exempt employees. Sourced from Workday HCM Compensation module.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Module; Fair Labor Standards Act (FLSA)

attributes.name: pay_rate_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the worker's compensation is structured as an hourly rate, fixed salary, daily rate (common for freelancers and production crew), or project-based flat rate. Determines how pay_rate is applied to calculate base_pay_amount.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Module; IAB Talent Standards

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: The mechanism by which net pay was disbursed to the worker. Direct deposit is standard for FTE employees; wire transfer may be used for international contractors and production talent.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: payroll_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this payroll record, formatted as PR-{YYYY}-{MM}-{sequence}. Used for reconciliation with SAP S/4HANA FI/CO postings and Mediaocean Prisma billing reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: payroll_run_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this payroll record within the payroll processing workflow. Tracks progression from initial calculation through final disbursement or reversal. LIFECYCLE_STATUS for this TRANSACTION_HEADER entity.

attributes.name: retirement_contribution_amount
attributes.description: Employee pre-tax or Roth retirement plan contribution (e.g., 401(k), 403(b)) deducted from gross pay in this pay period. Tracked separately from other benefits deductions for IRS Form W-2 Box 12 reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 560; ERISA

attributes.name: reversal_indicator
attributes.description: Flags whether this payroll record represents a reversal of a previously processed payroll disbursement. Reversals occur due to overpayments, incorrect bank details, or payroll corrections. Linked to the original record via original_payroll_record_id.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: social_security_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Employee portion of Social Security (OASDI) tax withheld in this pay period. Calculated at the statutory rate on wages up to the annual wage base. Required for IRS Form W-2 reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 15; Social Security Act

attributes.name: state_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Amount of state income tax withheld from the worker's gross pay in this pay period. Varies by state of employment. Relevant for agencies with multi-state operations and talent working across production locations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; State Tax Authorities

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_code
attributes.description: The primary tax jurisdiction code applicable to this payroll record, identifying the state/locality combination for tax withholding purposes. Critical for agencies with talent working across multiple states and production locations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Publication 15; State Tax Authorities

attributes.name: total_deductions_amount
attributes.description: Aggregate of all pre-tax and post-tax deductions applied in this pay period, including benefits contributions, garnishments, and voluntary deductions. Represents the adjustment component of the MONETARY_TRIPLET (gross_pay_amount minus total_deductions_amount yields net_pay_amount).
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp of the most recent modification to this payroll record in the Workday HCM Payroll module. RECORD_AUDIT_UPDATED field for the TRANSACTION_HEADER. Tracks corrections, status changes, and reversals.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; SOX Section 404; GDPR Article 5

attributes.name: worker_type
attributes.description: Classification of the worker receiving this payroll disbursement. Determines applicable tax withholding rules, benefits eligibility, and payment processing logic. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: FTE|contractor|freelancer|influencer|actor|photographer|director|production_crew — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; IRS Publication 15; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: ytd_gross_pay
attributes.description: Cumulative gross pay earned by the worker from the start of the calendar year through this pay period. Required for W-2 preparation, Social Security wage base tracking, and annual compensation reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Form W-2

attributes.name: ytd_tax_withheld
attributes.description: Cumulative total of all federal, state, and local taxes withheld from the worker's pay from the start of the calendar year through this pay period. Required for W-2 preparation and tax reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Payroll Module; IRS Form W-2

products.name: acquisition
products.description: Recruitment and hiring pipeline records — including requisition details, job posting channels, candidate pipeline stage, hiring manager, target start date, offer status, compensation offered, and source of hire. Sourced from Workday HCM Talent Acquisition (Recruiting) module. Tracks open headcount from requisition through onboarding.

attributes.name: acquisition_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each talent acquisition (recruiting) record in the Workday HCM Talent Acquisition module. Primary key for the talent_acquisition data product.

attributes.name: candidate_id
attributes.description: Reference to the candidate profile record associated with this talent acquisition pipeline entry. Links to the candidate master record in the talent domain.

attributes.name: hiring_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.org_unit. Business justification: Talent acquisition requisition is for a position within a specific organizational unit. One requisition targets one org_unit; one org_unit can have many requisitions over time. This links the recruitm

attributes.name: requisition_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent job requisition that initiated this talent acquisition record. Links to the requisition that authorized the open headcount.

attributes.name: worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal employee record of the hiring manager responsible for this requisition and candidate evaluation.

attributes.name: actual_start_date
attributes.description: Actual date on which the hired employee or contractor commenced their engagement. May differ from target_start_date due to notice periods, background check delays, or onboarding scheduling.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Onboarding; Workfront Resource Planning

attributes.name: agency_fee_pct
attributes.description: Agreed fee percentage of the hired candidate's first-year base salary payable to the external staffing agency upon successful placement. Used for cost-per-hire calculation and vendor cost management.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Vendor Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Module; ANA Procurement Standards

attributes.name: agency_name
attributes.description: Name of the external staffing or executive search agency engaged to source candidates for this requisition, if applicable. Null for direct-sourced or internally recruited positions.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Vendor Management; SAP S/4HANA MM Module

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Date on which the candidate submitted their application for the position. Marks the entry point of the candidate into the recruiting pipeline for this requisition.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Candidate Application; GDPR Article 13

attributes.name: approved_headcount_count
attributes.description: Number of approved positions authorized under this requisition. Most requisitions are for a single hire, but bulk requisitions for production crews, campaign teams, or seasonal staff may authorize multiple hires.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Requisition; SAP S/4HANA PS Module

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Current status of the pre-employment background screening process for the candidate. Required for compliance with agency client contracts and regulatory requirements. Blocks onboarding until Passed or Waived.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Onboarding; FTC Background Check Compliance; FCRA

attributes.name: compensation_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the offered compensation amounts. Required for multi-currency agencies operating across global markets. Examples: USD, GBP, EUR.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this talent acquisition record was first created in the Workday HCM system. Serves as the audit trail creation marker and is used for data lineage and pipeline velocity reporting.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: decline_reason
attributes.description: Reason recorded when a candidate declines an offer or is rejected during the pipeline. Examples include 'Compensation Below Expectation', 'Accepted Competing Offer', 'Skills Mismatch', 'Culture Fit'. Used for pipeline quality analysis and offer competitiveness benchmarking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Compensation Below Expectation|Accepted Competing Offer|Skills Mismatch|Culture Fit|Role Changed|Candidate Withdrew|Failed Assessment — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Disposition; 4As Talent Acquisition Best Practices

attributes.name: employment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the engagement type for the open position. FTE (Full-Time Equivalent) indicates a permanent headcount addition; Freelancer and Contractor indicate project-based or time-limited engagements common in advertising production and campaign delivery.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Worker Type; ANA Workforce Standards; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: headcount_type
attributes.description: Classification of whether this requisition represents a replacement for a departing employee (Backfill), a net-new addition to the team (New Headcount), a conversion from contractor to FTE (Conversion), or a role upgrade/reclassification (Upgrade). Drives budget approval workflows.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Headcount Planning; SAP S/4HANA PS Module

attributes.name: interview_rounds_count
attributes.description: Total number of interview rounds completed for this candidate on this requisition. Used to measure interview process efficiency and candidate experience quality.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting; 4As Talent Acquisition Best Practices

attributes.name: is_remote_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the position is eligible for fully remote or hybrid work arrangements. Relevant for talent pool expansion and workforce flexibility planning in the advertising industry.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Requisition; ANA Workforce Standards

attributes.name: job_family
attributes.description: Broad functional grouping of the role within the agency's workforce taxonomy. Examples include 'Creative', 'Media', 'Account Management', 'Analytics', 'Technology', 'Finance', 'Talent'. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Creative|Media|Account Management|Analytics|Technology|Finance|Talent|Strategy|Production|Operations — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Family; 4As Workforce Classification

attributes.name: job_level
attributes.description: Seniority level of the open position within the agency's career framework. Drives compensation banding, approval workflows, and resource planning capacity calculations. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Junior|Mid-Level|Senior|Lead|Manager|Director|VP|C-Suite — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Level; 4As Compensation Benchmarking

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title for the open position as defined in the requisition. Examples include 'Senior Media Planner', 'Creative Director', 'Programmatic Campaign Manager', 'Account Executive'.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Profile; 4As Workforce Classification

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this talent acquisition record in the Workday HCM system. Used for incremental data extraction (ETL) and audit trail compliance.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: offer_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal employment offer was extended to the candidate. Used to calculate offer-to-acceptance cycle time and to track offer expiry.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Offer Management; 4As Talent Acquisition Metrics

attributes.name: offer_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date by which the candidate must accept or decline the offer. After this date, the offer is automatically rescinded if no response is received.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Offer Management; 4As Talent Acquisition Best Practices

attributes.name: offer_status
attributes.description: Current status of the employment offer extended to the candidate. Tracks the offer lifecycle from issuance through acceptance or decline. Critical for headcount forecasting and onboarding planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Offer Management; 4As Talent Acquisition Best Practices

attributes.name: offered_base_salary
attributes.description: Annual base salary amount offered to the candidate in the employment offer. Expressed in the local currency of the office location. Sensitive compensation data used in offer approval workflows and P&L headcount cost planning.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; 4As Compensation Benchmarking

attributes.name: offered_bonus_target_pct
attributes.description: Target annual bonus as a percentage of base salary included in the offer. Reflects the variable compensation component of the total compensation package offered to the candidate.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation; SAP S/4HANA FI Module; 4As Compensation Benchmarking

attributes.name: pipeline_stage
attributes.description: Current stage of the candidate in the recruiting pipeline as tracked in Workday HCM. Represents the candidate's progression from application through onboarding. Drives recruiter workflow and hiring velocity reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Applied|Screening|Interview|Assessment|Offer|Onboarding|Withdrawn|Rejected — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Recruiting Stage; 4As Talent Acquisition Best Practices

attributes.name: posting_channel
attributes.description: Primary external channel on which the job was posted to attract candidates. Examples include 'LinkedIn', 'Indeed', 'Glassdoor', 'Agency Website', 'Industry Boards (4As, ANA)'. Distinct from source_of_hire which tracks where the hired candidate originated. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LinkedIn|Indeed|Glassdoor|Agency Website|4As Job Board|ANA Job Board|Campus Portal|Internal Portal — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Job Posting; IAB Workforce Standards

attributes.name: recruiter_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal recruiter or talent acquisition specialist assigned to manage this requisition and candidate pipeline. Used for workload distribution and recruiter performance reporting.

attributes.name: requisition_close_date
attributes.description: Date on which the requisition was formally closed, either because the position was filled, cancelled, or put on indefinite hold. Used to calculate time-to-fill metrics.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Requisition; 4As Talent Acquisition Metrics

attributes.name: requisition_number
attributes.description: Externally visible, human-readable requisition number assigned by Workday HCM at the time the job requisition is created. Used in communications with candidates, agencies, and job boards.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Talent Acquisition Module; IAB Workforce Standards

attributes.name: requisition_open_date
attributes.description: Date on which the job requisition was formally opened and approved for recruiting. Used as the start point for time-to-fill and time-to-hire KPI calculations.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Requisition; 4As Talent Acquisition Metrics

attributes.name: requisition_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the job requisition. Tracks whether the headcount need is actively being recruited against, paused, or resolved. Used in open headcount reporting and budget reconciliation.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Requisition Status; SAP S/4HANA PS Module

attributes.name: salary_band_max
attributes.description: Maximum of the approved compensation band for this job level and family. Used to validate that the offered salary falls within the approved range and to support pay equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; 4As Compensation Benchmarking; EEOC Pay Equity Guidelines

attributes.name: salary_band_min
attributes.description: Minimum of the approved compensation band for this job level and family. Used to validate that the offered salary falls within the approved range and to support pay equity analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compensation Grade; 4As Compensation Benchmarking; EEOC Pay Equity Guidelines

attributes.name: source_of_hire
attributes.description: Channel or method through which the candidate was sourced. Examples include 'LinkedIn', 'Employee Referral', 'Agency', 'Job Board', 'Direct Application', 'Campus Recruiting'. Used to measure recruiting channel effectiveness and cost-per-hire by source. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: LinkedIn|Employee Referral|Staffing Agency|Job Board|Direct Application|Campus Recruiting|Internal Transfer|Social Media — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Workday HCM Source of Hire; ANA Talent Sourcing Standards

attributes.name: target_start_date
attributes.description: Planned date on which the hired candidate is expected to begin employment. Used for onboarding scheduling, resource capacity planning in Workfront, and campaign staffing alignment.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Onboarding; Workfront Resource Planning

attributes.name: work_authorization_status
attributes.description: Candidate's legal authorization to work in the country of the office location. Determines whether visa sponsorship is required and impacts time-to-start planning. Relevant for global advertising agencies with international talent pools.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Compliance; USCIS I-9 Compliance; GDPR Article 9

products.name: usage_right
products.description: Rights and licensing records governing how talent (actors, models, photographers, directors, influencers) and their creative output may be used — including usage type (broadcast, digital, OOH, social, print), territory/market, exclusivity scope, usage period start/end, fee structure, buyout vs. residual payment terms, rights clearance status, and renewal/extension history. Tracks the full lifecycle from initial grant through renewals and expirations. Critical for compliance with talent union agreements (SAG-AFTRA, ACTRA, BECTU) and influencer contracts. Unauthorized usage triggers significant financial penalties.

attributes.name: usage_right_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the usage right record. Primary key for the usage_right data product within the talent domain.

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent talent contract or Statement of Work (SOW) under which this usage right was granted. Links to the contract data product in the Contract domain.
attributes.references: 4As Standard Contract Terms; IAB Talent Rights Framework

attributes.name: brand_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand.brand_profile. Business justification: Usage rights are granted for specific brand identities, not just campaigns. Critical for brand compliance checks, exclusivity enforcement across brand portfolios, and rights clearance workflows. Adver

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising campaign for which this usage right was acquired. Enables campaign-level rights compliance tracking and reporting.
attributes.references: Google Campaign Manager 360; IAB Campaign Standards

attributes.name: conversion_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to performance.conversion_event. Business justification: Supports talent performance attribution—measuring which on-screen talent (actors, influencers) drive conversions to justify usage rights investments and inform renewal/rate negotiations. Standard ROI

attributes.name: creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific creative asset (advertisement, photograph, video, audio recording) to which this usage right applies. Links to the creative domain asset registry.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud DAM; Workfront DAM; IAB Digital Asset Standards

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Usage rights are often negotiated within SOW scope; proper FK enables tracking which SOW governs talent usage rights, critical for rights clearance workflows, compliance audits, and ensuring usage ter

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Usage rights for talent (actors, influencers, models) are negotiated through and managed by vendor suppliers (talent agencies, rights management firms). Critical for rights clearance workflows, paymen

attributes.name: workday_worker_id
attributes.description: The Workday HCM system worker identifier for the talent, enabling integration between the usage rights record and the talent's HR, payroll, and time-tracking records in Workday. Supports residual payment processing through the payroll module.
attributes.references: Workday HCM Core HR; Workday Payroll Integration Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: The name or identifier of the business affairs manager, legal counsel, or authorized agency representative who formally approved and cleared this usage right. Provides audit trail for rights clearance accountability.
attributes.references: 4As Business Affairs Best Practices; ANA Talent Rights Governance

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out_status
attributes.description: The California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) opt-out status for the talent's personal data usage in California-targeted campaigns. 'opted_in' permits use; 'opted_out' restricts use of personal data for California audiences; 'not_applicable' for non-California markets.
attributes.references: CCPA California Civil Code Section 1798.100; FTC Privacy Regulations; NAI Compliance Standards

attributes.name: clearance_date
attributes.description: The date on which the usage right was formally cleared by the legal or business affairs team, confirming all contractual and union obligations have been satisfied and the creative asset may be deployed.
attributes.references: 4As Business Affairs Best Practices; ANA Rights Clearance Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this usage right record was first created in the system. Corresponds to the MASTER_AGREEMENT RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category. Supports data lineage, audit trails, and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); 4As Data Governance Standards; Workday HCM Audit Trail

attributes.name: exclusivity_category
attributes.description: The product or service category within which exclusivity applies when exclusivity_scope is 'category_exclusive' (e.g., 'automotive', 'financial services', 'consumer packaged goods'). Null when exclusivity_scope is 'exclusive' or 'non_exclusive'.
attributes.references: 4As Standard Talent Contract Terms; ANA Talent Rights Best Practices

attributes.name: exclusivity_scope
attributes.description: Defines whether the usage right is exclusive to this agency/client, non-exclusive (talent may appear in competing campaigns), or category-exclusive (exclusive within a specific product/service category). Exclusive rights typically command higher fees and restrict talent from competitor engagements.
attributes.references: 4As Standard Talent Contract Terms; ANA Talent Rights Best Practices; SAG-AFTRA Exclusivity Provisions

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: The agreed monetary fee paid to the talent or their representative for this usage right grant. For buyout structures, this is the total one-time fee. For residual structures, this is the base session fee. Expressed in the currency specified by fee_currency_code.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Scale Rates; ACTRA Fee Schedules; BECTU Rate Cards; 4As Financial Reconciliation Standards

attributes.name: fee_currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the fee amount (e.g., 'USD', 'GBP', 'EUR', 'CAD'). Required for multi-territory rights where fees may be denominated in local currency.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Management

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_obtained
attributes.description: Indicates whether explicit GDPR-compliant consent has been obtained from the talent for processing and using their personal data (including likeness, voice, and biometric data) in the specified territories. Mandatory for EU/EEA market usage.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6 and Article 9; EASA Cross-Border Advertising Standards; IAB Europe Consent Framework

attributes.name: influencer_disclosure_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether the talent (influencer) is contractually and regulatorily required to disclose the paid/sponsored nature of content under FTC Endorsement Guidelines or ASA CAP Code. Applicable primarily when talent_role is 'influencer'. Critical for regulatory compliance.
attributes.references: FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255; ASA CAP Code Section 2; EASA Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: is_perpetual
attributes.description: Indicates whether this usage right is granted in perpetuity with no expiration date. When True, rights_end_date should be null. Perpetual rights are typically associated with full buyout arrangements and carry higher upfront fees.
attributes.references: 4As Standard Talent Contract Terms; ANA Talent Rights Best Practices

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this usage right record was most recently modified, including status changes, renewals, fee updates, or clearance decisions. Supports change tracking and audit compliance.

attributes.name: original_grant_date
attributes.description: The date on which the usage right was first granted, regardless of subsequent renewals or extensions. Provides the anchor point for tracking the full lifecycle of the rights relationship with the talent.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Contract Administration; 4As Talent Rights Lifecycle Management

attributes.name: payment_structure
attributes.description: The fee arrangement governing talent compensation for this usage right. 'buyout' means a one-time payment granting unlimited use within agreed scope; 'residual' means ongoing payments per use cycle per union scale; 'session_fee' means payment for the recording session only with limited use; 'hybrid' combines upfront buyout with residual obligations for certain use categories.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Residuals Schedule; ACTRA Payment Terms; BECTU Fee Structures; 4As Talent Compensation Standards

attributes.name: penalty_amount
attributes.description: The contractually stipulated financial penalty payable to the talent or their union if the usage right is violated (e.g., unauthorized use beyond territory, media type, or expiry date). Expressed in fee_currency_code. Critical for financial risk management and compliance monitoring.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Liquidated Damages Provisions; ACTRA Penalty Schedule; 4As Risk Management Standards

attributes.name: platform_restrictions
attributes.description: Specific digital platforms or media outlets explicitly excluded from or restricted within this usage right (e.g., 'no TikTok', 'YouTube only', 'no competitor-owned media'). Null if no platform-specific restrictions apply beyond the usage_type classification.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Platform Standards; 4As Digital Rights Management Guidelines; NAI Platform Compliance

attributes.name: renewal_count
attributes.description: The number of times this usage right has been renewed or extended since the original grant. Tracks the full renewal history lifecycle and informs cumulative cost analysis and talent relationship management.
attributes.references: 4As Standard Talent Contract Terms; Workday HCM Contract Tracking

attributes.name: renewal_option_deadline
attributes.description: The date by which the agency must exercise the renewal option to extend the usage right period. Missing this deadline forfeits the renewal option and may require renegotiation at potentially higher rates. Critical for proactive rights management.
attributes.references: 4As Standard Talent Contract Terms; SAG-AFTRA Option Period Provisions; ANA Talent Rights Best Practices

attributes.name: renewal_option_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the contract includes an option to renew or extend the usage right period beyond the original rights_end_date. When True, renewal_option_deadline and renewal_fee_amount should be populated.
attributes.references: 4As Standard Talent Contract Terms; SAG-AFTRA Option Period Provisions

attributes.name: residual_rate
attributes.description: The per-use or per-cycle residual payment rate applicable when payment_structure is 'residual' or 'hybrid'. Expressed as a monetary amount per broadcast cycle or as a percentage of the original session fee per union scale. Null for pure buyout arrangements.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Residuals Schedule; ACTRA Residual Payment Terms; BECTU Repeat Fee Structures

attributes.name: right_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier for this usage right, used in correspondence with talent unions, legal teams, and talent agencies. Follows the agency's internal rights numbering convention (e.g., UR-2024-00123).
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Contract Administration; ACTRA Rights Management; 4As Standard Practices

attributes.name: right_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the usage right. 'active' indicates rights are cleared and in use; 'pending_clearance' indicates awaiting legal or union approval; 'expired' indicates the usage period has lapsed; 'suspended' indicates rights are temporarily halted pending dispute resolution; 'renewed' indicates an extension has been executed; 'terminated' indicates rights have been revoked or cancelled.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Residuals and Rights Administration; ACTRA Usage Rights Guidelines; BECTU Talent Agreements

attributes.name: rights_clearance_status
attributes.description: The legal clearance status of this usage right as determined by the agency's legal or business affairs team. 'cleared' indicates all rights have been legally verified and approved for use; 'pending' indicates clearance is in progress; 'rejected' indicates rights could not be cleared; 'under_review' indicates a dispute or ambiguity is being resolved.
attributes.references: 4As Business Affairs Best Practices; ANA Rights Clearance Standards; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: rights_end_date
attributes.description: The date on which the usage right expires and the talent's likeness or creative output must be withdrawn from all specified media and territories. Null for perpetual buyout rights. Corresponds to the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_UNTIL category. Critical for compliance monitoring to prevent unauthorized usage.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Contract Administration; ACTRA Usage Period Definitions; 4As Standard Contract Terms

attributes.name: rights_start_date
attributes.description: The date on which the usage right becomes effective and the talent's likeness or creative output may legally be used in the specified media and territory. Corresponds to the MASTER_AGREEMENT EFFECTIVE_FROM category.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Contract Administration; ACTRA Usage Period Definitions; 4As Standard Contract Terms

attributes.name: talent_role
attributes.description: The professional role or category of the talent whose rights are being managed. Determines applicable union agreements, rate scales, and rights clearance requirements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: actor|model|photographer|director|influencer|voice_talent|musician|dancer|stunt_performer|extra|presenter — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Performer Categories; ACTRA Talent Classifications; Workday HCM Job Classifications

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code(s) or region designator indicating the geographic market(s) where the usage right is valid. Multiple territories may be pipe-delimited (e.g., 'USA|CAN|GBR'). 'WW' denotes worldwide rights. Critical for determining applicable union agreements and residual payment obligations.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; SAG-AFTRA International Use Provisions; ACTRA Territorial Rights; EASA Cross-Border Advertising Standards

attributes.name: union_agreement_code
attributes.description: The talent union or guild agreement governing this usage right and its associated payment obligations. Determines applicable scale rates, residual schedules, and usage restrictions. 'NON-UNION' indicates talent not covered by a collective bargaining agreement.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Collective Bargaining Agreement; ACTRA ICA; BECTU Agreements; 4As Union Compliance Standards

attributes.name: union_contract_number
attributes.description: The specific union contract or signatory agreement number under which this usage right is administered. Required for SAG-AFTRA, ACTRA, and BECTU residual reporting and audit compliance. Null for non-union talent.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Contract Administration; ACTRA ICA Administration; BECTU Contract Registry

attributes.name: usage_limitation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any specific usage restrictions, conditions, or limitations not captured in structured fields (e.g., 'talent must be credited', 'no political advertising use', 'no alteration of likeness permitted', 'must not be used in conjunction with alcohol brands').
attributes.references: 4As Business Affairs Best Practices; FTC Endorsement Guidelines; ASA Advertising Standards

attributes.name: usage_period_months
attributes.description: The total duration of the usage right period expressed in months, calculated from rights_start_date to rights_end_date. Used for residual cycle calculations, budget forecasting, and rights expiry alerting.
attributes.references: SAG-AFTRA Residuals Schedule; ACTRA Usage Period Definitions

attributes.name: usage_subtype
attributes.description: Granular classification within the usage type, specifying the exact format or placement (e.g., 'pre-roll video', 'banner display', 'story ad', 'billboard static', 'magazine full-page'). Provides precision for rights clearance and union residual calculations.
attributes.references: IAB Ad Format Taxonomy; SAG-AFTRA Use Category Definitions; MRC Digital Measurement Standards

attributes.name: usage_type
attributes.description: The media channel or format category for which the talent's likeness or creative output may be used. Broadcast covers TV and streaming; digital covers online display and video; OOH (Out-of-Home) covers billboards and transit; social covers social media platforms; print covers magazines and newspapers; radio covers audio-only placements. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: broadcast|digital|ooh|social|print|radio|cinema|podcast|dooh|ctv — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Media Channel Taxonomy; MRC Media Measurement Standards; SAG-AFTRA Use Category Definitions

products.name: capacity_plan
products.description: Forward-looking workforce capacity plans by team, discipline, or department — including planned headcount, available FTE-equivalent hours, forecasted demand from pipeline campaigns and confirmed SOWs, capacity gap or surplus analysis, planning period (weekly/monthly/quarterly), plan version, and scenario modeling (best case, expected, worst case). Supports resource planning for new business pitches, campaign ramp-ups, bench management, and freelancer pool sizing. Key input to finance for revenue forecasting, margin planning, and utilization target setting.
products.reference: Workfront Resource Planning / Agency Capacity Model

attributes.name: capacity_plan_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for the capacity plan record. Primary key for the capacity_plan data product in the talent domain.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Resource Planning; Workfront - Resource Management

attributes.name: org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the specific team or squad within the department for which capacity is being planned (e.g., Brand Creative Team, Programmatic Buying Team). More granular than department.
attributes.references: Workfront - Resource Planning; Workday HCM - Talent Management

attributes.name: primary_capacity_org_unit_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the agency department or business unit for which this capacity plan is prepared (e.g., Creative, Media, Strategy, Account Management, Production). Links to the organizational hierarchy.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Core HR; SAP S/4HANA - CO Cost Center

attributes.name: primary_capacity_worker_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the employee (typically a Resource Manager, Department Head, or Operations Lead) responsible for authoring, maintaining, and approving this capacity plan. Maps to Workday HCM worker record.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Core HR; Workfront - Resource Planning

attributes.name: workfront_plan_id
attributes.description: External reference identifier for the corresponding resource plan record in Workfront Resource Planning module. Enables bi-directional synchronization between the lakehouse silver layer and the operational system of record.

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the capacity plan was formally approved by the designated approver. Nullable until plan status transitions to approved.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Workforce Planning; SAP S/4HANA - CO Controlling

attributes.name: available_hours
attributes.description: Total available productive hours across all planned FTE-equivalent resources for the planning period, net of holidays, PTO, and non-billable overhead. Primary supply-side metric for capacity gap analysis.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Time Tracking; Workfront - Resource Planning

attributes.name: campaign_pipeline_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of pipeline campaign or pitch identifiers whose forecasted resource demand is incorporated into this capacity plan. Links capacity planning to new business development activity.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; Workfront - Project Management

attributes.name: capacity_gap_hours
attributes.description: Net difference between available_hours and forecasted_demand_hours for the planning period. Negative values indicate a capacity shortfall requiring freelancer augmentation or scope negotiation; positive values indicate surplus bench capacity.
attributes.references: Workday HCM - Workforce Planning; Workfront - Resource Planning; 4As Resource Planning Guidelines

attributes.name: confirmed_demand_hours
attributes.description: Hours of resource demand backed by signed SOWs, confirmed Insertion Orders (IOs), or approved campaign briefs. Subset of forecasted_demand_hours representing firm commitments, used for conservative capacity planning.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma - Buying; Salesforce CRM - Service Cloud; IAB IO Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this capacity plan record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 - Data Integrity; IAB Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which labor_cost_budget and related financial figures are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency agency operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA - FI Financial Accounting

attributes.name: discipline
attributes.description: Functional discipline or craft specialty covered by this capacity plan (e.g., Art Direction, Copywriting, Media Planning, Data Analytics, Account Management, Production, UX Design). Aligns with Workday HCM job families. attributes.name: freelancer_hours_planned

attributes.name: freelancer_pool_size

attributes.name: fte_headcount_contractor

attributes.name: fte_headcount_permanent

attributes.name: is_new_business_pitch

attributes.name: pipeline_demand_hours

attributes.name: plan_code

attributes.name: plan_end_date

attributes.references: Workday HCM - Workforce Planning; Workfront - Resource Planning

attributes.name: plan_name

attributes.name: plan_notes

attributes.name: plan_start_date

attributes.references: Workday HCM - Workforce Planning; Workfront - Resource Planning

attributes.name: plan_status

attributes.name: plan_version

attributes.name: planned_headcount_fte

attributes.name: planning_period_type

attributes.references: Workday HCM - Workforce Planning; 4As Resource Planning Guidelines

attributes.name: revenue_forecast_amount
attributes.description: Projected revenue attributable to the team/discipline for the planning period, derived from confirmed SOW values and pipeline-weighted opportunities. Used by finance for revenue forecasting and EBITDA planning.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA - CO Controlling; Salesforce CRM - Sales Cloud; ANA Agency Compensation Guidelines

attributes.name: scenario_type
attributes.description: Scenario modeling classification for this capacity plan version — best case (maximum pipeline win rate), expected (most likely outcome), worst case (minimum pipeline conversion), or base (approved baseline). Supports sensitivity analysis for finance margin planning.

attributes.name: sow_reference_ids

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this capacity plan record, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used to detect stale plans and trigger re-approval workflows.

attributes.name: utilization_target_pct
