attributes.description: Timestamp when this attribution model configuration record was last modified.

attributes.name: position_based_first_touch_weight
attributes.description: For position-based (U-shaped) attribution models, the fractional credit weight assigned to the first touchpoint (e.g., 0.4000 for 40%). Null for non-position-based models.

attributes.name: position_based_last_touch_weight
attributes.description: For position-based (U-shaped) attribution models, the fractional credit weight assigned to the last touchpoint (e.g., 0.4000 for 40%). Null for non-position-based models.

attributes.name: position_based_middle_touch_weight
attributes.description: For position-based (U-shaped) attribution models, the fractional credit weight distributed equally among all middle touchpoints (e.g., 0.2000 for 20% total). Null for non-position-based models.

attributes.name: reprocessing_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether historical conversion events within the attribution window need to be reprocessed due to changes in this model configuration.

attributes.name: reprocessing_start_date
attributes.description: The earliest date from which historical conversion events should be reprocessed when model configuration changes. Null if no reprocessing is required.

attributes.name: time_decay_half_life_days
attributes.description: For time-decay attribution models, the number of days at which a touchpoint receives half the credit of the most recent touchpoint. Defines the exponential decay rate. Null for non-time-decay models.

attributes.name: view_through_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days after an impression (view) during which a conversion can be attributed to that impression event, even without a click. Standard values range from 1 to 30 days.
attributes.references: IAB Attribution Standards; MRC Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this attribution model configuration.

products.name: performance_kpi_target
products.description: Operational KPI target record defining the planned performance benchmarks for each campaign, line item, or placement. Stores KPI type (CPM, CPC, CPA, CTR, ROAS, VTR, viewability rate, GRP, SOV), target value, target period, tolerance band (acceptable variance percentage), and source (IO commitment, client brief, internal benchmark). Used for pacing alerts, delivery_pacing comparisons, and client performance reporting. Distinct from finance budgets: this is the performance measurement target, not the financial spend target.

attributes.name: performance_kpi_target_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Performance Key Performance Indicator (KPI) Target Identifier
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the performance KPI target record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the campaign for which this KPI target is defined. Links to the campaign master entity.

attributes.name: io_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_io_line. Business justification: KPI targets often set at IO line level per vendor contracts (guaranteed viewability, CTR floors, completion rates). Needed to track contractual performance guarantees, trigger makegood clauses, and ev

attributes.name: line_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific line item within a media plan or insertion order for which this KPI target applies. Nullable if target is set at campaign or placement level.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: media_placement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific media placement for which this KPI target is defined. Nullable if target is set at campaign or line item level.

attributes.name: alert_enabled
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether automated alerts should be triggered when performance deviates from target thresholds. True = alerts active, False = monitoring only without alerts.

attributes.name: alert_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which performance is evaluated against thresholds and alerts are generated. Real-time for critical KPIs, daily or weekly for less time-sensitive metrics.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who approved this KPI target for activation. Nullable if approval workflow is not required or target is still in draft status.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KPI target was approved for activation. Nullable if approval workflow is not required or target is still in draft status.

attributes.name: attribution_model
attributes.description: The attribution model used for conversion-based KPIs (CPA, ROAS, conversion_rate). Defines how credit is assigned across touchpoints in the customer journey.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KPI target record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: is_contractual_commitment
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this KPI target represents a contractual commitment to the client (typically from Insertion Order or Statement of Work). True = contractual obligation, False = internal goal or aspiration.

attributes.name: kpi_type
attributes.description: The type of performance metric being targeted. CPM = Cost Per Mille (thousand impressions), CPC = Cost Per Click, CPA = Cost Per Acquisition, CTR = Click-Through Rate, ROAS = Return on Ad Spend, VTR = View-Through Rate, GRP = Gross Rating Point, TRP = Target Rating Point, SOV = Share of Voice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: CPM|CPC|CPA|CTR|ROAS|VTR|viewability_rate|GRP|TRP|SOV|conversion_rate|engagement_rate|completion_rate|brand_lift — 14 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Performance Measurement Guidelines; MRC Viewability Standards

attributes.name: lookback_window_days
attributes.description: Number of days after ad exposure during which conversions are attributed to the campaign for conversion-based KPIs. Standard windows are 1, 7, 14, 30, or 90 days.
attributes.references: IAB Attribution Standards; MRC Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: lower_threshold
attributes.description: The minimum acceptable value for this KPI. Performance below this threshold triggers alerts or corrective actions. Calculated as target_value minus tolerance band or set explicitly.

attributes.name: measurement_methodology
attributes.description: Description of how this KPI is measured and calculated, including data sources, attribution models, and calculation logic. Ensures consistency in performance evaluation.
attributes.references: MRC Measurement Standards; IAB Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who last modified this KPI target record. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this KPI target record was last modified. Used for audit trail and change tracking.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, assumptions, or special instructions related to this KPI target. May include client expectations, historical context, or measurement caveats.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Business priority assigned to this KPI target. Critical targets require immediate attention when thresholds are breached; low priority targets are monitored but may not trigger immediate action.

attributes.name: target_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for monetary KPI targets (CPM, CPC, CPA, ROAS). Nullable for non-monetary KPIs.

attributes.name: target_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for this KPI target record, used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: target_period_end_date
attributes.description: The end date of the period for which this KPI target is applicable. Used for time-bound performance measurement and pacing analysis.

attributes.name: target_period_start_date
attributes.description: The start date of the period for which this KPI target is applicable. Used for time-bound performance measurement and pacing analysis.

attributes.name: target_source
attributes.description: The origin or basis for this KPI target. Insertion Order (IO) commitment represents contractual obligation, client brief represents client expectation, internal benchmark represents agency standard, historical average represents past performance baseline.
attributes.references: IAB Insertion Order Standards; Internal Performance Management Standards

attributes.name: target_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the KPI target. Draft = under definition, active = in measurement period, suspended = temporarily paused, achieved = target met, missed = target not met, expired = measurement period ended.

attributes.name: target_unit
attributes.description: The unit of measure for the target value. Currency for cost-based KPIs (CPM, CPC, CPA), percentage for rate-based KPIs (CTR, VTR, viewability_rate), ratio for ROAS, points for GRP/TRP, count for absolute metrics.

attributes.name: target_value
attributes.description: The numeric target value for the specified KPI. Interpretation depends on kpi_type (e.g., dollar amount for CPM/CPC/CPA, percentage for CTR/VTR/viewability_rate, ratio for ROAS, points for GRP/TRP).

attributes.name: tolerance_percentage
attributes.description: Acceptable variance percentage from the target value before triggering alerts or escalations. For example, 10.00 means ±10% from target is acceptable. Used for pacing alerts and performance monitoring.

attributes.name: upper_threshold
attributes.description: The maximum acceptable value for this KPI (relevant for cost-based metrics where exceeding target is negative). Performance above this threshold triggers alerts. Calculated as target_value plus tolerance band or set explicitly.

attributes.name: viewability_standard
attributes.description: The viewability measurement standard applied for viewability_rate KPI targets. MRC standard = 50% of pixels in view for 1 second (display) or 2 seconds (video). GroupM may have stricter requirements.
attributes.references: MRC Viewability Standards; IAB Viewability Guidelines

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the user who created this KPI target record. Used for audit trail and accountability.

products.name: video_completion_event
products.description: Video ad completion event record capturing quartile-level video engagement signals (25%, 50%, 75%, 100% completion) per video ad impression. Stores video ad unit identifier, completion quartile reached, autoplay flag, sound-on flag, skip action (skipped, completed), player size, and VTR (View-Through Rate) computation inputs. Sourced from VAST/VPAID event signals from video ad servers. Supports VTR-based IO commitments and video campaign performance measurement.

attributes.name: video_completion_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the video completion event record. Primary key for this event log entity.
attributes.references: IAB (Interactive Advertising Bureau) Digital Video Guidelines

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the advertising campaign this video completion event belongs to.

attributes.name: creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the video creative asset that was played. Links to the specific video ad unit served.

attributes.name: impression_event_id
attributes.description: Identifier linking this completion event to the parent video ad impression that was served. References the initial ad serving event.

attributes.name: media_placement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the media placement where this video ad was served. Links to the specific inventory position purchased.

attributes.name: publisher_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the publisher or content owner on whose property the video ad was served. Links to the supply-side partner.

attributes.name: ad_server
attributes.description: Name of the ad server platform that served the video ad and captured this completion event (e.g., Google Campaign Manager 360, Innovid, Sizmek). Used for data quality and discrepancy analysis.

attributes.name: browser
attributes.description: Web browser or app environment where the video ad was served (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox, in-app). Null for CTV (Connected TV) and OTT (Over-the-Top) environments.

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the video that was viewed, calculated as (time_to_completion_seconds / video_duration_seconds) * 100. Supports VTR (View-Through Rate) calculation.

attributes.name: completion_quartile
attributes.description: The quartile milestone reached in video playback: start (0%), first_quartile (25%), midpoint (50%), third_quartile (75%), or complete (100%). Used to calculate VTR (View-Through Rate) and engagement depth.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Guidelines; VAST (Video Ad Serving Template) 4.x

attributes.name: connection_type
attributes.description: Type of network connection used during video playback: wifi, cellular (3G/4G/5G), wired (ethernet), or unknown. Impacts video quality and completion rates.

attributes.name: content_category
attributes.description: IAB Content Taxonomy category of the content adjacent to the video ad (e.g., Sports, News, Entertainment). Used for contextual targeting and brand safety verification.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device on which the video ad was viewed: desktop, mobile (smartphone), tablet, CTV (Connected TV), console (gaming console), or other. Critical for cross-device campaign analysis.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Guidelines; IAB Tech Lab Device Type Taxonomy

attributes.name: event_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the video completion event was captured by the ad server or video player, in ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX).

attributes.name: geo_city
attributes.description: City where the video ad was viewed. Used for hyper-local campaign performance analysis and geo-targeting verification.

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code where the video ad was viewed (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN). Used for geo-targeting verification and regional performance analysis.

attributes.name: geo_region
attributes.description: State, province, or region where the video ad was viewed (e.g., California, Ontario, Bavaria). Used for sub-national geo-targeting analysis.

attributes.name: ip_address_hashed
attributes.description: Hashed IP address of the device that viewed the video ad. Used for fraud detection and geo-verification while maintaining privacy compliance.

attributes.name: is_autoplay
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the video ad started playing automatically without user initiation (True) or required user action to start (False). Impacts viewability and engagement quality.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Guidelines; Coalition for Better Ads Standards

attributes.name: is_fullscreen
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the video was playing in fullscreen mode at the time of the completion event (True) or in standard embedded player (False).

attributes.name: is_skipped
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the user actively skipped the video ad before completion (True) or allowed it to play through the recorded quartile (False).

attributes.name: is_sound_on
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the video ad played with sound enabled (True) or muted (False). Critical metric for video engagement quality and IO (Insertion Order) compliance.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Guidelines; MRC (Media Rating Council) Standards

attributes.name: is_viewable
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the video ad met MRC (Media Rating Council) viewability standards at the time of the completion event: 50% of pixels in-view for 2+ consecutive seconds. Used for viewable VTR (View-Through Rate) calculation.
attributes.references: MRC Viewability Standards; IAB Digital Video Guidelines

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system of the device where the video ad was viewed (e.g., iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, tvOS, Roku OS). Used for device-level performance segmentation.

attributes.name: player_height_pixels
attributes.description: Height of the video player in pixels at the time of the completion event. Used for precise viewability and player size analysis.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Guidelines; MRC Viewability Standards

attributes.name: player_size
attributes.description: Size classification of the video player at the time of the event: small (<400x300), medium (400x300 to 640x480), large (>640x480 but not fullscreen), or fullscreen. Impacts viewability measurement.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Guidelines; MRC Viewability Standards

attributes.name: player_width_pixels
attributes.description: Width of the video player in pixels at the time of the completion event. Used for precise viewability and player size analysis.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Guidelines; MRC Viewability Standards

attributes.name: session_code
attributes.description: Identifier for the user browsing or viewing session during which this video completion event occurred. Used for session-level engagement analysis.

attributes.name: site_domain
attributes.description: Domain name of the website or app where the video ad was served (e.g., youtube.com, espn.com). Used for brand safety and contextual analysis.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Video Guidelines; TAG (Trustworthy Accountability Group) Brand Safety Standards

attributes.name: skip_offset_seconds
attributes.description: Number of seconds into the video when the skip button became available to the user. Null if video was non-skippable.

attributes.name: time_to_completion_seconds
attributes.description: Actual elapsed time in seconds from video start to the recorded completion quartile. May differ from video_duration_seconds if user paused, rewound, or fast-forwarded.

attributes.name: user_id_hashed
attributes.description: Hashed or pseudonymized identifier for the user who viewed the video ad. Used for frequency capping and cross-device attribution while maintaining privacy compliance. Must comply with GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) and CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; IAB Tech Lab Privacy Standards

attributes.name: vast_version
attributes.description: Version of the VAST (Video Ad Serving Template) specification used to serve this video ad (e.g., 2.0, 3.0, 4.0, 4.1, 4.2). Indicates ad serving protocol capabilities and tracking fidelity.

attributes.name: video_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the video creative in seconds. Used to calculate completion percentage and time-based engagement metrics.

attributes.name: video_format
attributes.description: Format type of the video ad: linear (pre-roll, mid-roll, post-roll that interrupts content), non_linear (overlay ads that run concurrently with content), or companion (static/rich media ads displayed alongside video).

attributes.name: video_position
attributes.description: Position of the video ad within the content stream: pre_roll (before content), mid_roll (during content), or post_roll (after content). Applies to linear video formats only.

attributes.name: viewable_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the video player that was in the viewable area of the browser viewport at the time of the completion event. Used for granular viewability analysis beyond binary MRC threshold.
attributes.references: MRC Viewability Standards; IAB Digital Video Guidelines

attributes.name: vpaid_version
attributes.description: Version of the VPAID (Video Player-Ad Interface Definition) specification used for interactive video ads (e.g., 1.0, 2.0). Null for standard VAST-only video ads.

products.name: rtb_bid_event
products.description: Real-Time Bidding (RTB) auction participation event record capturing programmatic bid activity from DSP platforms (The Trade Desk, DV360). Stores bid request identifier, auction identifier, bid price (CPM), clearing price, win/loss status, bid rejection reason (floor price, brand safety, frequency cap), supply path details (SSP, publisher, domain, app bundle), audience segment matched, deal identifier (PMP/PG/open auction), and bid strategy parameters applied. Provides the raw programmatic buying event stream for win rate analysis, spend efficiency optimization, supply path transparency (SPO), and auction-level cost reconciliation against impression_event delivery records.

attributes.name: rtb_bid_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the RTB bid event record. Primary key for the bid event entity.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the advertiser client on whose behalf this bid was submitted.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the advertising campaign associated with this bid event.

attributes.name: creative_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the creative asset that would be served if this bid wins the auction.

attributes.name: impression_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to performance.impression_event. Business justification: When an RTB bid wins the auction, an impression is served and recorded as an impression_event. Adding impression_event_id FK (nullable, populated only when win_indicator = true) links the bid event to

attributes.name: line_item_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the media plan line item or insertion order line associated with this bid event.

attributes.name: programmatic_deal_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the programmatic deal if this bid participated in a private marketplace (PMP) or programmatic guaranteed (PG) deal. Null for open auction bids.

attributes.name: publisher_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the publisher or content owner whose inventory is being auctioned. May be SSP-specific or a standardized publisher ID.

attributes.name: app_bundle
attributes.description: The bundle or package name of the mobile application where the ad will be served (e.g., com.cnn.mobile.android). Null for web inventory.

attributes.name: app_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name of the mobile application (e.g., CNN Mobile App). Null for web inventory.

attributes.name: auction_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the programmatic auction instance. Multiple bid events may share the same auction ID when multiple DSPs participate.

attributes.name: audience_segment_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of audience segment IDs that matched this bid request. Represents the targeting criteria applied by the DSP (e.g., demographic, behavioral, contextual segments).

attributes.name: bid_price_cpm
attributes.description: The bid price submitted by the DSP expressed in CPM (cost per thousand impressions). Represents the maximum amount the advertiser is willing to pay for this impression.

attributes.name: bid_request_reference
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the bid request received from the SSP or ad exchange. Links this bid event to the originating auction request.

attributes.name: bid_response_time_ms
attributes.description: Time taken by the DSP to respond to the bid request, measured in milliseconds. Critical for auction participation and timeout analysis.

attributes.name: bid_status
attributes.description: Outcome status of the bid event indicating whether the bid won the auction, lost, was not submitted, timed out, or encountered an error.

attributes.name: bid_strategy
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the bidding strategy applied by the DSP (e.g., maximize conversions, target CPA, target ROAS, fixed CPM).
attributes.references: The Trade Desk Bid Strategy Documentation

attributes.name: bid_timestamp
attributes.description: Exact timestamp when the bid was submitted to the SSP or ad exchange. Represents the real-world event time of the bid participation.

attributes.name: browser
attributes.description: Web browser used by the user (e.g., Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge). Null for in-app inventory.

attributes.name: clearing_price_cpm
attributes.description: The actual price paid for the impression if the bid won the auction, expressed in CPM. May be lower than bid price in second-price auctions. Null if bid lost.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this bid event record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for bid and clearing prices (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: deal_type
attributes.description: Type of programmatic deal: open auction (no deal), PMP (private marketplace), programmatic guaranteed, or preferred deal.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device where the ad impression will be served: desktop, mobile, tablet, CTV (Connected TV), or set-top box.

attributes.name: domain
attributes.description: The domain of the website where the ad impression will be served (e.g., cnn.com, espn.com). Used for brand safety and supply path transparency.

attributes.name: dsp_platform
attributes.description: Name of the DSP platform that submitted the bid (e.g., The Trade Desk, DV360, Amazon DSP).

attributes.name: floor_price_cpm
attributes.description: Minimum bid price set by the publisher or SSP for this impression, expressed in CPM. Bids below this floor are automatically rejected.

attributes.name: geo_city
attributes.description: City name representing the user's geographic location (e.g., New York, London, Toronto).

attributes.name: geo_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the geographic location of the user (e.g., USA, GBR, CAN).

attributes.name: geo_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code representing the user's geographic location. May be truncated for privacy (e.g., 90210, M5H 2N2).

attributes.name: geo_region
attributes.description: State, province, or region code representing the user's geographic location (e.g., CA for California, ON for Ontario).

attributes.name: inventory_type
attributes.description: Type of digital inventory being auctioned: web (desktop browser), mobile web, mobile app, CTV (Connected TV), or DOOH (Digital Out-of-Home).

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system of the device (e.g., iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, tvOS).

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Ad format type for the placement: banner (display), video, native, or audio.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Reason why the bid was rejected or lost the auction. Includes floor price not met, brand safety violation, frequency cap exceeded, budget exhausted, geo/device restrictions, inventory quality issues, creative approval pending, or domain/app/category blocks. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: floor_price|brand_safety|frequency_cap|budget_cap|geo_restriction|device_restriction|inventory_quality|creative_approval|domain_block|app_block|category_block|none — 12 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: ssp_name
attributes.description: Name of the SSP or ad exchange that sent the bid request and conducted the auction (e.g., Google Ad Manager, Magnite, PubMatic, OpenX).

attributes.name: supply_path_cost
attributes.description: Total cost incurred through the supply path (SSP fees, exchange fees, reseller margins) expressed as a percentage or absolute amount. Used for supply path optimization (SPO) analysis.

attributes.name: user_id_hashed
attributes.description: Hashed or anonymized user identifier passed by the SSP for frequency capping and audience targeting. Complies with privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA).

attributes.name: win_indicator
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this bid won the auction (True) or lost (False). Derived from bid_status for simplified win rate analysis.

products.name: pixel_deployment
products.description: This association product represents the deployment relationship between tracking_pixel and tech_partner. It captures the operational deployment of tracking pixels through specific technology partner platforms (tag managers, DMPs, analytics platforms, ad servers). Each record links one tracking pixel to one tech partner platform with deployment-specific attributes including integration status, API version, deployment environment, custom parameters, and error monitoring metrics. This is the operational record of pixel-platform integration health and deployment configuration.. Existence Justification: In advertising operations, tracking pixels are deployed through multiple technology partner platforms (tag managers like Google Tag Manager, DMPs, CDPs, ad servers, analytics platforms), and each tech partner platform manages the deployment of multiple pixels across their client base. Agencies actively manage these pixel-platform deployments as operational integration records, monitoring deployment health, API compatibility, error rates, and troubleshooting integration issues per pixel-platform combination.

attributes.name: pixel_deployment_id
attributes.description: Primary key for the pixel_deployment association

attributes.name: tech_partner_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the tech partner platform through which this pixel is deployed

attributes.name: tracking_pixel_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the tracking pixel being deployed through this tech partner platform

attributes.name: api_version
attributes.description: Version of the tech partner API used for this pixel deployment. Critical for compatibility tracking and upgrade planning.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this pixel deployment record was created in the system.

attributes.name: custom_parameters
attributes.description: Platform-specific custom parameters or configuration settings for this pixel deployment. Varies by tech partner platform capabilities.

attributes.name: deployment_date
attributes.description: Date when this pixel was deployed through this specific tech partner platform. Tracks when the integration was established.

attributes.name: deployment_environment
attributes.description: Environment context for this pixel-platform deployment. Tracks whether this is a production integration or test deployment.

attributes.name: error_rate
attributes.description: Calculated error rate (0.00000 to 1.00000) for pixel fires through this tech partner platform over the monitoring window. Key vendor performance metric.

attributes.name: fire_status
attributes.description: Most recent fire status for this pixel through this tech partner platform. Used for real-time health monitoring.

attributes.name: integration_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the pixel deployment through this tech partner platform. Used for health monitoring and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: last_fire_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful pixel fire through this tech partner platform. Used to detect stale or broken integrations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this pixel deployment record.

products.name: model_platform_configuration
products.description: This association product represents the deployment configuration between attribution_model and tech_partner. It captures platform-specific implementation details, API integration health, licensing arrangements, and operational parameters that exist only when a specific attribution model is deployed on a specific technology platform. Each record links one attribution model to one tech partner platform with deployment metadata, integration status, and service-level tracking.. Existence Justification: In advertising operations, attribution models are deployed across multiple technology platforms (Google Analytics, Adobe Analytics, Neustar, The Trade Desk) simultaneously to support multi-platform measurement strategies. Each tech partner platform can host multiple attribution models for different advertisers or campaign strategies. The business actively manages platform-specific configurations including API integration health, data feed frequencies, licensing tiers, and support SLAs for each model-platform combination.

attributes.name: model_platform_configuration_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for this attribution model platform configuration record. Primary key.

attributes.name: attribution_model_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Model Platform Configuration - Attribution Model Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the attribution model configuration being deployed on this platform

attributes.name: tech_partner_id
attributes.business_glossary_term: Model Platform Configuration - Tech Partner Id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to the technology platform partner hosting this attribution model

attributes.name: api_integration_status
attributes.description: Current operational status of the API integration between the attribution model and this specific tech partner platform. Values: active, inactive, degraded, maintenance, failed, pending. Used for operational monitoring and alerting.

attributes.name: configuration_status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of this model-platform configuration. Values: active (in production use), inactive (disabled), testing (pilot/QA), deprecated (scheduled for removal). Governs whether this configuration is used for live attribution processing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this model-platform configuration record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_feed_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which conversion and touchpoint data is synchronized between the tech partner platform and the attribution model processing engine. Values: real-time, hourly, daily, weekly, on-demand. Impacts attribution latency and reporting freshness.

attributes.name: last_sync_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent successful data synchronization between the tech partner platform and the attribution model. Used for monitoring integration health and data freshness.

attributes.name: license_tier
attributes.description: Licensing tier or service level for this specific model-platform combination. Values: basic, standard, premium, enterprise. Determines feature availability, data volume limits, and support entitlements.

attributes.name: model_deployment_date
attributes.description: Date when this attribution model was first deployed and activated on this specific tech partner platform. Used for tracking model lifecycle and historical analysis.

attributes.name: platform_version
attributes.description: Version of the technology platform on which this attribution model is deployed (e.g., Google Analytics 4 v2.1, Adobe Analytics 2.8). Critical for compatibility tracking and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: support_sla_level
attributes.description: Service level agreement tier for technical support and issue resolution for this model-platform configuration. Values: bronze, silver, gold, platinum. Defines response times and escalation procedures.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this model-platform configuration record.

products.name: session
products.description: Master reference table for session. Referenced by session_id.

attributes.name: session_id
attributes.description: Primary key for session

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the advertising campaign associated with this session.

attributes.name: placement_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the ad placement where the session originated.

attributes.name: browser
attributes.description: Name of the browser used during the session.

attributes.name: browser_version
attributes.description: Version of the browser used during the session.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: The marketing channel through which the session was initiated.

attributes.name: clicks
attributes.description: Total number of ad clicks recorded during the session.

attributes.name: conversion_value
attributes.description: Total monetary value of conversions attributed to the session.

attributes.name: conversions
attributes.description: Total number of conversions attributed to the session.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the session record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for conversion value.

attributes.name: device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the device used during the session.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Type of device used during the session.

attributes.name: exit_page_url
attributes.description: The URL of the last page viewed before the session ended.

attributes.name: geo_city
attributes.description: City where the session originated.

attributes.name: geo_country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the session location.

attributes.name: geo_region
attributes.description: Geographic region or state where the session originated.

attributes.name: impressions
attributes.description: Total number of ad impressions served during the session.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the device during the session.

attributes.name: is_bot
attributes.description: Indicates whether the session was identified as bot traffic.

attributes.name: is_viewable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ad impressions in the session met viewability standards.

attributes.name: landing_page_url
attributes.description: The URL of the first page viewed in the session.

attributes.name: medium
attributes.description: The medium through which the session was acquired (e.g., cpc, organic, email).

attributes.name: operating_system
attributes.description: Operating system of the device used during the session.

attributes.name: page_views
attributes.description: Total number of pages viewed during the session.

attributes.name: referrer_url
attributes.description: The URL of the referring page that led to this session.

attributes.name: screen_resolution
attributes.description: Screen resolution of the device during the session (e.g., 1920x1080).

attributes.name: session_duration_seconds
attributes.description: Total duration of the session measured in seconds.

attributes.name: session_end_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the session ended.

attributes.name: session_key
attributes.description: External business identifier for the session, used for tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: session_start_timestamp
attributes.description: The exact date and time when the session started.

attributes.name: session_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the session.

attributes.name: session_type
attributes.description: Classification of the session based on traffic source type.

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: The origin or source of the session traffic (e.g., google, facebook, direct).

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the session record was last updated in the system.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser user agent string captured during the session.

attributes.name: user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user associated with this session.

attributes.name: originating_session_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on session (originating_session_id)

products.name: auction
products.description: Master reference table for auction. Referenced by auction_id.

attributes.name: auction_id
attributes.description: Primary key for auction

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser whose creative won the auction and will be served.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising campaign associated with the winning bid in this auction.

attributes.name: deal_id
attributes.description: Identifier for a private marketplace (PMP) deal or programmatic guaranteed deal. Null for open auction inventory.

attributes.name: impression_event_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the ad impression that resulted from this auction. Links auction to downstream delivery and performance events.

attributes.name: line_item_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific line item within the campaign that participated in or won this auction.

attributes.name: placement_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ad placement or inventory slot that was auctioned. Represents the specific location where the ad will be displayed.

attributes.name: publisher_id
attributes.description: Reference to the publisher or content owner providing the ad inventory being auctioned.

attributes.name: ad_format
attributes.description: Creative format of the ad unit being auctioned. Determines technical specifications and user experience.

attributes.name: ad_size
attributes.description: Dimensions of the ad unit in pixels (e.g., 300x250, 728x90). Standard IAB ad unit sizes or custom dimensions.

attributes.name: auction_completion_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the auction was resolved and a winning bid was selected or the auction was closed without a winner.

attributes.name: auction_external_code
attributes.description: External business identifier for the auction, typically provided by the ad exchange or supply-side platform (SSP). Used for cross-system reconciliation and reporting.

attributes.name: auction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the auction event. Tracks progression from initiation through bid collection to final resolution or failure.

attributes.name: auction_timeout_ms
attributes.description: Maximum time in milliseconds allowed for the auction to complete before timing out. Typical values range from 100-500ms.

attributes.name: auction_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the auction event was initiated by the ad exchange or SSP. Represents the real-world business event time for auction start.

attributes.name: auction_type
attributes.description: Classification of the auction mechanism used for ad inventory pricing. First-price auctions award to highest bidder at their bid price; second-price auctions award at second-highest bid price plus increment.

attributes.name: bid_count
attributes.description: Total number of bids received during the auction from all participating demand-side platforms (DSPs) and bidders.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this auction record was first created in the data platform. Used for data lineage and audit purposes.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary values in this auction (winning bid, floor price).

attributes.name: device_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the end-user device (IDFA, AAID, or hashed identifier). Used for frequency capping and attribution. May be pseudonymized or hashed.

attributes.name: device_type
attributes.description: Classification of the device on which the ad impression will be displayed. Critical for targeting and performance analysis.

attributes.name: exchange_code
attributes.description: Reference to the ad exchange or supply-side platform (SSP) that conducted the auction.

attributes.name: floor_price
attributes.description: Minimum acceptable bid price set by the publisher or exchange for this auction. Bids below this threshold are rejected.

attributes.name: fraud_score
attributes.description: Pre-bid fraud risk score (0-100) indicating likelihood of invalid traffic (IVT). Higher scores indicate higher fraud risk. Provided by fraud detection vendors.

attributes.name: geo_city
attributes.description: City name derived from the user's location. Used for hyper-local targeting and performance analysis.

attributes.name: geo_country
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code derived from the user's IP address or device location. Used for geographic targeting and reporting.

attributes.name: geo_postal_code
attributes.description: Postal or ZIP code derived from the user's location. Used for precise geographic targeting and demographic inference.

attributes.name: geo_region
attributes.description: State, province, or region within the country derived from the user's location. Used for sub-national geographic targeting.

attributes.name: ip_address
attributes.description: IP address of the end-user device at the time of the auction. May be IPv4 or IPv6. Used for geo-targeting and fraud detection. May be truncated for privacy compliance.

attributes.name: site_category
attributes.description: IAB content category classification of the publisher site or app. Used for contextual targeting and brand safety.

attributes.name: site_domain
attributes.description: Domain name of the website or app where the ad will be displayed. Used for brand safety and contextual targeting.

attributes.name: supply_chain
attributes.description: Serialized ads.txt or sellers.json supply chain transparency data. Identifies all intermediaries in the ad transaction chain for fraud prevention.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this auction record was last modified in the data platform. Used for change tracking and data quality monitoring.

attributes.name: user_agent
attributes.description: Browser or application user agent string identifying the software environment of the end user. Used for device detection and compatibility.

attributes.name: viewability_prediction
attributes.description: Pre-bid predicted probability (0-100%) that the impression will meet viewability standards (MRC: 50% of pixels in view for 1 second for display, 2 seconds for video).

attributes.name: winning_bid_amount
attributes.description: The monetary value of the winning bid in the auction. Represents the clearing price paid by the advertiser for the impression.

attributes.name: fallback_auction_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on auction (fallback_auction_id)

domains.name: brand
domains.description: Manages brand strategy, positioning, and identity assets for clients. Owns brand guidelines, messaging frameworks, competitive SOV tracking, brand health metrics (NPS, awareness, sentiment), and public relations communications. Supports Brand Strategy and Positioning and Public Relations and Communications processes. Integrates with Nielsen Ad Intel for competitive monitoring.

products.name: brand_profile
products.description: Master record for a client brand managed by the agency. Captures brand identity essentials including brand name, parent company, industry vertical, brand tier, logo references, brand color palette codes, typography standards, tone of voice classification, brand archetype, launch date, brand lifecycle stage (emerging, established, mature, declining), active markets and geographies, local brand name variants, regulatory compliance flags (ASA, FTC, EASA), and market tier classifications. Serves as the SSOT for brand identity within the brand domain — distinct from the client master in the client domain. Anchors all brand-level entities including guidelines, positioning, assets, health metrics, and PR activities.

attributes.name: brand_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the brand profile record. Serves as the primary key and system-of-record anchor for all brand-level entities within the brand domain.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: approved_media_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Brand profiles maintain approved media supplier lists for brand safety compliance and media buying operations. Critical for vendor approval workflows and ensuring brand-safe media placements across ca

attributes.name: active_markets
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes representing the markets where the brand is currently active and running campaigns. Supports geo-targeting in The Trade Desk, media planning in Mediaocean Prisma, and multi-market reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; IAB Geo-Targeting Standards; EASA Cross-Border Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: agency_onboard_date
attributes.description: Date on which the brand was formally onboarded to the agency and the brand profile record was activated in the system of record. Marks the start of the agency-client brand management relationship.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Standards; Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud Opportunity Close Date

attributes.name: asa_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand's advertising materials and practices are compliant with Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) regulations. Required for UK and international market campaign approvals.
attributes.references: Advertising Standards Authority (ASA) CAP Code; BCAP Code

attributes.name: brand_archetype
attributes.description: Jungian brand archetype classification (e.g., Hero, Caregiver, Explorer, Sage, Outlaw, Creator, Ruler, Magician, Innocent, Everyman, Lover, Jester) that defines the brand's personality framework. Anchors tone of voice, creative direction, and brand strategy positioning. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Hero|Caregiver|Explorer|Sage|Outlaw|Creator|Ruler|Magician|Innocent|Everyman|Lover|Jester — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Framework; ANA Brand Positioning Standards

attributes.name: brand_awareness_baseline_pct
attributes.description: Baseline unaided brand awareness percentage among the target audience at the time of agency engagement or last formal brand health study. Used as the benchmark for measuring awareness lift from campaign activity. Range: 0.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: MRC Audience Measurement Standards; Comscore Cross-Platform Analytics; ANA Brand Health Measurement Standards

attributes.name: brand_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying the brand across agency systems, including Mediaocean Prisma and Google Campaign Manager 360. Used as the business key for cross-system reconciliation and reporting.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Mediaocean Prisma Integration Specification

attributes.name: brand_guidelines_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the master brand guidelines document stored in Workfront DAM. Serves as the authoritative source for all brand identity standards including logo usage, color palette, typography, and tone of voice rules.
attributes.references: Workfront DAM Integration Specification; ANA Brand Management Standards

attributes.name: brand_name
attributes.description: The primary commercial name of the brand as it appears in market-facing communications, campaign briefs, and agency deliverables. Serves as the human-readable identity label for the brand profile.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Management Standards; IAB Taxonomy

attributes.name: brand_safety_category
attributes.description: Classification of the brand's content adjacency sensitivity level for programmatic media buying. Determines the brand safety targeting parameters applied in The Trade Desk and Google Campaign Manager 360 to prevent ad placement near inappropriate content.
attributes.references: IAB Brand Safety Standards; TAG Brand Safety Certified; GARM Brand Safety Floor

attributes.name: brand_status
attributes.description: Current operational lifecycle status of the brand profile record within the agency's system of record. Controls whether the brand is eligible for new campaign assignments, media planning, and creative production activities.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; 4As Agency Management Standards

attributes.name: brand_tier
attributes.description: Market positioning tier of the brand reflecting its price-point and competitive positioning strategy. Informs media planning, creative tone, and channel selection within campaign strategy and planning processes.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Management Standards; 4As Strategic Planning Framework

attributes.name: ccpa_opt_out
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Opt-Out Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand has opted out of the sale of consumer personal information under the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Restricts certain data sharing and targeting activities for California audiences.
attributes.references: CCPA (California Civil Code §1798.100); NAI Code of Conduct; IAB CCPA Compliance Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the brand profile record was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation marker for data lineage, compliance reporting, and record lifecycle management.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) Storage Limitation; Internal Data Governance Policy

attributes.name: easa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: European Advertising Standards Alliance (EASA) Compliance Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand's advertising practices comply with European Advertising Standards Alliance (EASA) cross-border complaint handling and self-regulatory standards. Required for European market campaign activation.
attributes.references: EASA Best Practice Recommendation; ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code

attributes.name: ftc_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand's advertising disclosures, endorsements, and claims comply with Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Advertising Practices Division guidelines. Required for US market campaign activation.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Practices Division; FTC Endorsement Guides 16 CFR Part 255

attributes.name: gdpr_data_use_consent
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Data Use Consent Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand has provided consent for audience data usage in programmatic targeting and analytics under GDPR Article 6 lawful basis requirements. Governs data activation in The Trade Desk and DMP/CDP integrations.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; IAB Europe Transparency and Consent Framework (TCF)

attributes.name: industry_vertical
attributes.description: The primary industry sector classification of the brand per IAB Content Taxonomy (e.g., Automotive, Consumer Packaged Goods, Financial Services, Retail, Technology). Used for competitive conflict detection, audience segmentation, and Nielsen Ad Intel competitive monitoring alignment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: Automotive|Consumer Packaged Goods|Financial Services|Retail|Technology|Healthcare|Entertainment|Travel|Telecommunications|Food & Beverage — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Content Taxonomy v3.0; Nielsen Ad Intel Industry Classification

attributes.name: launch_date
attributes.description: The date on which the brand was officially launched in its primary market. Used for brand age calculations, lifecycle stage validation, and historical competitive Share of Voice (SOV) analysis via Nielsen Ad Intel.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the brand's commercial lifecycle. Drives investment strategy, media mix recommendations, and KPI benchmarking. Aligned with brand health monitoring and Nielsen Ad Intel competitive tracking.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Management Standards; IAB Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: local_brand_name
attributes.description: Market-specific or locale-specific variant of the brand name used in regional campaigns, translations, or co-branded executions. Supports multi-market brand management and localization workflows.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Management Standards; EASA Cross-Border Advertising Guidelines

attributes.name: logo_asset_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the master brand logo file stored in the Workfront Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. Provides a canonical pointer to the approved logo for use in campaign trafficking, ad serving via Google Campaign Manager 360, and creative production.
attributes.references: Workfront DAM Integration Specification; IAB Digital Ad Specifications

attributes.name: market_tier
attributes.description: Classification of the brand's market investment tier indicating the scale and priority of media investment. Tier 1 represents highest-investment markets; Tier 3 represents emerging or test markets. Drives media budget allocation in Mediaocean Prisma.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Market Classification; ANA Media Planning Standards

attributes.name: messaging_framework_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the brand's approved messaging framework document in Workfront DAM. Defines key messages, proof points, and value propositions used across campaign strategy, PR communications, and creative development.
attributes.references: Workfront DAM Integration Specification; 4As Strategic Planning Framework

attributes.name: nielsen_brand_code
attributes.description: External brand identifier assigned by Nielsen Ad Intel for competitive monitoring, audience measurement, and Gross Rating Point (GRP) tracking. Used to reconcile agency brand records with Nielsen's competitive intelligence database.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel Integration Specification; MRC Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: nps_baseline_score
attributes.description: Baseline Net Promoter Score (NPS) for the brand at the time of agency engagement or last formal brand health assessment. Serves as the reference benchmark for measuring brand health improvement over the engagement period. Range: -100.00 to 100.00.
attributes.references: NPS Methodology (Bain & Company); ANA Brand Health Measurement Standards

attributes.name: parent_company_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the parent organization that owns or controls the brand. Used for competitive conflict checks, client hierarchy management, and consolidated reporting across brand portfolios.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Management Standards; ANA Client Relationship Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_color_hex
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code for the brand's primary color as defined in the brand guidelines. Used by Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) for asset production and Workfront DAM for brand compliance checks.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud Brand Standards; IAB Digital Ad Specifications

attributes.name: primary_market
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code for the brand's primary or home market. Used as the default market context for brand health benchmarking, SOV tracking via Nielsen Ad Intel, and regulatory compliance flag evaluation.

attributes.name: primary_typeface
attributes.description: Name of the primary typeface (font family) specified in the brand's typography standards. Governs headline and body copy font usage across all creative executions produced in Adobe Creative Cloud.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud Brand Standards; 4As Creative Production Guidelines

attributes.name: secondary_color_hex
attributes.description: Hexadecimal color code for the brand's secondary color as defined in the brand guidelines. Supports multi-color palette management in Adobe Creative Cloud and Workfront DAM for creative production workflows.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud Brand Standards; IAB Digital Ad Specifications

attributes.name: secondary_typeface
attributes.description: Name of the secondary or supporting typeface specified in the brand's typography standards. Used for subheadings, captions, and supporting copy in creative executions.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud Brand Standards; 4As Creative Production Guidelines

attributes.name: sentiment_baseline
attributes.description: Baseline brand sentiment classification derived from social listening, PR monitoring, and consumer research at the time of agency engagement. Anchors sentiment tracking and PR communications strategy.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Health Measurement Standards; IAB Social Media Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: sov_tracking_enabled
attributes.business_glossary_term: Share of Voice (SOV) Tracking Enabled Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether competitive Share of Voice (SOV) tracking is active for this brand via Nielsen Ad Intel. When enabled, competitive monitoring data is ingested and linked to brand health metrics.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel Integration Specification; MRC Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: tag_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the brand holds Trustworthy Accountability Group (TAG) certification for brand safety, anti-fraud, and malware protection in digital advertising. Influences publisher allowlist/blocklist configuration in The Trade Desk and Google Campaign Manager 360.
attributes.references: Trustworthy Accountability Group (TAG) Certified Against Fraud; TAG Brand Safety Certified

attributes.name: tone_of_voice
attributes.description: Standardized classification of the brand's communication style and personality expression across all channels. Governs copywriting, creative briefs, and PR communications to ensure brand consistency. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: authoritative|playful|inspirational|empathetic|bold|sophisticated|conversational — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: 4As Creative Standards; ANA Brand Positioning Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the brand profile record was most recently modified. Supports change detection, incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer, and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5(1)(e) Storage Limitation; Internal Data Governance Policy

products.name: guideline
products.description: Authoritative brand guideline document record governing visual identity, messaging architecture, and usage standards for a brand. Tracks guideline version, effective date, expiry date, approval status, owning brand strategist, document storage URI (DAM reference), applicable markets/regions, language variants, and guideline type (visual identity, tone of voice, messaging framework, digital, OOH, co-branding). For messaging-type guidelines, captures structured messaging architecture including brand promise, brand pillars, key proof points, elevator pitch, tagline variants, audience-specific message maps, tone descriptors, and forbidden language lists. Integrates with Adobe Creative Cloud DAM and Workfront for proofing workflows. Versioned to support messaging framework evolution alongside visual identity updates.

attributes.name: guideline_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the brand guideline record. Primary key for the brand_guideline data product in the Silver Layer lakehouse.

attributes.name: approved_production_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Brand guidelines specify approved production vendors (design agencies, production houses) for asset creation. Essential for vendor compliance in creative production and ensuring brand consistency acro

attributes.name: brand_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand.brand_profile. Business justification: Brand guidelines govern the visual identity and messaging architecture for a specific brand profile. While client_brand_id tracks client ownership, brand_profile_id links to the operational brand enti

attributes.name: client_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client brand entity that this guideline governs. Links the guideline to its owning brand within the client portfolio.

attributes.name: previous_version_guideline_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the immediately preceding version of this guideline. Enables version chain traversal and supports messaging framework evolution auditing.
attributes.references: Workfront Version Control; Adobe Creative Cloud DAM

attributes.name: worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the talent profile of the brand strategist who owns and is accountable for this guideline document.

attributes.name: applicable_markets
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes identifying the geographic markets to which this guideline applies (e.g., 'USA|GBR|DEU'). Supports multi-market brand governance and regional variant management.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the guideline document within the Workfront proofing and approval workflow. Draft indicates work-in-progress; In Review indicates active UAT/stakeholder review; Approved indicates ratified and in force; Superseded indicates replaced by a newer version; Retired indicates no longer applicable.
attributes.references: Workfront Proofing Workflow; ASA Code of Advertising Practice

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the guideline received final client or internal approval, as recorded in the Workfront proofing workflow.
attributes.references: Workfront Proofing Workflow; 4As Agency Operations Standards

attributes.name: approved_typefaces
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of approved font family names for use in brand communications (e.g., 'Helvetica Neue|Georgia|Arial'). Populated for visual_identity guideline types. Sourced from Adobe Creative Cloud font libraries.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud Fonts; IAB Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: audience_message_map
attributes.description: Structured JSON-serialised string capturing audience segment-to-message mappings (e.g., segment name, primary message, secondary message, call-to-action). Populated for messaging_framework guideline types to support audience-targeted communications.
attributes.references: ANA Audience Targeting Standards; IAB Audience Taxonomy

attributes.name: brand_pillars
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of the brand's strategic pillars (e.g., 'Innovation|Trust|Sustainability'). Populated for messaging_framework guideline types. Confidential as it represents proprietary brand positioning strategy.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Strategy Framework; 4As Brand Standards

attributes.name: brand_promise
attributes.description: The core brand promise statement articulating the fundamental value the brand commits to delivering to its audience. Populated for messaging_framework guideline types. Confidential as it represents proprietary brand strategy.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Strategy Framework; 4As Brand Standards

attributes.name: change_summary
attributes.description: Free-text summary of the key changes introduced in this version relative to the previous version. Supports change communication to creative, media, and PR teams.
attributes.references: Workfront Version Control; 4As Agency Operations Standards

attributes.name: channel_scope
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of media channels to which this guideline applies (e.g., 'digital|ooh|ctv|print|social'). Aligns with IAB channel taxonomy and supports channel-specific creative governance. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: digital|ooh|ctv|print|social|radio|dooh|ott|email|search — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Channel Taxonomy; MRC Measurement Standards

attributes.name: co_brand_partner_name
attributes.description: Name of the partner brand involved in a co-branding arrangement governed by this guideline. Populated only for co_branding guideline types. Supports competitive conflict checks and partner brand governance.
attributes.references: ANA Co-Marketing Standards; ASA Code of Advertising Practice

attributes.name: confidentiality_level
attributes.description: Data classification level assigned to this guideline document governing its distribution and access permissions. Public guidelines may be shared externally; Restricted guidelines contain unreleased brand strategy.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5; CCPA; FTC Advertising Practices; TAG Brand Safety Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: ISO 8601 timestamp recording when this brand guideline record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: dam_uri
attributes.business_glossary_term: Digital Asset Management (DAM) Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)
attributes.description: Fully-qualified URI pointing to the master guideline document stored in the Adobe Creative Cloud Digital Asset Management (DAM) system. Serves as the authoritative source-of-record reference for creative teams.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud DAM; IAB Digital Asset Standards

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Calendar date from which this version of the guideline becomes binding for all creative production, media planning, and communications activities.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Advertising Practice; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: elevator_pitch
attributes.description: Concise 30–60 second verbal description of the brand's value proposition for use in sales, PR, and client-facing communications. Populated for messaging_framework guideline types.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Strategy Framework; 4As Agency Operations Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Calendar date after which this version of the guideline is no longer valid and must be superseded or retired. Nullable for open-ended guidelines with no planned expiry.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Advertising Practice; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: forbidden_language
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of words, phrases, or claims that are explicitly prohibited in all brand communications under this guideline. Supports compliance with ASA, FTC, and client brand safety requirements.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Advertising Practice; FTC Advertising Practices; TAG Brand Safety Standards

attributes.name: guideline_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the guideline document, used in Workfront project references and Adobe Creative Cloud DAM asset tagging. Format: BG- followed by 4–12 uppercase alphanumeric characters.
attributes.references: Workfront DAM Naming Convention; Adobe Creative Cloud DAM

attributes.name: guideline_type
attributes.description: Categorical classification of the guideline document by its primary subject matter. Visual Identity covers logos, colour palettes, typography; Tone of Voice covers language style; Messaging Framework covers brand promise and pillars; Digital covers web/social/app standards; Out-of-Home (OOH) covers outdoor/transit formats; Co-Branding covers partner brand usage rules.
attributes.references: IAB Brand Safety Standards; ASA Code of Advertising Practice; 4As Brand Standards

attributes.name: is_global
attributes.description: Indicates whether this guideline applies globally across all markets (True) or is restricted to the markets specified in applicable_markets (False). Supports multi-market brand governance hierarchies.
attributes.references: EASA Cross-Border Advertising Standards; ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code

attributes.name: is_mandatory
attributes.description: Indicates whether compliance with this guideline is mandatory (True) for all creative and communications outputs, or advisory/recommended (False). Supports brand compliance enforcement workflows.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Advertising Practice; FTC Advertising Practices; TAG Brand Safety Standards

attributes.name: key_proof_points
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of substantiated claims or evidence statements that support the brand promise and pillars. Used by copywriters and PR teams to ensure message consistency. Populated for messaging_framework guideline types.
attributes.references: FTC Advertising Substantiation Guidelines; ASA Code of Advertising Practice

attributes.name: language_variants
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of BCP-47 language tags identifying the language versions covered by this guideline (e.g., 'en-US|fr-FR|de-DE'). Supports localisation of tone-of-voice and messaging framework guidelines.
attributes.references: BCP-47 Language Tags; EASA Cross-Border Advertising Standards

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: ISO 8601 timestamp recording when this brand guideline record was most recently updated. Supports change detection, audit trail, and Silver Layer incremental processing.

attributes.name: logo_usage_rules
attributes.description: Free-text description of approved and prohibited logo usage rules including minimum size, clear space, colour variants, and placement restrictions. Populated for visual_identity and co_branding guideline types.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Advertising Practice; IAB Brand Safety Standards; 4As Brand Standards

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled calendar date for the next mandatory review of this guideline. Derived operationally from effective_date plus review_cycle_days but stored explicitly to support governance workflow triggers.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Standards; ANA Brand Governance Framework

attributes.name: primary_colour_palette
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of approved primary brand colours expressed as HEX codes (e.g., '#FF0000|#FFFFFF|#000000'). Populated for visual_identity guideline types. Sourced from Adobe Creative Cloud brand libraries.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud Brand Libraries; IAB Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: review_cycle_days
attributes.description: Scheduled review frequency for this guideline expressed in calendar days (e.g., 365 for annual review). Drives automated review reminders and governance calendar planning.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Standards; ANA Brand Governance Framework

attributes.name: secondary_colour_palette
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of approved secondary/accent brand colours expressed as HEX codes. Populated for visual_identity guideline types. Supports extended creative palette governance.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud Brand Libraries; IAB Digital Advertising Standards

attributes.name: tagline
attributes.description: The primary approved tagline for the brand as defined in this guideline version. Confidential as it may represent unreleased creative strategy prior to campaign launch.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Advertising Practice; FTC Advertising Practices; ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Human-readable title of the brand guideline document (e.g., 'Acme Corp Global Visual Identity Standards v3.2'). Used as the primary display label in DAM and Workfront.

attributes.name: tone_descriptors
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of adjectives describing the brand's approved tone of voice (e.g., 'Authoritative|Warm|Witty|Direct'). Populated for tone_of_voice and messaging_framework guideline types.
attributes.references: ASA Code of Advertising Practice; 4As Brand Standards

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Semantic version identifier for this iteration of the guideline (e.g., '1.0', '2.3', '3.1.2'). Supports versioned evolution of messaging frameworks alongside visual identity updates.
attributes.references: Workfront Version Control; Adobe Creative Cloud DAM

products.name: positioning
products.description: Strategic positioning statement and competitive differentiation record for a brand. Stores the formal positioning statement, target audience definition, frame of reference (competitive category), point of difference, reason to believe, brand essence, competitive set identifiers, positioning territory (functional, emotional, societal), and positioning review cycle. Tracks positioning history with effective and superseded dates. Supports Brand Strategy and Positioning process.

attributes.name: positioning_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the brand positioning record. Primary key for this entity. Entity role: MASTER_RESOURCE — represents a strategic positioning document/asset owned and managed by the agency on behalf of a client brand.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; 4As Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser (client organisation) that owns the brand being positioned. Enables cross-brand and cross-client reporting.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Sales Cloud Account Object; IAB Advertiser Standards

attributes.name: brand_profile_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand.brand_profile. Business justification: Brand positioning statements define the strategic positioning for a specific brand profile. Similar to brand_guideline, client_brand_id tracks ownership while brand_profile_id links to the operational

attributes.name: client_brand_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client brand entity for which this positioning strategy is defined. Links the positioning record to the brand master in the client domain.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM — Sales Cloud Brand Object; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: parent_positioning_id
attributes.description: Reference to the global master brand_positioning_id from which this regional or market-specific positioning is derived. Null if this record is itself the global master or a standalone positioning.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: primary_superseded_by_positioning_id
attributes.description: Reference to the brand_positioning_id of the newer record that replaced this one. Null if this is the current active version. Enables navigation of the positioning version chain.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: approval_status
