attributes.description: The approval workflow status of this positioning record. 'pending' = awaiting internal review; 'approved' = signed off internally; 'rejected' = returned for revision; 'pending_client' = awaiting client sign-off.
attributes.references: Workfront Proofing and Approval Workflow; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual (internal lead or client stakeholder) who granted final approval for this positioning record. Supports audit trail and accountability tracking.
attributes.references: Workfront Proofing and Approval Workflow; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: approved_date
attributes.description: The date on which this positioning record received final approval (internal and/or client). Null if not yet approved. Used for audit trail and compliance with client SOW deliverable timelines.
attributes.references: Workfront Proofing and Approval Workflow; Salesforce CRM — Service Cloud

attributes.name: awareness_type
attributes.description: Specifies the methodology used to measure the brand awareness baseline: 'unaided' = spontaneous recall without prompting; 'aided' = recognition when brand name is provided; 'top_of_mind' = first brand recalled in category.
attributes.references: MRC Audience Measurement Standards; Nielsen Ad Intel Audience Measurement

attributes.name: brand_awareness_baseline_pct
attributes.description: The unaided or aided brand awareness percentage recorded at the time this positioning was established or last reviewed. Used as a benchmark to measure the effectiveness of the positioning strategy over time.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel Audience Measurement; MRC Audience Measurement Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: brand_essence
attributes.description: A concise distillation of the brand's fundamental nature and core value — typically a short phrase or single sentence that captures the brand's soul and guides all brand expression (e.g., 'Empowering human potential').
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: brand_personality
attributes.description: Description of the human characteristics and traits attributed to the brand (e.g., 'bold, innovative, approachable'). Guides tone of voice, creative direction, and communications style across all channels.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: brand_promise
attributes.description: The explicit commitment the brand makes to its target audience — the experience or value customers can consistently expect. Distinct from brand essence in that it is outward-facing and customer-centric.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: brand_sentiment_baseline
attributes.description: The baseline brand sentiment score (e.g., on a -100 to +100 scale) recorded at the time this positioning was established or last reviewed. Tracks consumer perception and emotional affinity toward the brand.
attributes.references: Comscore Cross-Platform Analytics; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: competitive_set_ids
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of competitor brand or advertiser identifiers that constitute the defined competitive set for this positioning. Used to scope Share of Voice (SOV) tracking and competitive monitoring via Nielsen Ad Intel.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel Competitive Monitoring; IAB Brand Safety Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this brand positioning record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and compliance requirements. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE RECORD_AUDIT_CREATED category.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; 4As Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: The date from which this positioning record is considered active and authoritative. Supports temporal tracking of positioning history and enables point-in-time analysis of brand strategy.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: frame_of_reference
attributes.description: The competitive category or context within which the brand competes and against which consumers evaluate it (e.g., 'premium athletic footwear', 'cloud-based HR software'). Defines the competitive set boundary for the positioning.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: The geographic market(s) for which this positioning applies, expressed as ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country codes or regional descriptors (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'GLOBAL'). Supports multi-market brand strategy management.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3 Country Codes; IAB Global Standards

attributes.name: is_global_master
attributes.description: Indicates whether this positioning record is the global master version from which regional adaptations are derived. True = global master; False = regional or market-specific adaptation.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: The IETF BCP 47 language code for the language in which this positioning record is authored (e.g., 'en', 'en-US', 'fr-FR'). Supports multi-language brand strategy management for global clients.
attributes.references: IETF BCP 47 Language Tags; IAB Global Standards

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: The date on which this positioning record was most recently formally reviewed and validated by the brand strategy team and client stakeholders.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; Workfront Project Management

attributes.name: messaging_framework
attributes.description: Structured narrative framework defining the hierarchy of brand messages — from core proposition through supporting messages to proof points — used to ensure consistency across campaigns and communications.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: The scheduled date for the next formal review of this positioning record. Calculated based on the review cycle and last review date. Used to trigger review workflows and client QBR preparation.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; Workfront Project Management

attributes.name: nielsen_brand_code
attributes.description: The brand identifier assigned by Nielsen Ad Intel for competitive monitoring and SOV tracking. Used to link this positioning record to Nielsen competitive intelligence data and GRP/TRP measurement reports.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel Competitive Monitoring; MRC Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: nps_baseline
attributes.description: The Net Promoter Score (NPS) baseline value recorded at the time this positioning was established or last reviewed. Provides a benchmark for measuring brand health improvement attributable to the positioning strategy.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Management Guidelines; NPS Methodology (Bain & Company)

attributes.name: point_of_difference
attributes.description: The key attribute, benefit, or association that differentiates the brand from competitors within the frame of reference. Represents the core competitive advantage articulated in the positioning strategy.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: positioning_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric business identifier for the positioning record, used in cross-system references, client deliverables, and brand strategy documents (e.g., BP-ACME2024). Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE BUSINESS_IDENTIFIER category.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; IAB Brand Safety Framework

attributes.name: positioning_name
attributes.description: Human-readable title or label for this positioning record (e.g., 'FY2024 Premium Repositioning — ACME Corp'). Used in reports, presentations, and brand strategy documents. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE IDENTITY_LABEL category.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: positioning_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the positioning record. 'draft' = in development; 'active' = approved and in use; 'under_review' = scheduled review cycle in progress; 'superseded' = replaced by a newer version; 'archived' = retired. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE LIFECYCLE_STATUS category.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; Workfront Project Lifecycle

attributes.name: reason_to_believe
attributes.description: The substantiation or proof points that support the brand's point of difference and make the positioning credible to the target audience. May include product features, certifications, heritage, or third-party endorsements.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; FTC Advertising Practices — Substantiation Guidelines

attributes.name: review_cycle
attributes.description: The scheduled frequency at which this positioning record is formally reviewed and validated by the brand strategy team and client. Drives workflow scheduling in Workfront and QBR agenda planning.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; Workfront Project Management

attributes.name: sov_target_pct
attributes.description: The target Share of Voice (SOV) percentage the brand aims to achieve within its competitive set and frame of reference. Used as a KPI benchmark for media planning and campaign performance evaluation. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE MEASUREMENT_OR_VALUE category.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel SOV Measurement; MRC Audience Measurement Standards; IAB Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: statement
attributes.description: The formal, approved positioning statement articulating the brand's unique place in the market. Typically follows the structure: 'For [target audience], [brand] is the [frame of reference] that [point of difference] because [reason to believe].' Classified confidential as it represents proprietary brand strategy.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: superseded_date
attributes.description: The date on which this positioning record was superseded by a newer version. Null if the record is currently active. Enables full positioning history tracking and audit trail.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; ANA Brand Management Guidelines

attributes.name: target_audience_definition
attributes.description: Narrative description of the primary target audience for the brand, including demographic, psychographic, and behavioural characteristics. Used to align media planning, creative development, and campaign strategy.
attributes.references: IAB Audience Taxonomy; ANA Brand Management Guidelines; Nielsen Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: territory
attributes.description: The primary strategic territory in which the brand is positioned. 'functional' = product/service performance benefits; 'emotional' = feelings and personal identity; 'societal' = broader social, environmental, or cultural purpose. Satisfies MASTER_RESOURCE CLASSIFICATION_OR_TYPE category.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Management Guidelines; ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this brand positioning record was most recently modified. Supports audit trail, change tracking, and Silver layer incremental processing in the Databricks Lakehouse.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 — Data Integrity and Accountability; 4As Data Governance Framework

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Sequential version number of this positioning record for the associated brand. Increments with each approved revision. Enables version history tracking and comparison of positioning evolution over time.
attributes.references: 4As Brand Strategy Standards; Workfront DAM Version Control

attributes.name: workfront_project_code
attributes.description: The identifier of the corresponding brand strategy project in Workfront (Project Management system). Enables traceability between the positioning record and the project deliverable, resource plan, and approval workflow.
attributes.references: Workfront Project Management; 4As Project Management Standards

products.name: brand_asset
products.description: Individual brand asset record representing a discrete creative or identity asset (logo, icon, typeface file, brand video, photography, illustration, template) managed under a brand, including its deployment and usage history. Captures asset name, asset type, file format, resolution/dimensions, color mode, usage rights, rights expiry date, approved channels (digital, print, OOH, broadcast), market applicability, DAM asset ID (Adobe Creative Cloud / Workfront DAM reference), version number, approval status, and asset lifecycle stage. Also tracks usage events: each approved deployment across campaigns, channels, or markets with usage context, start/end dates, approver, rights confirmation, co-branding partner references, and restriction notes. Enables brand compliance auditing, rights management tracking, and asset utilization reporting. Distinct from campaign creative assets owned by the creative domain.

attributes.name: brand_asset_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each brand asset record in the DAM. Primary key for the brand_asset product.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser or client who owns this brand asset. Supports client-level brand compliance auditing.

attributes.name: brand_profile_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent brand under which this asset is managed. Links the asset to its owning brand entity.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the campaign for which this asset was originally created or first deployed. Supports campaign-level asset utilization reporting and creative lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Google Campaign Manager 360; IAB Digital Data & Technology Standards

attributes.name: dam_asset_id
attributes.description: External reference identifier for this asset in the Digital Asset Management (DAM) system — Adobe Creative Cloud or Workfront DAM. Used to cross-reference and retrieve the physical file from the DAM platform.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud DAM; Workfront DAM

attributes.name: guideline_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand.brand_guideline. Business justification: Brand assets must comply with specific brand guidelines. Currently brand_guideline_ref is a STRING reference - converting to FK enables validation that assets meet guideline requirements and allows jo

attributes.name: parent_asset_brand_asset_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing identifier pointing to the master or parent asset from which this variant or localized version was derived. Enables asset hierarchy and lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Workfront DAM; ANA Brand Management Standards

attributes.name: production_supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Brand assets track production vendor (design agencies, production houses, photographers) for asset provenance, rights management, and vendor performance evaluation. Critical for usage rights tracking

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the asset received its current approval status. Used for compliance auditing and to determine the start of the approved usage window.
attributes.references: Workfront Proofing; ASA Advertising Standards; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval status of the brand asset as determined by the brand governance review process. Only assets with 'approved' status may be deployed in client-facing campaigns.
attributes.references: Workfront Proofing; ASA Advertising Standards; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the brand manager or creative director who granted final approval for this asset. Supports brand compliance audit trails.

attributes.name: approved_channels
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of channels for which this asset has been approved for deployment (e.g., 'digital,print,OOH,broadcast,social'). Enforces brand compliance by restricting asset use to authorized channels only.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Ad Serving Standards; ASA Advertising Standards; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: asset_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the brand asset including its intended use, visual characteristics, and any special handling instructions for creative teams.
attributes.references: Workfront DAM; ANA Brand Management Standards

attributes.name: asset_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the brand asset as catalogued in the DAM (e.g., 'Primary Logo RGB', 'Brand Typeface Regular', 'Hero Photography Q1 2024').
attributes.references: IAB Digital Data & Technology Standards; Workfront DAM

attributes.name: asset_type
attributes.description: Classification of the brand asset by its creative or identity function. Drives usage rights enforcement and channel eligibility rules. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: logo|icon|typeface|brand_video|photography|illustration|template|motion_graphic|brand_guideline|color_palette — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Digital Content Label; ANA Brand Management Standards

attributes.name: cobranding_partner
attributes.description: Name of the co-branding partner organization whose brand identity is incorporated in this asset (e.g., for co-branded campaigns or partnership activations). Null if no co-branding applies.
attributes.references: ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code; 4As Client Management Standards

attributes.name: color_mode
attributes.description: Color space or mode of the asset (RGB for digital, CMYK for print, Pantone for brand-matched spot colors). Critical for ensuring correct reproduction across digital and print channels.
attributes.references: ICC Color Management Standards; IAB Digital Ad Serving Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this brand asset record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); IAB Data Transparency Standards

attributes.name: deployment_count
attributes.description: Total number of times this asset has been deployed across campaigns, channels, or markets. Supports asset utilization reporting and ROI analysis for brand asset investment.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Management Standards; Google Campaign Manager 360

attributes.name: file_format
attributes.description: File format or extension of the brand asset (e.g., AI, EPS, SVG, PNG, PDF, MP4). Determines rendering compatibility across channels and platforms. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AI|EPS|SVG|PNG|JPG|PDF|MP4|MOV|OTF|TTF|PSD|INDD|GIF|WEBP — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Digital Ad Serving Standards; Adobe Creative Cloud

attributes.name: file_size_kb
attributes.description: File size of the asset in kilobytes. Used to validate compliance with channel-specific file weight limits (e.g., IAB ad unit max file sizes for digital placements).
attributes.references: IAB Ad Unit Guidelines; Google Campaign Manager 360

attributes.name: height_px
attributes.description: Height dimension of the asset in pixels. Used alongside width for aspect ratio validation and channel placement eligibility.
attributes.references: IAB Ad Unit Guidelines; MRC Digital Measurement Standards

attributes.name: is_master_asset
attributes.description: Indicates whether this asset is the master/canonical version of the asset type for the brand (True) or a derivative/localized variant (False). Supports brand governance by identifying the authoritative source asset.
attributes.references: ANA Brand Management Standards; Workfront DAM

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 region subtag) indicating the language of any text or copy embedded in the asset (e.g., 'en', 'en-US', 'fr-FR'). Supports multi-market localization management.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1 Language Codes; EASA Cross-Border Complaints Standards

attributes.name: last_deployed_date
attributes.description: Date on which this asset was most recently deployed in a campaign, channel, or market activation. Used for asset utilization reporting and identifying dormant assets.

attributes.name: lifecycle_stage
attributes.description: Current stage in the brand asset's lifecycle from creation through retirement. Governs whether the asset may be deployed in campaigns or channels. Aligns with Workfront proofing workflow stages.
attributes.references: Workfront Project Management; ANA Brand Management Standards

attributes.name: market_applicability
attributes.description: Comma-separated list of markets or regions where this asset is approved for use (e.g., 'USA,CAN,GBR'). Supports multi-market brand governance and localization compliance.
attributes.references: EASA Cross-Border Complaints Standards; ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code

attributes.name: resolution_dpi
attributes.description: Resolution of the asset expressed in dots per inch (DPI). Determines print and digital quality suitability (e.g., 72 DPI for web, 300 DPI for print).
attributes.references: IAB Digital Ad Serving Standards; MRC Measurement Standards

attributes.name: restriction_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any specific restrictions, caveats, or conditions on the use of this asset (e.g., 'Not for use in alcohol advertising', 'Minimum size 100px', 'Do not alter color values'). Supports brand compliance enforcement.
attributes.references: ASA Advertising Standards; FTC Advertising Practices; ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code

attributes.name: rights_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the usage rights for this asset expire. After this date, the asset must not be deployed without rights renewal. Critical for rights management compliance and avoiding unauthorized use.
attributes.references: ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code; FTC Advertising Practices; talent.usage_right

attributes.name: rights_territory
attributes.description: Geographic territory or market scope in which the usage rights for this asset are valid (e.g., 'USA', 'GBR', 'Global', 'EMEA'). Restricts deployment to authorized markets only.
attributes.references: ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code; EASA Cross-Border Complaints Standards

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Operational system of record from which this brand asset record originated (e.g., Adobe Creative Cloud, Workfront DAM). Supports data lineage and ETL traceability in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: IAB Data Transparency Standards; Workfront DAM; Adobe Creative Cloud

attributes.name: tags
attributes.description: Comma-separated taxonomy or keyword tags applied to the asset for searchability and categorization within the DAM (e.g., 'hero,summer-2024,product-launch'). Facilitates asset discovery and reuse.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this brand asset record was last modified. Supports change tracking, audit compliance, and Silver layer incremental processing.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); IAB Data Transparency Standards

attributes.name: usage_rights_type
attributes.description: Classification of the intellectual property rights governing this asset's use (e.g., owned outright, licensed, royalty-free, rights-managed). Determines permissible deployment scope and commercial use restrictions.
attributes.references: ICC Advertising and Marketing Communications Code; GDPR Article 6; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the asset following semantic versioning convention (e.g., 1.0, 2.1, 3.0.1). Tracks iterative revisions and ensures the correct version is deployed across campaigns.
attributes.references: Workfront DAM Version Control; ANA Brand Management Standards

attributes.name: width_px
attributes.description: Width dimension of the asset in pixels. Used for channel eligibility validation and ad serving compatibility checks.
attributes.references: IAB Ad Unit Guidelines; MRC Digital Measurement Standards

products.name: share_of_voice
products.description: Share of Voice (SOV) competitive monitoring record sourced from Nielsen Ad Intel. Captures brand, competitor brand, measurement period (weekly/monthly), media channel, market/geography, brand SOV percentage, competitor SOV percentage, total category spend estimate, brand spend estimate, SOV index vs category average, and data source reference. Supports competitive intelligence and brand strategy reviews. Integrates with Nielsen Ad Intel competitive monitoring module.

attributes.name: share_of_voice_id
attributes.description: Primary key for share_of_voice

attributes.name: brand_profile_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the client brand being tracked for share of voice analysis.
attributes.references: IAB (Interactive Advertising Bureau) Brand Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: competitive_brand_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the competitor brand being compared in the share of voice analysis.
attributes.references: IAB (Interactive Advertising Bureau) Competitive Intelligence Standards

attributes.name: competitive_intelligence_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to analytics.competitive_intelligence. Business justification: Share of voice tracking data feeds competitive intelligence reports. Analysts aggregate SOV measurements across channels and periods to produce competitive intelligence deliverables. Direct operationa

attributes.name: positioning_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand.brand_positioning. Business justification: Share of voice measurements track competitive performance of brand positioning strategies. Nullable FK links SOV metrics to the positioning being executed. Enables validation that positioning is achie

attributes.name: brand_impression_count
attributes.description: Total number of advertising impressions delivered by the client brand during the measurement period. Used as an alternative numerator for share of voice calculations when impression data is available.
attributes.references: MRC (Media Rating Council) Impression Measurement Standards

attributes.name: brand_sov_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total category voice captured by the client brand during the measurement period. Calculated as brand impressions or spend divided by total category impressions or spend, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00).
attributes.references: IAB (Interactive Advertising Bureau) Share of Voice Calculation Standards

attributes.name: brand_spend_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated advertising spend by the client brand during the measurement period. Sourced from Nielsen Ad Intel competitive monitoring. Used as the numerator for share of voice calculations.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel Spend Estimation Methodology

attributes.name: competitive_rank
attributes.description: Rank of the client brand within the product category based on share of voice during the measurement period. Rank 1 indicates the highest share of voice in the category. Supports competitive positioning analysis.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel Competitive Ranking Methodology

attributes.name: competitor_impression_count
attributes.description: Total number of advertising impressions delivered by the competitor brand during the measurement period. Used for competitive impression share analysis.
attributes.references: MRC (Media Rating Council) Impression Measurement Standards

attributes.name: competitor_sov_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of total category voice captured by the competitor brand during the measurement period. Calculated as competitor impressions or spend divided by total category impressions or spend, expressed as a percentage (0.00 to 100.00).
attributes.references: IAB (Interactive Advertising Bureau) Share of Voice Calculation Standards

attributes.name: competitor_spend_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated advertising spend by the competitor brand during the measurement period. Sourced from Nielsen Ad Intel competitive monitoring.
attributes.references: Nielsen Ad Intel Spend Estimation Methodology

attributes.name: created_timestamp

products.name: competitive_monitoring
products.description: This association product represents the active monitoring assignment between a client brand and a competitor brand tracked in the agency's competitive intelligence program. It captures the monitoring relationship including threat assessment, monitoring cadence, intelligence update history, and competitive positioning data. Each record links one brand_profile to one competitive_brand with attributes that exist only in the context of this monitoring relationship.. Existence Justification: In advertising agency operations, competitive monitoring is an active business process where each client brand (brand_profile) is monitored against multiple competitor brands simultaneously, and each competitor brand is tracked in relation to multiple client brands. The agency actively manages these monitoring assignments with specific threat assessments, monitoring cadences, and intelligence update schedules that are unique to each brand-competitor pairing.

products.name: asset_deployment
products.description: This association product represents the deployment event between brand_asset and pr_campaign. It captures the operational process of deploying specific brand assets within PR campaigns, including approval workflow, usage context, and performance tracking. Each record links one brand asset to one pr_campaign with attributes that exist only in the context of this deployment relationship.. Existence Justification: In advertising brand management, brand assets (logos, videos, templates) are actively deployed across multiple PR campaigns throughout their lifecycle, and each PR campaign utilizes multiple brand assets for different purposes (press kits, media releases, event materials). The deployment process is a managed business activity with approval workflows, usage tracking, and performance measurement specific to each asset-campaign pairing.

domains.name: vendor
domains.description: SSOT for all third-party media vendors, publishers, technology partners (DSPs, SSPs, DMPs, CDPs), and production suppliers. Ensures brand safety compliance.

products.name: supplier
products.description: Canonical master record and Single Source of Truth (SSOT) for all third-party vendor identities in the advertising ecosystem. Encompasses media publishers (digital, broadcast, OOH, DOOH, CTV/OTT, print), technology platforms (DSPs, SSPs, DMPs, CDPs, ad servers, verification vendors such as IAS and DoubleVerify, attribution platforms, data providers), production houses, research providers, and supply chain partners. Captures legal entity details, vendor type classification (enum: publisher, tech_platform, production, research, other), IAB content category (for publishers), platform type per IAB Tech Lab taxonomy and API integration status (for tech partners), audience reach metrics, MRC-audited measurement status, TAG/MRC accreditation status, TAG Certified Against Fraud, brand safety tier rating, supply path transparency (SPO) attributes, diversity certification, data sharing agreement status, programmatic supply chain role, onboarding lifecycle state, and primary agency relationship owner. All other vendor-domain products reference this entity via supplier_id. Sourced from Mediaocean Prisma vendor records, Salesforce CRM, The Trade Desk, and Google CM360 integrations.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the supplier record. Primary key for the vendor.supplier data product. All other vendor-domain products reference this entity via supplier_id. MASTER_PARTY role.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Vendor Master; Salesforce CRM Account Object

attributes.name: ads_txt_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the publisher supplier's authorized digital sellers (ads.txt) or sellers.json file has been verified by the agency's programmatic operations team, confirming legitimate inventory authorization and reducing counterfeit inventory risk per IAB Tech Lab standards.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Ads.txt Standard v1.1; IAB Tech Lab Sellers.json Standard

attributes.name: agency_relationship_owner
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the primary agency employee (e.g., media director, programmatic lead, or account director) responsible for managing the commercial relationship with this supplier. Used for accountability, QBR scheduling, and escalation routing.
attributes.references: 4As Account Management Standards; Salesforce CRM Owner Field

attributes.name: api_integration_status
attributes.description: Current status of the API integration between the agency's technology stack and the supplier's platform. Applicable primarily to tech_platform vendor types. Tracks whether automated data exchange (bid management, reporting, audience sync) is live, pending setup, inactive, or not applicable.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab API Standards; The Trade Desk Partner API; Google CM360 API

attributes.name: audience_reach
attributes.description: Estimated total unique audience reach of the supplier's media properties, expressed as number of unique users/devices per month. Sourced from Comscore or Nielsen Ad Intel measurement. Used in media planning for reach and frequency analysis and GRP/TRP calculations.
attributes.references: Comscore Digital Audience Measurement; Nielsen Ad Intel; MRC Audience Measurement Standards

attributes.name: brand_safety_tier
attributes.description: Agency-assigned brand safety tier rating for the supplier based on content quality, TAG certification, MRC accreditation, and supply chain transparency. Tier 1 = premium brand-safe inventory; Tier 2 = standard; Tier 3 = restricted/monitored; Unrated = pending assessment. Controls eligibility for client campaigns with brand safety mandates.
attributes.references: TAG Brand Safety Certification; GARM Brand Safety Floor & Suitability Framework; ANA

attributes.name: cm360_vendor_code
attributes.description: Unique vendor or site identifier assigned to the supplier within Google Campaign Manager 360 for ad trafficking, placement management, and delivery reporting. Enables reconciliation between CM360 delivery data and the vendor master.

attributes.name: contract_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiry date of the master service agreement (MSA) or master vendor contract with the supplier. Triggers contract renewal workflows and controls whether new insertion orders (IOs) can be issued against this supplier in Mediaocean Prisma.
attributes.references: 4As Standard Agency-Vendor Contract Terms; SAP S/4HANA MM Contract Management

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code representing the country where the supplier is legally incorporated. Drives regulatory compliance checks (GDPR, CCPA), tax treatment in SAP S/4HANA, and supply path transparency (SPO) reporting.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 44; IAB Tech Lab

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the supplier record was first created in the vendor master system (Mediaocean Prisma or Salesforce CRM), captured in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset. Supports data lineage, audit trail, and GDPR data subject request processing.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code in which the supplier invoices the agency (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Used for multi-currency financial reconciliation in SAP S/4HANA and Mediaocean Prisma billing workflows.

attributes.name: data_sharing_agreement
