attributes.description: The timestamp when the invoice record was first created in the system, representing the audit trail creation event. Follows ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts on this invoice (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Required for multi-currency media buying operations and SAP S/4HANA foreign currency revaluation.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Management; GAAP

attributes.name: delivered_spend_amount
attributes.description: The actual ad spend amount as recorded by the ad server (Google CM360) or DSP (The Trade Desk) for the billing period. Represents the verified delivery data used in post-buy reconciliation against the vendor invoice.
attributes.references: Google Campaign Manager 360 Reporting; The Trade Desk Bid Management; MRC Measurement Standards

attributes.name: delivery_data_source
attributes.description: The ad server or measurement platform used as the authoritative source of delivery data for reconciliation (e.g., Google CM360, The Trade Desk). Determines which system's impression and spend data is used to validate the vendor invoice. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: cm360|the_trade_desk|mediaocean_prisma|nielsen|comscore|vendor_reported|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: MRC Measurement Standards; Google CM360; The Trade Desk; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: discrepancy_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the root cause of the reconciliation variance. Delivery shortfall: vendor delivered less than invoiced. Overbilling: vendor charged above IO rate. Trafficking error: ad server setup error. Invalid traffic: IVT/fraud detected. Make good: compensatory delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delivery_shortfall|overbilling|trafficking_error|data_discrepancy|invalid_traffic|make_good|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: TAG Invalid Traffic Standards; MRC Discrepancy Guidelines; IAB Ad Fraud Standards; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: dispute_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the formal dispute case raised against this invoice when the variance exceeds the acceptable threshold. Links to the dispute management workflow in SAP S/4HANA or Mediaocean Prisma.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Dispute Management; Mediaocean Prisma Dispute Resolution; IAB Billing Dispute Guidelines

attributes.name: dispute_raised_date
attributes.description: The date on which a formal billing dispute was raised with the vendor. Initiates the dispute resolution clock and triggers vendor notification per contractual SLA terms.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Dispute Management; IAB Billing Dispute Guidelines; 4As Billing Standards

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_date
attributes.description: The date on which the billing dispute was formally resolved and the approved billing amount was agreed upon with the vendor. Marks the transition from 'disputed' to 'approved' status.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Dispute Management; IAB Billing Dispute Guidelines; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: dispute_resolution_notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative documenting the outcome of the dispute resolution process, including the agreed adjustment, vendor concessions, make-good arrangements, or credit note details.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Dispute Management; IAB Billing Dispute Guidelines

attributes.name: gross_amount
attributes.description: The total gross amount billed by the vendor before any agency discounts, rebates, or adjustments. Represents the full rate card value of media or services delivered as stated on the vendor invoice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP — Gross Amount; GAAP; Mediaocean Prisma Gross Billing

attributes.name: invalid_traffic_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether invalid traffic (IVT) or ad fraud was detected in the delivery data for this invoice period, as identified by TAG-certified measurement tools. A True value triggers discrepancy_reason_code = 'invalid_traffic' and initiates dispute proceedings.
attributes.references: TAG Invalid Traffic (IVT) Standards; MRC IVT Guidelines; IAB Ad Fraud Standards

attributes.name: invoice_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the invoice within the invoice-to-payment workflow. Received: invoice has been received from vendor. Reconciled: matched against IO and delivery data. Approved: cleared for payment. Disputed: discrepancy identified requiring resolution. Paid: payment has been issued.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Invoice Lifecycle; Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation

attributes.name: invoice_type
attributes.description: Classification of the invoice by the nature of services billed. Media covers ad placements and programmatic buys; production covers creative and content production; technology covers DSP/SSP/DMP platform fees; data covers audience data and analytics services; talent covers freelance and contractor services. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: media|production|technology|data|talent|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Taxonomy; Mediaocean Prisma Invoice Classification

attributes.name: io_authorized_amount
attributes.description: The total spend amount authorized under the associated Insertion Order (IO) for the billing period. Used as the baseline for reconciliation against the vendor invoice gross amount to identify overbilling or underbilling.
attributes.references: IAB Insertion Order Standard; Mediaocean Prisma IO Authorization; SAP S/4HANA PS

attributes.name: issue_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was issued by the vendor, as stated on the invoice document. Used as the principal business event date for the invoice and for payment terms calculation.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP — Invoice Date; GAAP Revenue Recognition

attributes.name: net_amount
attributes.description: The net payable amount after deducting agency discounts and rebates from the gross amount. This is the amount recorded in SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable for payment processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP — Net Amount; GAAP; Mediaocean Prisma Net Billing

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally-assigned invoice number as provided by the vendor on the invoice document. Used as the primary business identifier for matching vendor invoices to internal purchase orders and IOs. Must be unique per vendor.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP — Vendor Invoice Number; IAB Invoice Standards

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: The date on which payment was issued to the vendor for the approved billing amount. Populated when invoice status transitions to 'paid'. Used for cash flow reporting and vendor payment history.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Run; GAAP Cash Disbursement

attributes.name: payment_due_date
attributes.description: The contractual date by which payment must be made to the vendor to comply with agreed payment terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 60). Used for cash flow planning and avoiding late payment penalties.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP — Due Date; Mediaocean Prisma Payment Terms

attributes.name: payment_reference
attributes.description: The payment transaction reference number generated by SAP S/4HANA FI-AP when the payment run is executed. Used to trace the payment in bank statements and vendor remittance advice.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Document; GAAP Cash Disbursement

attributes.name: payment_terms
attributes.description: The contractual payment terms agreed with the vendor, defining the number of days from invoice receipt to payment due date (e.g., Net 30, Net 60). Sourced from the vendor contract in SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Payment Terms; Mediaocean Prisma Vendor Contract; 4As Payment Standards

attributes.name: received_date
attributes.description: The date the invoice was received and logged into the accounts payable system. May differ from the issue date due to postal or electronic delivery lag. Used for aging analysis and payment terms compliance.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP — Posting Date; GAAP Accounts Payable

attributes.name: reconciliation_date
attributes.description: The date on which the invoice reconciliation was completed and the variance amount and percentage were calculated. Marks the transition from 'received' to 'reconciled' status.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation; SAP S/4HANA FI-AP

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_end
attributes.description: The end date of the reconciliation window used to pull delivery data from CM360 or The Trade Desk for matching against this invoice.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation; Google CM360 Reporting; The Trade Desk Reporting

attributes.name: reconciliation_period_start
attributes.description: The start date of the reconciliation window used to pull delivery data from CM360 or The Trade Desk for matching against this invoice. May differ from billing_period_start if reconciliation covers a different date range.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation; Google CM360 Reporting; The Trade Desk Reporting

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: The applicable tax amount (e.g., VAT, GST, sales tax) charged on the invoice as required by the vendor's jurisdiction. Recorded separately for tax compliance and SAP S/4HANA FI tax reporting.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Tax Module; GAAP; IFRS; FTC Advertising Practices

attributes.name: total_payable_amount
attributes.description: The final total amount payable to the vendor, calculated as net_amount plus tax_amount. This is the amount that will be disbursed in the payment run in SAP S/4HANA FI-AP.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP — Total Amount; GAAP; Mediaocean Prisma Final Billing

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the invoice record was last modified, capturing any status changes, reconciliation updates, dispute actions, or payment postings. Used for audit trail and change tracking in the Silver Layer.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP Audit Trail; GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); ISO 8601

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: The monetary difference between the vendor's invoiced gross amount and the delivered spend amount recorded by the ad server or DSP. A positive value indicates overbilling by the vendor; negative indicates underbilling.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation; MRC Discrepancy Standards; IAB Ad Impression Measurement

attributes.name: variance_percentage
attributes.description: The variance amount expressed as a percentage of the delivered spend amount. Used to assess whether the discrepancy exceeds the industry-standard tolerance threshold (typically 10% per MRC guidelines) triggering a formal dispute.
attributes.references: MRC Discrepancy Standards; IAB Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: vendor_reference_number
attributes.description: Vendor's own internal reference or purchase order number included on the invoice, used to cross-reference the vendor's billing system and facilitate dispute resolution.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI-AP — Vendor Reference; Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation

products.name: reconciliation
products.description: Media cost reconciliation record comparing IO-authorized spend against vendor-invoiced amounts and actual delivery data from ad servers (CM360, The Trade Desk). Captures reconciliation period, variance amount, variance percentage, discrepancy reason code, resolution status, and approved final billing amount. Supports Mediaocean Prisma post-buy reconciliation and SAP S/4HANA financial close processes.

attributes.name: reconciliation_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the media cost reconciliation record. Primary key for this entity in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertising campaign associated with this reconciliation record, enabling campaign-level financial close and post-buy analysis.

attributes.name: client_brand_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.client_brand. Business justification: Reconciliations track delivered spend by brand for budget management. Multi-brand advertisers reconcile vendor invoices at brand level to ensure accurate brand P&L. Essential for brand-level financial

attributes.name: flight_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to campaign.flight. Business justification: Reconciliations often occur at flight level for multi-flight campaigns to verify delivery and spend. Essential for flight-level discrepancy resolution, makegood tracking, and financial accuracy in adv

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.initiative. Business justification: Media reconciliations validate vendor billing against project budgets and deliverables. Linking reconciliation to initiative enables project-level financial close, variance reporting, and ensures proj

attributes.name: invoice_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.invoice. Business justification: Reconciliation is the process of comparing IO-authorized spend against vendor-invoiced amounts and ad-server-delivered spend. Each reconciliation record analyzes a specific invoice to identify varianc

attributes.name: io_line_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_io_line. Business justification: Reconciliations occur at IO line level to match contracted vs delivered units. Essential for billing disputes, makegood identification, under-delivery penalties, and vendor performance evaluation. Ena

attributes.name: line_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to campaign.line_item. Business justification: Reconciliations commonly reconcile at line-item level for granular delivery verification against contracted units. Critical for line-item-level discrepancy resolution, billing accuracy, and vendor per

attributes.name: media_insertion_order_id
attributes.description: Reference to the Insertion Order (IO) that authorized the media spend being reconciled. Links reconciliation to the originating IO commitment.
attributes.references: IAB Insertion Order Standard; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Reconciliation validates delivered media spend against SOW-level budgets and scope commitments. Finance teams track SOW budget utilization, flag overruns, and trigger SOW amendments when reconciled sp

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the third-party media vendor, publisher, or technology partner (DSP/SSP) whose invoice is being reconciled against authorized spend.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma; TAG Supply Chain Transparency Standard

attributes.name: talent_engagement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to talent.engagement. Business justification: Reconciliation of vendor invoices for talent services needs to reference the specific engagement for accurate billing verification. Essential for matching invoiced amounts against engagement agreement

attributes.name: adserver_delivered_amount
attributes.description: Actual media cost derived from ad server delivery data (Google Campaign Manager 360 or The Trade Desk) for the reconciliation period. Used as the authoritative delivery benchmark in post-buy reconciliation.
attributes.references: Google Campaign Manager 360; The Trade Desk; MRC Measurement Standards

attributes.name: adserver_source
attributes.description: Identifies the authoritative ad serving or DSP platform from which delivery data was sourced for this reconciliation (e.g., Google Campaign Manager 360, The Trade Desk). Ensures traceability of delivery benchmarks.
attributes.references: Google Campaign Manager 360; The Trade Desk; MRC Measurement Standards

attributes.name: approved_billing_amount
attributes.description: The mutually agreed and approved final billing amount after reconciliation resolution. This is the amount posted to SAP S/4HANA for financial close and vendor payment processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Mediaocean Prisma; 4As Financial Reconciliation Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the agency finance or media operations team member who formally approved the final billing amount and closed the reconciliation record.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; 4As Financial Reconciliation Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the reconciliation record was formally approved and the final billing amount was confirmed. Key lifecycle event for SAP S/4HANA financial period close.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: buying_method
attributes.description: Method by which the media was purchased, distinguishing between direct IO buys, programmatic guaranteed, open RTB (Real-Time Bidding), private marketplace (PMP), or preferred deals. Affects reconciliation workflow and tolerance thresholds.
attributes.references: IAB Programmatic Buying Standards; The Trade Desk; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: The media channel category for the spend being reconciled (e.g., Display, Video, CTV/OTT, OOH/DOOH, Search). Enables channel-level reconciliation reporting and variance analysis. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: display|video|search|social|ooh|dooh|ctv|ott|audio|print — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Digital Ad Impression Measurement Guidelines; MRC Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reconciliation record was first created in the system, establishing the audit trail start point for the post-buy reconciliation lifecycle.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Mediaocean Prisma; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: credit_note_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of the vendor-issued credit note applied to resolve an overbilling discrepancy. Reduces the net payable amount in SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: credit_note_number
attributes.description: Vendor-issued credit note reference number when a credit adjustment is issued to resolve an overbilling discrepancy. Linked to SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable credit memo processing.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code applicable to all monetary amounts on this reconciliation record (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency media buying operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: discrepancy_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative explaining the specific nature of the billing discrepancy, including details of delivery shortfalls, trafficking errors, or vendor disputes not fully captured by the reason code.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma; IAB Post-Buy Audit Guidelines

attributes.name: discrepancy_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code classifying the root cause of the billing discrepancy between IO-authorized spend and vendor invoice. Drives resolution workflow and vendor performance tracking. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: delivery_shortfall|trafficking_error|ad_fraud|brand_safety_block|viewability_adjustment|data_discrepancy|billing_error|makegood_offset — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Post-Buy Audit Guidelines; TAG Anti-Fraud Standards; MRC Measurement Standards

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the approved billing amount must be paid to the vendor per contractual payment terms. Derived from vendor invoice date and agreed net payment terms (e.g., Net 30, Net 60).
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: io_authorized_amount
attributes.description: Total media spend amount authorized under the Insertion Order (IO) for the reconciliation period. Represents the contractually committed budget against which vendor invoices are compared.
attributes.references: IAB Insertion Order Standard; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: makegood_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a make-good placement has been agreed as part of the discrepancy resolution, where the vendor compensates for delivery shortfalls with additional inventory rather than a monetary credit.
attributes.references: IAB Post-Buy Audit Guidelines; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional commentary, escalation notes, or vendor communication summaries relevant to the reconciliation record. Used by media finance teams during dispute resolution.

attributes.name: period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the media delivery period covered by this reconciliation record. Together with period_start_date defines the reconciliation billing window.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma; IAB Post-Buy Audit Guidelines

attributes.name: period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the media delivery period covered by this reconciliation record. Defines the billing window for comparing IO-authorized spend against vendor-invoiced amounts.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma; IAB Post-Buy Audit Guidelines

attributes.name: prisma_reconciliation_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier from Mediaocean Prisma post-buy reconciliation module corresponding to this record. Enables traceability between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the source system of record.

attributes.name: reconciliation_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business identifier for this reconciliation record, used in Mediaocean Prisma post-buy workflows and SAP S/4HANA financial close correspondence with vendors.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation; SAP S/4HANA FI

attributes.name: reconciliation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reconciliation record within the post-buy financial close workflow. Drives approval routing in Mediaocean Prisma and SAP S/4HANA.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: reconciliation_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reconciliation record indicating whether it covers standard media buys, programmatic (RTB/DSP) activity, make-good placements, credit adjustments, or final billing close.
attributes.references: IAB Post-Buy Audit Guidelines; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: resolution_date
attributes.description: Date on which the billing discrepancy was formally resolved and the approved billing amount was agreed between the agency and the vendor.

attributes.name: resolution_status
attributes.description: Current status of the discrepancy resolution process. Tracks whether the variance is unresolved, awaiting vendor response, under internal review, fully resolved, or written off as immaterial.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation; 4As Financial Reconciliation Guidelines

attributes.name: sap_document_number
attributes.description: SAP S/4HANA FI accounting document number generated upon financial close posting of the approved billing amount. Provides the audit link between media reconciliation and the general ledger.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI Module; ANA Media Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: tolerance_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Agreed acceptable variance percentage threshold below which discrepancies are considered immaterial and do not require formal dispute resolution. Typically set per vendor contract or IAB industry standard (commonly 10%).
attributes.references: IAB Post-Buy Audit Guidelines; MRC Measurement Standards; ANA Media Transparency Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this reconciliation record was most recently modified, supporting audit trail requirements and change tracking in the Silver Layer lakehouse.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA FI; Mediaocean Prisma; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability)

attributes.name: variance_amount
attributes.description: Absolute monetary difference between the vendor-invoiced amount and the ad server delivered amount (vendor_invoiced_amount minus adserver_delivered_amount). Positive value indicates vendor overbilling; negative indicates underbilling.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Post-Buy Reconciliation; IAB Post-Buy Audit Guidelines

attributes.name: variance_pct
attributes.description: Variance expressed as a percentage of the IO-authorized amount ((variance_amount / io_authorized_amount) * 100). Used to assess materiality of discrepancy against agency tolerance thresholds (typically ±10% per IAB guidelines).
attributes.references: IAB Post-Buy Audit Guidelines; MRC Measurement Standards; Mediaocean Prisma

attributes.name: vendor_invoiced_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount billed by the vendor on their invoice for the reconciliation period. Primary input to variance calculation against IO-authorized spend.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma; SAP S/4HANA FI Accounts Payable

attributes.name: within_tolerance_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the variance percentage falls within the agreed tolerance threshold, determining whether formal dispute escalation is required.
attributes.references: IAB Post-Buy Audit Guidelines; MRC Measurement Standards

products.name: vendor_contact
products.description: Individual contact records for vendor organization representatives — including account managers, trafficking coordinators, billing contacts, technical integration leads, and executive sponsors. Captures contact name, role/title, email, phone, preferred communication channel, contact status (active/inactive), and agency-side relationship owner. Supports day-to-day operational communication and escalation paths. Managed in Salesforce CRM.

attributes.name: vendor_contact_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the vendor contact record in the Silver Layer lakehouse. Primary key for the vendor_contact data product.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent vendor organisation record to which this contact belongs. Links the individual contact to the vendor master profile.
attributes.references: IAB Data Standards; Salesforce CRM Account-Contact Relationship

attributes.name: agency_relationship_owner
attributes.description: Full name or employee identifier of the agency-side team member who owns the relationship with this vendor contact. Represents the internal counterpart responsible for day-to-day engagement, escalation management, and vendor performance oversight.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Account Team; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City where the vendor contact is primarily based. Used for regional market alignment, OOH/DOOH territory management, and scheduling in-person meetings or site visits.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; IAB Geographic Targeting Standards

attributes.name: contact_source
attributes.description: Indicates the originating source through which this vendor contact record was created or first captured. Supports data lineage tracking and CRM data quality audits.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Lead/Contact Source; IAB Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: contact_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the vendor contact record. Indicates whether the contact is actively engaged, temporarily unavailable, or no longer with the vendor organisation. Drives communication routing and CRM hygiene.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; IAB Vendor Management Best Practices

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 three-letter country code representing the country where the vendor contact is primarily based. Used for regulatory jurisdiction determination (GDPR, CCPA), regional media buying operations, and OOH/DOOH market coverage.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1 Alpha-3; GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp indicating when this vendor contact record was first created in the source system (Salesforce CRM). Conforms to ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX). Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM System Fields; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); ISO 8601

attributes.name: data_privacy_region
attributes.description: Regulatory privacy jurisdiction applicable to this vendor contact's personal data. Determines which data protection framework governs the processing of their information (e.g., GDPR for EEA, CCPA for USA-California, PIPEDA for Canada).
attributes.references: GDPR Article 3; CCPA Section 1798.140; PIPEDA; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: department
attributes.description: Business department or functional unit within the vendor organisation to which this contact belongs (e.g., Ad Operations, Finance, Technology, Sales). Supports routing of operational queries to the correct team.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; IAB Ad Operations Standards

attributes.name: do_not_contact_flag
attributes.description: Indicates that this vendor contact has requested to not be contacted, or has been flagged by the agency as inactive for outreach. Ensures compliance with communication preferences and prevents unsolicited contact in line with GDPR and CCPA opt-out requirements.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 7; CCPA Section 1798.120; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Contact Preferences

attributes.name: email
attributes.description: Primary business email address of the vendor contact. The principal digital channel for day-to-day operational communication, Insertion Order (IO) correspondence, and escalation. Managed in Salesforce CRM.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; CAN-SPAM Act; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the vendor contact individual as recorded in Salesforce CRM. Used for personalised communication and salutation in correspondence.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: gdpr_consent_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Consent Status
attributes.description: Records the GDPR consent status for processing this vendor contact's personal data. Required for contacts based in the European Economic Area (EEA). Tracks whether consent has been obtained, is not required (B2B legitimate interest), has been withdrawn, or is pending confirmation.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 6; GDPR Article 7; EASA Data Privacy Guidelines; ICO Guidance

attributes.name: is_billing_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor contact is designated to receive billing-related communications including invoices, reconciliation queries, and credit note notifications. Supports the Mediaocean Prisma billing workflow and SAP S/4HANA FI processes.
attributes.references: Mediaocean Prisma Billing Workflow; SAP S/4HANA FI; IAB Payment Terms Guidelines

attributes.name: is_executive_sponsor
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor contact holds an executive sponsor role, typically a senior stakeholder engaged for Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), strategic negotiations, and escalation resolution at the executive level.
attributes.references: 4As Vendor Management Guidelines; ANA Vendor Relationship Standards

attributes.name: is_primary_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this individual is the designated primary point of contact for the vendor organisation. Only one contact per vendor should hold this flag as True at any given time. Used to determine default routing for IO negotiations and account queries.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Role; 4As Vendor Management Guidelines

attributes.name: is_technical_contact
attributes.description: Indicates whether this vendor contact is the designated technical integration lead responsible for API connections, tag implementation, DSP/SSP platform integrations, and VAST/VPAID troubleshooting.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab API Standards; VAST 4.x; VPAID 2.0; TAG Technical Standards

attributes.name: job_title
attributes.description: Official job title or designation of the vendor contact within their organisation (e.g., Account Manager, Trafficking Coordinator, VP of Partnerships). Used to identify seniority and functional responsibility.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; 4As Vendor Management Guidelines

attributes.name: language_code
attributes.description: ISO 639-1 language code (optionally with ISO 3166-1 region subtag, e.g., en-US, fr-FR) representing the vendor contact's preferred language for written and verbal communication. Supports multilingual campaign operations and international media buying.
attributes.references: ISO 639-1; ISO 3166-1; EASA Multilingual Communication Standards

attributes.name: last_interaction_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent recorded interaction between the agency and this vendor contact (e.g., email, call, meeting, QBR). Used to identify stale contacts, drive CRM hygiene, and prioritise re-engagement for active campaigns.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Activity Timeline; 4As Vendor Relationship Management Guidelines

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name / surname of the vendor contact individual. Combined with first_name to form the full display name for operational communication and escalation paths.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: linkedin_url
attributes.description: LinkedIn public profile URL for the vendor contact. Used for professional background verification, relationship intelligence, and executive engagement preparation ahead of QBRs and pitch meetings.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: mobile_phone
attributes.description: Mobile / cell phone number for the vendor contact in E.164 format. Used for urgent out-of-hours escalations, SMS notifications, and direct contact when office lines are unavailable.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for capturing qualitative notes about the vendor contact, including relationship context, communication preferences, escalation history, or special instructions from the agency account team. Sourced from Salesforce CRM Contact Description field.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; 4As Account Management Standards

attributes.name: offboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which this vendor contact was offboarded or deactivated from the agency's vendor management system, typically due to departure from the vendor organisation or role change. Triggers deactivation workflows and access revocation.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; TAG Vendor Offboarding Standards; GDPR Article 17 (Right to Erasure)

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which this vendor contact was formally onboarded into the agency's vendor management system (Salesforce CRM). Marks the start of the operational relationship and triggers onboarding workflow tasks in Workfront.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Object; Workfront Onboarding Workflow; TAG Vendor Onboarding Standards

attributes.name: phone
attributes.description: Primary business phone number for the vendor contact in E.164 international format. Used for urgent operational communication, campaign trafficking issues, and escalation calls.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; ITU-T E.164; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: preferred_communication_channel
attributes.description: The vendor contact's stated preferred channel for receiving communications from the agency. Guides account teams on how to initiate contact for routine updates, campaign queries, and escalations.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Contact Preferences; 4As Client-Vendor Communication Standards

attributes.name: role_type
attributes.description: Functional role classification of the vendor contact from the agency's perspective. Determines routing of operational requests, escalations, and communications. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: account_manager|trafficking_coordinator|billing_contact|technical_integration_lead|executive_sponsor|media_planner|legal_contact|data_privacy_officer — promote to reference product if additional roles are required]
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Vendor Taxonomy; 4As Vendor Management Guidelines; Salesforce CRM Contact Role

attributes.name: salesforce_contact_code
attributes.description: The native 18-character Salesforce CRM Contact object identifier (Sales Cloud). Used for bi-directional synchronisation between the lakehouse Silver Layer and the Salesforce system of record.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud Contact Object

attributes.name: secondary_email
attributes.description: Alternate or backup email address for the vendor contact. Used when the primary email is unresponsive or for specific communication streams such as billing or technical alerts.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; Salesforce CRM Contact Object

attributes.name: time_zone
attributes.description: IANA time zone identifier for the vendor contact's primary working location (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London). Used to schedule calls, set SLA response windows, and coordinate cross-timezone campaign operations.
attributes.references: IANA Time Zone Database; IAB Ad Operations Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this vendor contact record in the source system (Salesforce CRM). Conforms to ISO 8601 format. Used for incremental ETL processing, change detection, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM System Fields; GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); ISO 8601

products.name: preferred_vendor_list
products.description: Agency-maintained preferred vendor list (PVL) designating approved and preferred vendors by category, channel, client, or campaign type. Captures vendor tier (preferred, approved, restricted, blacklisted), approval date, approving stakeholder, applicable client or campaign scope, and review cycle. Enables media planners to enforce client-mandated vendor restrictions and agency-wide preferred partner agreements.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_list_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each preferred vendor list entry. Primary key for the preferred_vendor_list data product within the vendor domain.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Data Standards; 4As Agency Operations Guidelines

attributes.name: accreditation_id
attributes.description: Official TAG certification identifier issued by the Trustworthy Accountability Group. Used to verify vendor accreditation status in programmatic supply chain audits and brand safety compliance checks.
attributes.references: TAG Trustworthy Accountability Group Certification Registry

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the advertiser/client for whom this PVL entry applies. Null if the entry is agency-wide (not client-specific). Enables enforcement of client-mandated vendor restrictions and preferred partner agreements.
attributes.references: Salesforce CRM Sales Cloud Account Object; 4As Client Service Standards

attributes.name: agreement_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.agreement. Business justification: PVL entries often reference master service agreements that govern preferred vendor relationships. Procurement teams link PVL status to underlying MSAs, enforce MSA terms across campaigns, and trigger

attributes.name: primary_preferred_supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor record in the vendor master. Identifies the third-party media vendor, publisher, technology partner (DSP, SSP, DMP, CDP), or production supplier designated on this PVL entry.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Vendor Transparency Standards; TAG Certified Against Fraud

attributes.name: vendor_rate_card_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.vendor_rate_card. Business justification: Preferred vendor list entries designate approved vendors by category and tier. The PVL already has a rate_card_id field referencing vendor.rate_card (likely a naming inconsistency - the actual product

attributes.name: ads_txt_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor (publisher or SSP) is compliant with the IAB Tech Lab ads.txt standard for authorized digital sellers. Critical for programmatic buying fraud prevention and supply path optimization (SPO).
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab ads.txt Specification; TAG Certified Against Fraud Program

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this vendor was formally approved and added to the preferred vendor list. Represents the effective start of the vendor's PVL designation. Used in audit trails and compliance reporting.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; FTC Advertising Practices Division Vendor Disclosure Requirements

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this PVL entry. 'active' = currently approved for use; 'inactive' = no longer in use but retained for history; 'suspended' = temporarily blocked pending investigation; 'pending_approval' = submitted for review but not yet approved; 'expired' = review cycle lapsed without renewal.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; ANA Vendor Management Best Practices

attributes.name: approving_stakeholder
attributes.description: Name or role of the internal stakeholder (e.g., Chief Procurement Officer, Group Media Director, Client Lead) who authorized this vendor's inclusion on the PVL. Supports governance accountability and audit requirements.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; FTC Advertising Practices Division

attributes.name: approving_stakeholder_email
attributes.description: Email address of the internal stakeholder who approved this PVL entry. Used for audit trail, escalation routing, and review cycle notifications. Classified confidential as it is an internal business contact.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; CCPA Section 1798.140; 4As Agency Operations Guidelines

attributes.name: brand_safety_rating
attributes.description: Agency-assigned or third-party brand safety rating for the vendor. Reflects the vendor's compliance with brand safety standards including content adjacency, fraud prevention, and viewability benchmarks. Informs media planner decisions.
attributes.references: TAG Brand Safety Standards; IAB Brand Safety Guidelines; GARM Brand Safety Floor

attributes.name: buying_method
attributes.description: Indicates the transactional method by which media is purchased from this vendor. Supports Mediaocean Prisma media plan configuration and The Trade Desk programmatic buying workflow alignment.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab OpenRTB Specification; Mediaocean Prisma Buying Workflow Standards

attributes.name: campaign_type_scope
attributes.description: Specifies the campaign type(s) for which this vendor designation applies (e.g., brand awareness, performance, direct response, ABM, retargeting). Null if applicable to all campaign types. Supports campaign strategy and planning alignment.
attributes.references: IAB Digital Advertising Guidelines; 4As Campaign Planning Standards

attributes.name: ccpa_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has confirmed CCPA compliance for handling California consumer data. Required for vendors involved in audience targeting, data management, or programmatic buying for US campaigns.
attributes.references: CCPA Section 1798.100; NAI Code of Conduct; Network Advertising Initiative

attributes.name: channel_type
attributes.description: Media channel or advertising channel for which this vendor is designated on the PVL. Enables media planners to filter the PVL by channel when building media plans. Aligns with IAB channel taxonomy. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: digital|tv|radio|print|ooh|dooh|ctv|social|search|programmatic — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Channel Taxonomy; MRC Cross-Media Measurement Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this PVL entry was first created in the system. Provides the audit trail creation anchor for the vendor's PVL lifecycle. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); FTC Advertising Practices Division Record-Keeping Requirements

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the minimum spend commitment and any financial terms associated with this PVL entry (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency agency operations.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; SAP S/4HANA FI Currency Configuration

attributes.name: data_processing_agreement_signed
attributes.description: Indicates whether a formal Data Processing Agreement has been executed with this vendor. Required under GDPR Article 28 for any vendor processing personal data on behalf of the agency or its clients.

attributes.name: dpa_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor's Data Processing Agreement expires and must be renewed. Null if the DPA is perpetual or not applicable. Triggers compliance renewal workflows.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this PVL entry is binding and the vendor designation is enforceable for media planning and buying. May differ from approval_date if a future-dated activation is configured.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; Mediaocean Prisma Vendor Management

attributes.name: effective_until_date
attributes.description: Date on which this PVL entry expires and the vendor designation ceases to be enforceable. Null for open-ended designations. Triggers review cycle notifications when approaching expiry.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; Mediaocean Prisma Vendor Management

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant
attributes.business_glossary_term: General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) Compliant Flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has confirmed GDPR compliance through a signed Data Processing Agreement (DPA) or equivalent documentation. Mandatory for vendors processing EU audience data in digital campaigns.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 28 (Processor Obligations); EASA European Advertising Standards Alliance

attributes.name: iab_member
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is a current member of the IAB (Interactive Advertising Bureau). IAB membership signals adherence to industry standards for digital advertising, viewability, and data practices.
attributes.references: IAB Membership and Standards Program; IAB Tech Lab

attributes.name: minimum_spend_commitment
attributes.description: Contractually committed minimum annual or period spend with this vendor as part of the preferred partner agreement. Expressed in the agency's base currency. Used in budget management and financial reconciliation to track commitment utilization.
attributes.references: ANA Transparency Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Contract Management

attributes.name: mrc_accredited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds current MRC (Media Rating Council) accreditation for audience measurement or ad verification services. Required for vendors providing viewability, brand safety, or audience measurement in agency-managed campaigns.
attributes.references: MRC Minimum Standards for Media Rating Research; MRC Accreditation Program

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next formal review of this PVL entry. Calculated from approval_date plus review_cycle_months. Used by procurement and account management teams to manage vendor governance calendars.
attributes.references: ANA Vendor Management Best Practices; 4As Agency Operations Guidelines

attributes.name: onboarding_completed
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has completed the agency's full onboarding process including legal, compliance, financial, and technical setup steps. Vendors must be fully onboarded before being activated on the PVL.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; ANA Vendor Management Best Practices

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the vendor completed the agency's onboarding process. Used to track vendor lifecycle from initial engagement through active PVL status.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; SAP S/4HANA MM Vendor Onboarding

attributes.name: preferred_partner_agreement
attributes.description: Indicates whether the agency has a formal preferred partner agreement (e.g., volume commitment, rebate arrangement, or strategic partnership MOU) with this vendor. Preferred partner agreements typically carry negotiated CPM/CPC rates and added-value commitments.
attributes.references: ANA Transparency Guidelines; 4As Media Transparency Principles

attributes.name: pvl_entry_code
attributes.description: Human-readable, externally-known business identifier for this PVL entry (e.g., PVL-2024-0042). Used in agency communications, audit trails, and vendor onboarding correspondence.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; ANA Vendor Management Best Practices

attributes.name: restriction_reason
attributes.description: Documented reason for a 'restricted' or 'blacklisted' vendor tier designation. Required when vendor_tier is restricted or blacklisted. Supports compliance audit trails and media planner guidance. Examples: brand safety incident, fraud detection, client conflict, regulatory non-compliance.
attributes.references: TAG Brand Safety Standards; FTC Advertising Practices Division; IAB Brand Safety Guidelines

attributes.name: review_cycle_months
attributes.description: Frequency in months at which this PVL entry must be formally reviewed and re-approved. Standard cycles are 6, 12, or 24 months depending on vendor tier and client requirements. Drives automated review reminders.
attributes.references: ANA Vendor Management Best Practices; 4As Agency Operations Guidelines

attributes.name: scope_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field capturing any specific conditions, restrictions, or qualifications on the vendor's PVL designation. Examples include geographic restrictions, format limitations, client-specific exclusions, or campaign type caveats not captured in structured fields.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; ANA Vendor Management Best Practices

attributes.name: supply_chain_transparency_score
attributes.description: Numeric score (0.00–100.00) reflecting the vendor's supply chain transparency rating based on ads.txt/sellers.json compliance, TAG certification, and programmatic path quality assessments. Supports programmatic operations and brand safety governance.
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab ads.txt Standard; IAB Tech Lab sellers.json Standard; TAG Supply Chain Integrity

attributes.name: tag_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds a current TAG (Trustworthy Accountability Group) certification (e.g., TAG Certified Against Fraud, TAG Brand Safety Certified). Critical for brand safety compliance and programmatic buying governance.
attributes.references: TAG Trustworthy Accountability Group Certification Standards; IAB Brand Safety Guidelines

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this PVL entry. Used for change tracking, data lineage, and incremental ETL processing in the Databricks Lakehouse Silver Layer. Format: yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Accountability); Databricks Delta Lake Change Data Feed Standards

attributes.name: vendor_category
attributes.description: Primary business category classifying the vendor's service type (e.g., publisher, DSP, SSP, DMP, CDP, OOH provider, CTV/OTT network, production house, research firm, PR agency). Drives media planning filter logic and category-level spend reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: publisher|dsp|ssp|dmp|cdp|ooh_provider|ctv_ott|production|research|pr_agency|data_provider|creative_tech — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: IAB Tech Lab Taxonomy; IAB Content Taxonomy 3.0

attributes.name: vendor_tier
attributes.description: Agency-assigned designation indicating the vendor's standing on the preferred vendor list. 'preferred' = actively recommended partner with negotiated rates; 'approved' = cleared for use without special authorization; 'restricted' = requires client or management sign-off before use; 'blacklisted' = prohibited from use; 'under_review' = pending re-evaluation.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Operations Guidelines; ANA Vendor Management Best Practices; TAG Brand Safety Standards

products.name: performance_evaluation
products.description: Periodic vendor performance evaluation records capturing delivery fulfillment rate against IO commitments, make-good obligations, invoice accuracy rate, response time SLA adherence, brand safety incident count, and overall vendor scorecard rating. Evaluated quarterly (QBR cycle) and used to inform preferred vendor list tier assignments and contract renewal decisions. Operational records — not aggregated analytics.

attributes.name: performance_evaluation_id
attributes.description: Unique system-generated identifier for each vendor performance evaluation record. Primary key for the performance_evaluation product.

attributes.name: agency_relationship_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to client.agency_relationship. Business justification: Vendor performance evaluations are conducted in context of specific agency-client relationships. Vendor scorecards vary by client account due to different SLAs, rate cards, and service expectations. L

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.initiative. Business justification: Vendor performance evaluations are often scoped to specific projects they supported, assessing delivery, quality, and responsiveness within project context. Enables project-based vendor scorecarding a

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Performance evaluations assess vendor delivery against SOW scope, deliverables, and SLA targets. Account teams score vendors on SOW fulfillment rates, link evaluation outcomes to SOW renewal decisions

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being evaluated. Links to the vendor master record in the vendor domain.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Reference to the governing contract or master service agreement under which this vendor is being evaluated.

attributes.name: actual_delivered_units
attributes.description: Total number of impressions, clicks, or deliverable units actually delivered by the vendor during the evaluation period as recorded in the ad server (e.g., Google Campaign Manager 360). Numerator for delivery fulfillment rate calculation.
attributes.references: MRC Measurement Standards; IAB Impression Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the senior stakeholder (e.g., VP of Media, Chief Procurement Officer) who formally approved this vendor performance evaluation and its resulting tier assignment and renewal recommendation.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Internal Governance Standards; ANA Vendor Accountability Framework

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the vendor performance evaluation was formally approved by the designated approver. Distinct lifecycle event from evaluation completion.

attributes.name: brand_safety_incident_count
attributes.description: Number of brand safety incidents recorded against the vendor during the evaluation period, including ad placements adjacent to harmful, inappropriate, or non-brand-safe content. Critical metric for TAG (Trustworthy Accountability Group) compliance and preferred vendor list eligibility.
attributes.references: TAG Brand Safety Standards; IAB Brand Safety Guidelines; GARM Brand Safety Floor

attributes.name: brand_safety_incident_severity
attributes.description: Highest severity level of brand safety incidents recorded against the vendor during the evaluation period. Aligned to GARM (Global Alliance for Responsible Media) brand safety floor and suitability framework tiers.
attributes.references: TAG Brand Safety Standards; GARM Brand Safety Floor; IAB Brand Safety Guidelines

attributes.name: contract_renewal_recommendation
attributes.description: Formal recommendation for contract renewal action based on the outcome of this performance evaluation. Feeds directly into the contract management workflow and vendor relationship strategy decisions.
attributes.references: 4As Agency Contract Standards; ANA Vendor Accountability Framework

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this vendor performance evaluation record was first created in the system. Audit trail field for data lineage and governance purposes.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); IAB Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: delivery_fulfillment_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of Insertion Order (IO) committed impressions, units, or deliverables that were actually fulfilled by the vendor during the evaluation period. Calculated as (actual_delivered / io_committed) * 100. Core KPI for media vendor accountability.
attributes.references: MRC Measurement Standards; IAB Impression Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: disputed_invoices_count
attributes.description: Number of invoices submitted by the vendor during the evaluation period that required dispute resolution, credit notes, or correction due to billing inaccuracies. Feeds into invoice accuracy rate and financial risk assessment.
attributes.references: 4As Financial Reconciliation Standards; SAP S/4HANA FI Module

attributes.name: evaluation_cycle
attributes.description: The fiscal quarter in which this evaluation was conducted, aligned to the QBR (Quarterly Business Review) cycle. Used to track cadence and trend analysis across periods.

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The principal business date on which the formal vendor performance evaluation was conducted or finalized, typically the QBR session date.

attributes.name: evaluation_notes
attributes.description: Free-text qualitative commentary from the evaluator capturing context, mitigating factors, notable incidents, or strategic observations not captured in the quantitative scorecard metrics. Used in QBR presentations and vendor relationship management.
attributes.references: 4As QBR Standards; ANA Vendor Accountability Framework

attributes.name: evaluation_number
attributes.description: Externally-visible business identifier for this evaluation record, used in QBR documentation, vendor communications, and preferred vendor list reviews. Format: VPE-{YEAR}-{SEQUENCE}.

attributes.name: evaluation_period_end_date
attributes.description: End date of the performance measurement period covered by this evaluation, typically aligned to the quarterly QBR cycle (e.g., last day of the quarter).

attributes.name: evaluation_period_start_date
attributes.description: Start date of the performance measurement period covered by this evaluation, typically aligned to the quarterly QBR cycle (e.g., first day of the quarter).

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the vendor performance evaluation record. Draft indicates data collection in progress; in_review indicates pending stakeholder sign-off; completed indicates finalized; approved indicates accepted by vendor management; disputed indicates vendor has raised a formal objection.

attributes.name: evaluation_year
attributes.description: The fiscal year in which this evaluation was conducted. Combined with evaluation_cycle to uniquely identify the QBR period for trend and year-over-year comparison.

attributes.name: evaluator_name
attributes.description: Name of the internal agency staff member or team lead responsible for conducting and submitting this vendor performance evaluation, typically the media buyer, account director, or vendor management lead.

attributes.name: invalid_traffic_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of impressions delivered by the vendor during the evaluation period classified as invalid traffic (IVT) including general invalid traffic (GIVT) and sophisticated invalid traffic (SIVT) per MRC and TAG standards. Critical for fraud prevention and supply chain transparency.
attributes.references: MRC Invalid Traffic Standards; TAG Certified Against Fraud Program; IAB Tech Lab IVT Guidelines

attributes.name: invoice_accuracy_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of vendor invoices submitted during the evaluation period that matched the reconciled billing amounts within the agreed tolerance threshold, without requiring correction or credit notes. Calculated as (accurate_invoices / total_invoices) * 100. Sourced from Mediaocean Prisma reconciliation data.
attributes.references: 4As Financial Reconciliation Standards; IAB Payment Standards

attributes.name: io_committed_units
attributes.description: Total number of impressions, clicks, or deliverable units committed by the vendor across all active Insertion Orders (IOs) during the evaluation period. Denominator for delivery fulfillment rate calculation.
attributes.references: IAB Insertion Order Standards; MRC Measurement Standards

attributes.name: makegood_fulfilled_count
attributes.description: Number of make-good obligations that were successfully fulfilled by the vendor during the evaluation period. Compared against makegood_obligation_count to assess vendor responsiveness to under-delivery.
attributes.references: IAB Make-Good Standards; 4As Media Buying Guidelines

attributes.name: makegood_obligation_count
attributes.description: Number of make-good obligations raised against the vendor during the evaluation period due to under-delivery against IO commitments. A make-good is compensatory inventory provided by the vendor to offset shortfalls.
attributes.references: IAB Make-Good Standards; 4As Media Buying Guidelines

attributes.name: mrc_accreditation_status
attributes.description: Current MRC (Media Rating Council) accreditation status of the vendor at the time of evaluation. MRC accreditation validates the vendor's measurement methodologies and is required for audience measurement and impression counting credibility.
attributes.references: MRC Accreditation Program; IAB Measurement Standards

attributes.name: overall_scorecard_rating
attributes.description: Composite weighted scorecard rating for the vendor for the evaluation period, typically on a scale of 0.00 to 10.00 or 0.00 to 100.00. Aggregates delivery fulfillment, invoice accuracy, SLA adherence, brand safety, and viewability dimensions into a single performance score used for preferred vendor list tier assignment.
attributes.references: ANA Vendor Accountability Framework; 4As Vendor Scorecard Standards

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_tier
attributes.description: Preferred vendor list tier assignment resulting from this evaluation. Tier 1 indicates top-performing strategic partners; Tier 2 indicates approved vendors; Tier 3 indicates conditional approval; Probation indicates performance improvement required; Disqualified indicates removal from preferred vendor list.
attributes.references: ANA Preferred Vendor List Standards; 4As Vendor Management Guidelines

attributes.name: prior_preferred_vendor_tier
attributes.business_glossary_term: Prior Period Preferred Vendor List (PVL) Tier
attributes.description: The vendor's preferred vendor list tier from the immediately preceding evaluation period. Used to track tier movement (promotion or demotion) resulting from this evaluation cycle.

attributes.name: prior_scorecard_rating
attributes.description: The vendor's overall scorecard rating from the immediately preceding evaluation period. Enables quarter-over-quarter trend analysis and identification of improving or declining vendor performance trajectories.
attributes.references: ANA Vendor Accountability Framework; 4As QBR Standards

attributes.name: response_time_sla_adherence_rate
attributes.business_glossary_term: Response Time Service Level Agreement (SLA) Adherence Rate
attributes.description: Percentage of vendor response obligations (e.g., campaign issue resolution, data discrepancy responses, creative trafficking requests) fulfilled within the contractually agreed SLA response time during the evaluation period.
attributes.references: 4As Agency-Vendor SLA Standards; ANA Vendor Accountability Framework

attributes.name: scorecard_rating_scale
attributes.description: The numeric scale used for the overall_scorecard_rating in this evaluation (e.g., 0-10, 0-100, 1-5). Ensures correct interpretation of the rating value across different evaluation frameworks or vendor categories.

attributes.name: sla_breaches_count
attributes.description: Number of SLA response obligations that were not fulfilled within the contractually agreed timeframe during the evaluation period. Used to identify chronic SLA non-compliance patterns.
attributes.references: 4As Agency-Vendor SLA Standards; ANA Vendor Accountability Framework

attributes.name: sla_incidents_total
attributes.description: Total number of SLA-governed response obligations raised against the vendor during the evaluation period. Denominator for response_time_sla_adherence_rate calculation.

attributes.name: tag_certification_status
attributes.description: Current TAG (Trustworthy Accountability Group) certification status of the vendor at the time of evaluation. TAG certification is a prerequisite for preferred vendor list tier 1 eligibility and indicates compliance with anti-fraud, brand safety, and supply chain transparency standards.
attributes.references: TAG Certification Program; ANA Vendor Accountability Framework

attributes.name: total_invoices_submitted
attributes.description: Total number of invoices submitted by the vendor during the evaluation period. Denominator for invoice accuracy rate calculation. Sourced from Mediaocean Prisma billing records.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this vendor performance evaluation record was last modified. Audit trail field for change tracking and data lineage in the Databricks Silver Layer.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 5 (Data Integrity); IAB Data Governance Standards

attributes.name: vendor_category
attributes.description: Classification of the vendor type being evaluated. Determines which performance dimensions and benchmarks are applicable. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: media_publisher|dsp|ssp|dmp|cdp|production_supplier|technology_partner|research_vendor — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: vendor_dispute_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has formally disputed the findings of this performance evaluation. When True, the evaluation status should reflect 'disputed' and a resolution process must be initiated.
attributes.references: ANA Vendor Accountability Framework; 4As Dispute Resolution Guidelines

attributes.name: vendor_dispute_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing the vendor's formal objection or dispute rationale when vendor_dispute_flag is True. Documents the basis of the dispute for audit trail and resolution tracking purposes.
attributes.references: ANA Vendor Accountability Framework; 4As Dispute Resolution Guidelines

attributes.name: viewability_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of impressions delivered by the vendor during the evaluation period that met the MRC (Media Rating Council) viewability standard (50% of pixels in view for 1 continuous second for display; 50% for 2 seconds for video). Key quality metric for media vendor evaluation.
attributes.references: MRC Viewability Standards; IAB Viewability Guidelines

products.name: risk_assessment
products.description: Vendor risk assessment record capturing financial stability rating, data security posture (SOC 2, ISO 27001 compliance), GDPR/CCPA data processing risk level, business continuity risk, concentration risk (revenue dependency), and insurance coverage verification. Evaluated during onboarding and refreshed annually. Supports client-mandated vendor due diligence requirements and agency risk management policies.

attributes.name: risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the vendor risk assessment record. Primary key.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client who mandated this risk assessment, if applicable.

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to project.initiative. Business justification: Risk assessments may be conducted for vendors engaged on high-value or sensitive projects/initiatives. Linking assessment to initiative enables project-specific vendor risk management, compliance trac

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor being assessed. Links to the vendor master record.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_contract. Business justification: Risk assessments inform vendor contract terms (liability caps, insurance requirements, SLA penalties). Legal and procurement teams reference risk scores when negotiating contract clauses, set contract

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the individual who approved the risk assessment.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the risk assessment was formally approved.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the risk assessment was conducted or completed.

attributes.name: assessment_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the risk assessment, used in communications and reporting.

attributes.name: assessment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the risk assessment record.

attributes.name: assessment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the assessment based on the trigger or purpose (initial onboarding, annual refresh, triggered by incident, ad-hoc review, or client-mandated due diligence).

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team who conducted the risk assessment.

attributes.name: brand_safety_risk
attributes.description: Assessment of risk related to brand safety incidents, including ad placement near inappropriate content, fraud, or reputational damage.
attributes.references: TAG (Trustworthy Accountability Group) Brand Safety Framework; IAB (Interactive Advertising Bureau) Brand Safety Standards

attributes.name: business_continuity_plan_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's business continuity plan has been reviewed and verified as adequate.

attributes.name: business_continuity_risk
attributes.description: Assessment of risk related to the vendor's ability to maintain operations during disruptions, including disaster recovery and business continuity planning.

attributes.name: ccpa_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Assessment of the vendor's compliance with CCPA requirements for consumer data privacy.

attributes.name: ccpa_risk_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act) Risk Level
attributes.description: Risk level associated with the vendor's CCPA compliance posture and consumer data handling practices.

attributes.name: client_mandated_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this risk assessment was mandated by a specific client as part of their vendor due diligence requirements.

attributes.name: concentration_risk
attributes.description: Risk level associated with revenue dependency on this vendor, assessing the impact if the vendor relationship were to terminate.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this risk assessment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: data_breach_count
attributes.description: Number of documented data breaches or significant security incidents involving the vendor in the assessment period.

attributes.name: data_breach_history_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has a documented history of data breaches or security incidents.

attributes.name: data_security_posture
attributes.description: Overall assessment of the vendor's data security capabilities, controls, and practices.

attributes.name: effective_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which this risk assessment is considered valid and applicable.

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date when this risk assessment expires and requires refresh or renewal.

attributes.name: financial_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric score representing the financial risk level of the vendor, typically on a scale of 0-100 where higher values indicate higher risk.

attributes.name: financial_stability_rating
attributes.description: Credit or financial health rating of the vendor, indicating their ability to continue operations and fulfill contractual obligations. Ratings follow standard credit rating scale. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: AAA|AA|A|BBB|BB|B|CCC|CC|C|D — 10 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Standard & Poor's Rating Scale; Moody's Rating Scale

attributes.name: gdpr_compliance_status
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Compliance Status
attributes.description: Assessment of the vendor's compliance with GDPR requirements for data processing and privacy.

attributes.name: gdpr_risk_level
attributes.business_glossary_term: GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Risk Level
attributes.description: Risk level associated with the vendor's GDPR compliance posture and data processing activities.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_amount
attributes.description: Total amount of insurance coverage held by the vendor, typically in USD.

attributes.name: insurance_coverage_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's insurance coverage (general liability, professional indemnity, cyber liability) has been verified and meets requirements.

attributes.name: insurance_currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the insurance coverage amount.

attributes.name: iso27001_certificate_expiry_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the vendor's ISO 27001 certification.

attributes.name: iso27001_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds ISO 27001 certification for information security management systems.

attributes.name: mrc_accredited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is accredited by the Media Rating Council for audience measurement and reporting standards.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next periodic review of vendor risk, typically annual.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes capturing additional context, observations, or recommendations from the risk assessment process.

attributes.name: overall_risk_rating
attributes.description: Composite risk rating summarizing all risk dimensions (financial, security, compliance, continuity, concentration) into a single overall assessment.

attributes.name: overall_risk_score
attributes.description: Numeric composite risk score aggregating all risk dimensions, typically on a scale of 0-100 where higher values indicate higher risk.

attributes.name: revenue_dependency_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of agency revenue that is dependent on or flows through this vendor, used to assess concentration risk.

attributes.name: soc2_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has achieved SOC 2 Type II compliance, demonstrating controls for security, availability, processing integrity, confidentiality, and privacy.

attributes.name: soc2_report_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent SOC 2 audit report received from the vendor.

attributes.name: tag_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds TAG certification against fraud, malware, and piracy.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this risk assessment record was last modified.

attributes.name: prior_risk_assessment_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on risk_assessment (prior_risk_assessment_id)

products.name: supply_chain_profile
products.description: Vendor-level supply chain transparency and brand safety assessment record — capturing programmatic supply path documentation (SPO), content adjacency risk ratings, verification scores, and preferred/excluded status.

attributes.name: supply_chain_profile_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the supply chain profile record. Primary key.

attributes.name: accreditation_id
attributes.description: Unique certification identifier issued by TAG for fraud prevention and brand safety compliance.

attributes.name: publisher_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.publisher. Business justification: Supply chain profiles assess publisher-specific supply path quality, transparency, and fraud risk. Media buyers review publisher supply chain profiles before authorizing IOs. Profile.supplier_id links

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Reference to the vendor or technology partner this supply chain profile belongs to.

attributes.name: vendor_contract_id
