attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.vendor_contract. Business justification: Supply chain profiles (SPO tier, ads.txt verification, brand safety ratings) inform vendor contract approval and terms. Procurement teams enforce supply chain transparency requirements in contracts, l

attributes.name: ads_txt_authorized
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor is authorized in relevant publisher ads.txt files for inventory authenticity.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the stakeholder who approved the supply chain profile and vendor classification.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supply chain profile was officially approved.

attributes.name: assessment_date
attributes.description: Date when the supply chain transparency and brand safety assessment was conducted.

attributes.name: assessment_version
attributes.description: Version number of this supply chain profile assessment, used for tracking updates and revisions.

attributes.name: assessor_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or team responsible for conducting the supply chain profile assessment.

attributes.name: average_viewability_rate
attributes.description: Average percentage of viewable impressions delivered by the vendor, measured per MRC standards.

attributes.name: brand_safety_tier
attributes.description: Overall brand safety classification tier based on content adjacency risk, verification scores, and compliance history.

attributes.name: brand_safety_verification_score
attributes.description: Numerical score (0-100) representing the vendor's brand safety verification performance and compliance level.

attributes.name: ccpa_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's supply chain practices comply with CCPA consumer privacy requirements.

attributes.name: content_adjacency_risk_rating
attributes.description: Risk rating for potential brand-unsafe content adjacency based on inventory quality and content categorization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the supply chain profile record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: critical_incident_count
attributes.description: Number of critical-severity brand safety or fraud incidents that resulted in immediate action or vendor suspension.

attributes.name: data_residency_region
attributes.description: Geographic region where the vendor stores and processes advertising data, relevant for data sovereignty compliance.

attributes.name: exclusion_reason
attributes.description: Detailed explanation if the vendor is excluded or restricted from preferred status due to supply chain or brand safety concerns.

attributes.name: gdpr_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor's supply chain practices comply with GDPR data protection requirements.

attributes.name: incident_count
attributes.description: Total number of brand safety or supply chain transparency incidents recorded for this vendor during the assessment period.

attributes.name: intermediary_count
attributes.description: Number of intermediary hops in the programmatic supply chain between the advertiser and the publisher.

attributes.name: invalid_traffic_rate
attributes.description: Percentage of invalid traffic detected in the vendor's supply, measured against MRC standards for ad fraud prevention.
attributes.references: MRC Invalid Traffic Detection and Filtration Guidelines

attributes.name: last_audit_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent supply chain transparency and brand safety audit conducted for this vendor.

attributes.name: mrc_accredited
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor holds active MRC accreditation for measurement and audience verification.

attributes.name: next_review_date
attributes.description: Scheduled date for the next supply chain profile review and reassessment.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional notes, observations, or context regarding the vendor's supply chain transparency and brand safety assessment.

attributes.name: preferred_vendor_status
attributes.description: Vendor's status on the agency's preferred vendor list based on supply chain transparency and brand safety performance.

attributes.name: profile_reference_number
attributes.description: Business-readable unique reference number for this supply chain profile assessment.

attributes.name: profile_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the supply chain profile assessment.

attributes.name: review_cycle_months
attributes.description: Number of months between scheduled supply chain profile reviews based on vendor tier and risk level.

attributes.name: sellers_json_url
attributes.description: URL to the vendor's published sellers.json file for programmatic supply chain transparency.

attributes.name: sellers_json_verified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has a verified sellers.json file published per IAB Tech Lab standards for supply chain transparency.

attributes.name: spo_documentation_url
attributes.description: URL reference to the vendor's supply path optimization documentation and transparency disclosures.

attributes.name: supply_chain_documentation_complete
attributes.description: Indicates whether the vendor has provided complete supply chain documentation including all intermediaries and fee structures.

attributes.name: supply_chain_transparency_score
attributes.description: Composite score (0-100) measuring the vendor's overall supply chain transparency, documentation completeness, and disclosure quality.

attributes.name: supply_path_optimization_tier
attributes.description: Classification tier for programmatic supply path optimization indicating the vendor's preferred routing status in the supply chain.

products.name: platform_activation
products.description: This association product represents the activation and integration of advertising technology platforms (DSPs, DMPs, ad servers, analytics tools) within specific agency projects or initiatives. It captures project-specific integration scope, activation timeline, allocated platform fees, usage metrics, and integration health status. Each record links one tech partner platform to one initiative with attributes that exist only in the context of this project-specific activation.. Existence Justification: In advertising agency operations, tech platforms (DSPs, DMPs, ad servers, analytics tools) are activated for multiple initiatives based on project needs, and initiatives routinely use multiple tech platforms as part of their integrated tech stack. Platform activations are actively managed by project teams with project-specific integration scope, activation timelines, allocated costs, and usage tracking. This is an operational M:N relationship that the business recognizes and manages as 'platform activation' or 'tech stack assignment.'

attributes.description: Reference identifier or vault key for project-specific API credentials used to integrate with this tech platform. Supports secure credential management per initiative.

attributes.description: Timestamp when this platform activation record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deactivation_date
attributes.description: Date when the tech platform was deactivated or integration was terminated for this initiative. Null if still active. Supports historical tracking of platform usage across project lifecycle.

products.name: dependency
products.description: Defines scheduling dependencies between tasks or milestones within and across projects. Captures predecessor entity type (task or milestone), predecessor entity reference, successor entity type, successor entity reference, dependency type (finish-to-start, start-to-start, finish-to-finish, start-to-finish), lag days, lead days, is_cross_project flag, and dependency status (active, waived, violated). Enables critical path analysis and schedule risk identification across the project portfolio.

attributes.name: dependency_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project dependency record.

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project containing this dependency relationship.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Project Management Body of Knowledge

attributes.name: successor_entity_task_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific task or milestone that depends on the predecessor. The entity type is determined by successor_entity_type.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Precedence Diagramming Method

attributes.name: task_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific task or milestone that must complete before the successor can begin. The entity type is determined by predecessor_entity_type.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Precedence Diagramming Method

attributes.name: constraint_type
attributes.description: Rigidity level of the dependency constraint. Hard: must be enforced, cannot be violated. Soft: should be enforced but can be overridden with approval. Preferred: advisory only, used for optimization.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dependency record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: dependency_category
attributes.description: Classification of the dependency nature. Mandatory: legally or contractually required. Discretionary: based on best practices or preferences. External: involves third parties or external entities. Internal: within the organization's control.

attributes.name: dependency_status
attributes.description: Current state of the dependency relationship. Active: dependency is enforced. Waived: dependency temporarily ignored by project manager approval. Violated: successor started before predecessor completed. Suspended: dependency enforcement paused. Resolved: dependency satisfied and closed.

attributes.name: dependency_type
attributes.description: Logical relationship type between predecessor and successor. Finish-to-start (FS): successor cannot start until predecessor finishes. Start-to-start (SS): successor cannot start until predecessor starts. Finish-to-finish (FF): successor cannot finish until predecessor finishes. Start-to-finish (SF): successor cannot finish until predecessor starts.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Dependency Determination and Integration

attributes.name: float_days
attributes.description: Total float or slack time available in this dependency relationship. Number of days the successor can be delayed without impacting the project completion date.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Schedule Network Analysis

attributes.name: is_critical_path
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependency is part of the project critical path. True when any delay in this dependency directly impacts the project completion date.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Critical Path Method

attributes.name: is_cross_project
attributes.description: Indicates whether this dependency spans across multiple projects. True when predecessor and successor belong to different projects, enabling portfolio-level critical path analysis.
attributes.references: PMI Standard for Program Management - Inter-Project Dependencies

attributes.name: lag_days
attributes.description: Number of working days to delay the successor after the predecessor relationship is satisfied. Positive values create a waiting period between activities.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Leads and Lags

attributes.name: lead_days
attributes.description: Number of working days the successor can start before the predecessor relationship is satisfied. Allows overlapping or fast-tracking of activities.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Leads and Lags

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that last modified the dependency record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the dependency record was last updated.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional context, constraints, or special instructions related to this dependency relationship. Free-text field for project team collaboration.

attributes.name: predecessor_entity_type
attributes.description: Type of the predecessor entity in the dependency relationship. Indicates whether the predecessor is a task or milestone.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Schedule Network Analysis

attributes.name: risk_impact_level
attributes.description: Assessment of schedule risk if this dependency is violated or delayed. Critical: project completion at risk. High: major milestone impact. Medium: moderate schedule impact. Low: minor impact. Negligible: no material impact.

attributes.name: source_system
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this dependency record originated. Typically Workfront, Monday.com, or other project management platform.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Unique identifier of this dependency record in the source operational system. Enables traceability and reconciliation with upstream systems.

attributes.name: successor_entity_type
attributes.description: Type of the successor entity in the dependency relationship. Indicates whether the successor is a task or milestone.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Schedule Network Analysis

attributes.name: violation_date
attributes.description: Date when the dependency was violated, if applicable. Recorded when successor activity started or finished before the predecessor relationship was satisfied.
attributes.references: PMI PMBOK Guide - Schedule Variance Analysis

attributes.description: Business justification for waiving or suspending the dependency. Captures the rationale when project manager overrides the dependency constraint.

attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system that created the dependency record. Typically the project manager or project coordinator.

attributes.references: Advertising Standards Authority (ASA); Federal Trade Commission (FTC) Advertising Practices; Trustworthy Accountability Group (TAG)

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this deliverable tracking record was first created in the system. Marks the start of operational tracking.

attributes.name: deliverable_name
attributes.description: Business name or title of the deliverable being tracked (e.g., 'Q4 Brand Campaign Video', 'Media Plan Deck', 'Trafficking Sheet').

attributes.name: deliverable_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the deliverable in the production workflow. Tracks progression from initiation through final delivery. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: not_started|in_production|in_review|approved|delivered|rejected|on_hold|cancelled — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: deliverable_type
attributes.description: Classification of the deliverable by format and purpose. Distinguishes creative assets from strategic documents, operational setup files, and reporting outputs. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: creative_asset|media_plan|strategy_deck|report|campaign_setup|trafficking_sheet|presentation|research_report|analytics_dashboard|social_content|video_asset|display_banner|landing_page|email_creative|print_collateral|ooh_creative|other — 17 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivered_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the deliverable was marked as delivered. Provides exact delivery time for Service Level Agreement (SLA) measurement.

attributes.name: delivery_channel
attributes.description: Method or platform through which the deliverable was or will be transmitted to the recipient (e.g., email, client portal, FTP, DAM system). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: email|client_portal|ftp|dam|cloud_storage|physical_delivery|api|other — 8 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: delivery_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes accompanying the deliverable delivery. May include usage instructions, context, or special handling requirements.

attributes.name: estimated_hours
attributes.description: Planned effort in hours required to complete this deliverable. Used for resource planning and capacity management.

attributes.name: file_reference
attributes.description: File path, URL, or Digital Asset Management (DAM) system reference pointing to the deliverable asset location.
attributes.references: Adobe Creative Cloud DAM Standard; Workfront DAM Integration

attributes.name: format_specification
attributes.description: Technical format requirements for the deliverable (e.g., 'MP4 1920x1080 30fps', 'PDF print-ready CMYK', 'HTML5 300x250'). Ensures deliverable meets technical specifications.
attributes.references: Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) Creative Standards; Video Ad Serving Template (VAST)

attributes.name: internal_approval_status
attributes.description: Internal agency approval status before client submission. Ensures quality control and brand compliance before external delivery.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this deliverable is billable to the client or is part of non-billable agency overhead or pro-bono work.
attributes.references: SAP S/4HANA Project Systems (PS) Billing Standard

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this deliverable tracking record. Used for change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: planned_delivery_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the deliverable is scheduled to be completed and delivered to the client or internal stakeholder.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Business priority level assigned to this deliverable. Drives resource allocation and scheduling decisions.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Explanation provided when a deliverable is rejected by client or internal reviewer. Captures feedback for rework and process improvement.

attributes.name: review_round_count
attributes.description: Number of review cycles the deliverable has undergone. Tracks iteration intensity and helps identify scope creep or unclear requirements.

attributes.name: source_system_deliverable_code
attributes.description: Original identifier from the source project management or work management system (e.g., Workfront task ID, Monday.com item ID).

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this deliverable tracking record originated (e.g., 'Workfront', 'Monday.com', 'Asana').

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version identifier for the deliverable (e.g., 'v1.0', 'v2.3', 'Final'). Tracks iteration history and ensures version control.
attributes.references: Workfront Proofing and Version Control Standard

attributes.name: revision_of_deliverable_tracker_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on deliverable_tracker (revision_of_deliverable_tracker_id)

products.name: time_entry
products.description: Individual time entry record submitted by agency staff against a specific project task or work package — the granular time-tracking record at the project level. Captures worker reference, project reference, work package reference, task reference, entry date, hours logged, activity type (creative development, strategy, client management, production, media planning, QA, admin), billable flag, billing rate, billable amount, approval status (submitted, approved, rejected), approver, and source system (Workfront/Monday.com timelog ID). Distinct from talent.timesheet (the aggregated pay-period timesheet header) — this is the line-level project time allocation record.

attributes.name: time_entry_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the time entry record. Primary key for the time entry entity.

attributes.name: approver_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the manager or project lead who approved or rejected this time entry. Null if not yet reviewed.

attributes.name: cost_center_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.cost_center. Business justification: Time entries must post to cost centers for labor cost allocation, utilization reporting, and departmental P&L. Core requirement for agency financial systems integrating time tracking with GL posting.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Time entries require GL account assignment for payroll expense posting and revenue recognition. Essential for labor cost capitalization, WIP accounting, and financial statement preparation in agency o

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Reference to the project against which this time was logged. Links to the project domain project entity.

attributes.name: primary_time_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agency staff member who logged this time entry. Links to the talent domain worker entity.

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Time is billed against SOWs. Agencies track SOW-level time for client invoicing, utilization reporting, and validating labor charges against SOW rate cards and authorized budget caps.

attributes.name: task_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific task or deliverable against which time was logged. Links to the project.task entity.

attributes.name: work_package_id
attributes.description: Reference to the work package within the project. Represents a logical grouping of tasks for billing or resource planning purposes.

attributes.name: activity_type
attributes.description: The type of work activity performed during this time entry. Categorizes time for resource utilization analysis and billing purposes. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: creative_development|strategy|client_management|production|media_planning|quality_assurance|account_services|research|copywriting|design|video_editing|project_management|administrative — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Current approval state of the time entry. Tracks the workflow from submission through manager approval for payroll and billing processing.

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the time entry was approved or rejected by the approver. Null if not yet reviewed.

attributes.name: billable_amount
attributes.description: The total billable amount for this time entry, calculated as hours_logged multiplied by billing_rate. Null for non-billable entries. Used for revenue recognition and client invoicing.

attributes.name: billing_rate
attributes.description: The hourly billing rate applied to this time entry for client invoicing. May vary by worker role, project contract terms, or activity type. Null for non-billable entries.

attributes.name: cost_amount
attributes.description: The total internal cost for this time entry, calculated as hours_logged multiplied by cost_rate. Used for project margin analysis and financial reporting.

attributes.name: cost_rate
attributes.description: The internal cost rate per hour for this worker. Used for project profitability analysis and resource cost tracking. Distinct from billing_rate.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this time entry record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the billable amount (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP). Supports multi-currency project billing.

attributes.name: entry_date
attributes.description: The calendar date on which the work was performed. Used for timesheet aggregation and project timeline tracking.

attributes.name: hours_logged
attributes.description: The number of hours worked on this task for the entry date. Supports fractional hours (e.g., 1.5 hours, 0.25 hours).

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry is billable to the client. True for billable time, False for non-billable or internal time.

attributes.name: is_locked
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry is locked and cannot be edited. True when the entry has been processed for payroll or billing. False for editable entries.

attributes.name: is_overtime
attributes.description: Indicates whether this time entry represents overtime hours. True for overtime, False for regular hours. Used for payroll processing and labor cost analysis.

attributes.name: location
attributes.description: The physical or virtual location where the work was performed. Used for resource allocation analysis and compliance with remote work policies.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this time entry record was last modified. Updated whenever any field changes. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Optional free-text notes or comments provided by the worker describing the work performed. Used for detailed activity tracking and client reporting.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Free-text explanation provided by the approver when rejecting a time entry. Null for approved or pending entries.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: The unique identifier for this time entry in the source system (Workfront or Monday.com). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: The name of the system from which this time entry was ingested. Supports multi-system time tracking integration.

attributes.name: submitted_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when the worker submitted this time entry for approval. Null for draft entries.

attributes.name: adjusted_time_entry_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on time_entry (adjusted_time_entry_id)

products.name: project_budget
products.description: Project-level budget record defining the approved financial envelope for a project, distinct from finance.budget (which operates at cost center and campaign level). Captures project reference, budget version, budget type (original approved, revised, client-approved), total approved budget, budget by phase or work package, contingency reserve, management reserve, currency, approval date, approver, budget status (draft, approved, locked, over-budget), total committed spend, total actual spend, and remaining budget. Enables project financial control and client billing reconciliation.

attributes.name: project_budget_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project budget record. Primary key.

attributes.name: gl_account_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to finance.gl_account. Business justification: Project budgets need GL account mapping for financial statement integration, accrual posting, and revenue/expense classification. Required for month-end close and financial reporting in agency ERP sys

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project for which this budget is defined. Links to the project master record.

attributes.name: owner_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual (typically project manager or account director) who owns and is accountable for this project budget. Links to the employee master record.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to media.media_plan. Business justification: Project budgets allocate funds to specific media plans. Required for variance analysis between planned media spend and project budget, enabling financial forecasting, budget reallocation decisions, an

attributes.name: primary_project_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the individual (employee or executive) who approved this budget version. Links to the employee or user master record.

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Project budgets are allocated from SOW budgets. Finance tracks SOW-to-project budget mapping for billing reconciliation, variance analysis, and ensuring project spend does not exceed contractual autho

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this budget version was formally approved by the authorized approver or governance body.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget version was formally approved. Captures the precise moment of approval for audit and compliance purposes.

attributes.name: baseline_budget_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget version represents the original approved baseline for the project. True for the baseline version, False for revisions.

attributes.name: budget_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the budget: draft (in preparation), submitted (pending approval), approved (active), locked (no further changes), over-budget (exceeded threshold), or closed (project complete).

attributes.name: budget_type
attributes.description: Classification of the budget record: original approved (baseline), revised (internal adjustment), client-approved (client sign-off), internal forecast (planning estimate), or contingency (reserve allocation).

attributes.name: client_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which the client formally approved this budget version. Null if not yet client-approved.

attributes.name: client_approved_flag
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether this budget version has been formally approved by the client. True if client-approved, False otherwise.

attributes.name: contingency_reserve
attributes.description: Budget reserve allocated for identified risks and known-unknowns. Typically controlled by the project manager and released as needed for scope changes or risk mitigation.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center code to which this project budget is allocated. Enables financial tracking and Profit and Loss (P&L) reporting by organizational unit.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was first created in the source system. Supports audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: creative_production_budget
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to creative development and production activities, including design, video production, photography, and Digital Asset Management (DAM).

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in this budget (e.g., USD, EUR, GBP).

attributes.name: effective_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which this budget version ceases to be effective. Null for the current active budget version.

attributes.name: effective_start_date
attributes.description: Date from which this budget version becomes effective and active for financial tracking and control.

attributes.name: fiscal_quarter
attributes.description: Fiscal quarter to which this project budget primarily applies (Q1, Q2, Q3, Q4). Supports quarterly financial planning and Quarterly Business Review (QBR) processes.

attributes.name: fiscal_year
attributes.description: Fiscal year to which this project budget applies (e.g., 2024, 2025). Enables financial period alignment and year-over-year analysis.

attributes.name: labor_budget
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to labor costs, including salaries, contractor fees, and Full-Time Equivalent (FTE) resources.

attributes.name: locked_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget version was locked to prevent further modifications. Null if the budget is still open for changes.

attributes.name: management_reserve
attributes.description: Budget reserve allocated for unknown-unknowns and unplanned scope changes. Typically controlled by senior management and requires formal approval to access.

attributes.name: media_budget
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to media buying and placement costs across all channels (digital, broadcast, print, Out-of-Home (OOH), etc.).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this budget record was last modified in the source system. Supports change tracking and audit trail.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional notes, assumptions, constraints, or context related to this budget version. Supports audit trail and knowledge transfer.

attributes.name: remaining_budget
attributes.description: Calculated remaining budget available for allocation. Typically total_approved_budget minus (total_committed_spend + total_actual_spend).

attributes.name: revision_reason
attributes.description: Textual explanation of why this budget version was revised from the previous version. Captures scope changes, client requests, cost overruns, or other justifications.

attributes.name: source_system_budget_code
attributes.description: Original budget identifier from the source system (e.g., Workfront project budget ID, SAP Project Systems (PS) budget ID). Enables traceability and reconciliation.

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this budget record originated (e.g., Workfront, SAP S/4HANA PS, Mediaocean Prisma). Supports data lineage and Extract Transform Load (ETL) auditing.

attributes.name: technology_budget
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to technology costs, including ad serving platforms, Demand-Side Platform (DSP), Data Management Platform (DMP), analytics tools, and Application Programming Interface (API) integrations.

attributes.name: third_party_vendor_budget
attributes.description: Portion of the total budget allocated to external vendor services, including research firms, data providers, freelancers, and specialized consultants.

attributes.name: total_actual_spend
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of budget that has been actually spent (invoiced and paid or accrued) against this project budget.

attributes.name: total_approved_budget
attributes.description: The total financial envelope approved for this project budget version. Represents the authorized spending limit.

attributes.name: total_committed_spend
attributes.description: Cumulative amount of budget that has been committed through Purchase Orders (PO), Insertion Orders (IO), contracts, or other binding commitments, but not yet invoiced or paid.

attributes.name: utilization_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of the total approved budget that has been utilized (committed or spent). Calculated as ((total_committed_spend + total_actual_spend) / total_approved_budget) * 100.
attributes.references: Project Management Institute (PMI) Earned Value Management

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version identifier for this budget iteration (e.g., v1.0, v2.1, 2024-Q1-Rev3). Enables tracking of budget revisions over the project lifecycle.

attributes.name: work_breakdown_structure_code
attributes.description: Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) element code associated with this budget. Enables hierarchical project decomposition and budget tracking at the work package level.

attributes.name: revised_from_project_budget_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on project_budget (revised_from_project_budget_id)

products.name: approval_workflow
products.description: Tracks formal approval workflow instances for project artifacts — including creative proofs, media plans, project briefs, change requests, and deliverables requiring structured sign-off. Captures workflow instance reference, artifact type (brief, deliverable, change request, budget, plan), artifact reference, workflow template used, current stage, stage sequence, approver role, assigned approver, submission date, decision (approved, rejected, approved with comments), decision date, comments, and escalation flag. Enables audit trails for client and internal approval processes across the project lifecycle.

attributes.name: approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the approval workflow instance. Primary key.

attributes.name: advertiser_id
attributes.description: Reference to the client or advertiser for whom this approval workflow is being executed, if applicable.

attributes.name: campaign_id
attributes.description: Reference to the campaign associated with this approval workflow, if the artifact is campaign-specific.

attributes.name: guideline_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to brand.brand_guideline. Business justification: Approval workflows validate creative/content against specific brand guideline versions. Real compliance process ensuring brand consistency and regulatory adherence in advertising production.

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project under which this approval workflow is executed.

attributes.name: plan_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to media.media_plan. Business justification: Media plans require multi-stage approvals (strategy, legal, client). Tracks approval chain for audit compliance, regulatory documentation, and client sign-off workflows required for SOW execution auth

attributes.name: primary_approval_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific individual or user assigned as approver for the current stage.

attributes.name: project_template_id
attributes.description: Reference to the workflow template or approval process definition used for this instance.

attributes.name: sow_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: SOW-governed work requires approval workflows. Agencies enforce SOW-defined approval chains for deliverables, creative assets, and scope changes to ensure contractual compliance and client acceptance

attributes.name: approver_comments
attributes.description: Textual comments, feedback, or notes provided by the approver when rendering their decision.

attributes.name: approver_role
attributes.description: Role or function of the approver for the current stage (e.g., Creative Director, Account Manager, Client Stakeholder, Legal Counsel, Finance Manager).

attributes.name: artifact_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or title of the artifact being approved.

attributes.name: artifact_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier or code of the specific artifact being approved (e.g., creative asset ID, brief document ID, change request number).

attributes.name: artifact_type
attributes.description: Type of project artifact requiring approval: brief (project brief, campaign brief), deliverable (creative asset, media plan), change request (scope change, timeline change), budget (budget allocation, budget revision), plan (media plan, campaign plan), or proof (creative proof, design proof).

attributes.name: assigned_approver_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual assigned as approver for the current stage.

attributes.name: client_facing_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this approval workflow involves client stakeholders or is purely internal agency approval.

attributes.name: completed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the approval workflow was fully completed (all stages approved or workflow terminated).

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this approval workflow record was first created in the data platform.

attributes.name: current_stage
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the current approval stage in the workflow (e.g., Creative Review, Client Review, Legal Review, Final Approval).

attributes.name: decision
attributes.description: Decision rendered by the approver for the current stage: approved (unconditional approval), rejected (approval denied), approved_with_comments (conditional approval with feedback), pending (decision not yet made).

attributes.name: decision_date
attributes.description: Date when the approval decision was made for the current stage.

attributes.name: decision_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the approval decision was made for the current stage.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the approval decision is expected or required for the current stage.

attributes.name: escalation_date
attributes.description: Date when the workflow was escalated to a higher authority or management level.

attributes.name: escalation_flag
attributes.description: Boolean indicator whether this workflow has been escalated to a higher authority due to delays, conflicts, or special circumstances.

attributes.name: escalation_reason
attributes.description: Reason or justification for escalating the approval workflow (e.g., missed deadline, approver unavailable, conflicting feedback).

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this approval workflow record was last modified or updated in the data platform.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Additional free-text notes or context about the approval workflow instance, used for documentation and audit purposes.

attributes.name: priority
attributes.description: Priority level assigned to this approval workflow instance, indicating urgency and business criticality.

attributes.name: rejection_reason
attributes.description: Specific reason or rationale provided when an approval is rejected, used for audit and process improvement.

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system from which this approval workflow record originated (e.g., Workfront, Monday.com, Asana).

attributes.name: source_system_workflow_code
attributes.description: Original workflow instance identifier from the source system of record (e.g., Workfront approval ID, Monday.com approval ID).

attributes.name: stage_sequence
attributes.description: Numeric sequence position of the current stage within the overall workflow (e.g., 1 for first stage, 2 for second stage).

attributes.name: submission_date
attributes.description: Date when the artifact was submitted for approval and the workflow instance was initiated.

attributes.name: submission_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise timestamp when the artifact was submitted for approval and the workflow instance was initiated.

attributes.name: submitter_name
attributes.description: Full name of the individual who submitted the artifact for approval.

attributes.name: total_stages
attributes.description: Total number of approval stages defined in this workflow instance.

attributes.name: workflow_instance_reference
attributes.description: Business-readable reference number or code for this workflow instance, used for tracking and communication.

attributes.name: workflow_status
attributes.description: Current overall status of the approval workflow instance: pending (not yet started), in_progress (awaiting approver action), approved (all stages approved), rejected (one or more stages rejected), cancelled (workflow terminated), escalated (sent to higher authority).

attributes.name: resubmitted_approval_workflow_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on approval_workflow (resubmitted_approval_workflow_id)

products.name: sprint
products.description: Agile sprint or iteration record for projects managed using agile/scrum methodology — capturing the time-boxed execution cycle within a project. Stores sprint name, sprint number, sprint goal, project reference, start date, end date, planned story points or effort, completed story points or effort, velocity, sprint status (planning, active, review, retrospective, closed), sprint retrospective notes, and blockers identified. Supports agencies running agile delivery for digital, technology, and data-driven campaign projects.

attributes.name: sprint_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the sprint record. Primary key.

attributes.name: initiative_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent project under which this sprint is executed.

attributes.name: sprint_product_owner_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the product owner responsible for backlog prioritization and sprint goal definition.

attributes.name: sprint_worker_id
attributes.description: Reference to the scrum master facilitating this sprint. Responsible for removing blockers and ensuring agile process adherence.

attributes.name: actual_effort_hours
attributes.description: Total hours logged by the team during the sprint. Used for time tracking and resource utilization analysis.

attributes.name: blockers_identified
attributes.description: List or description of impediments, blockers, or risks encountered during the sprint that hindered progress.

attributes.name: carry_over_story_points
attributes.description: Story points from incomplete work carried forward to the next sprint. Indicates scope creep or planning accuracy issues.

attributes.name: closed_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the sprint was officially closed after retrospective and review ceremonies. Marks the end of the sprint lifecycle.

attributes.name: completed_story_points
attributes.description: Total story points or effort units actually completed by sprint end. Used to calculate velocity and team performance.

attributes.name: completion_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of planned work completed by sprint end. Calculated as (completed_story_points / planned_story_points) * 100.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sprint record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: duration_days
attributes.description: The length of the sprint in calendar days. Typically 1-4 weeks (7-28 days) in agile practice.

attributes.name: end_date
attributes.description: The date when the sprint is scheduled to conclude. Defines the time-box boundary for the iteration.

attributes.name: goal
attributes.description: The primary objective or outcome the team commits to achieving during this sprint. Defines the sprint's business purpose.

attributes.name: is_billable
attributes.description: Indicates whether the sprint work is billable to the client. Used for revenue recognition and client invoicing.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this sprint record was last updated. Used for change tracking and audit purposes.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: General notes, comments, or additional context about the sprint. Used for documentation and knowledge sharing.

attributes.name: planned_capacity_hours
attributes.description: Total available team hours for the sprint, accounting for vacations, meetings, and other commitments. Used for capacity planning.

attributes.name: planned_story_points
attributes.description: Total story points or effort units committed at sprint planning. Represents the team's capacity forecast.

attributes.name: retrospective_date
attributes.description: Date when the sprint retrospective ceremony was conducted for team reflection and process improvement.

attributes.name: retrospective_notes
attributes.description: Summary of lessons learned, team feedback, and improvement actions identified during the sprint retrospective ceremony.

attributes.name: review_date
attributes.description: Date when the sprint review ceremony was conducted to demonstrate completed work to stakeholders.

attributes.name: source_system_name
attributes.description: Name of the operational system of record from which this sprint data originated (e.g., Workfront, Monday.com, Jira).

attributes.name: source_system_sprint_code
attributes.description: Original sprint identifier from the source project management system (Workfront, Monday.com, Jira). Used for data lineage and reconciliation.

attributes.name: sprint_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or label for the sprint (e.g., 'Q1 Campaign Launch Sprint', 'Creative Development Sprint 3').

attributes.name: sprint_number
attributes.description: Sequential number of the sprint within the project (e.g., Sprint 1, Sprint 2). Used for ordering and identification.

attributes.name: sprint_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the sprint. Tracks progression through agile ceremonies and execution phases.

attributes.name: start_date
attributes.description: The date when the sprint officially begins. Marks the start of the time-boxed iteration.

attributes.name: team_size
attributes.description: Number of team members assigned to this sprint. Used for capacity and velocity normalization.

attributes.name: velocity
attributes.description: The rate of story points completed per sprint. Key metric for forecasting future sprint capacity and project timelines.

attributes.name: previous_sprint_id
attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on sprint (previous_sprint_id)

products.name: project_template
products.description: Reusable project plan template defining standard work breakdown structures, task sequences, milestone patterns, and resource role requirements for common project types at the agency. Captures template name, project type (TV production, digital campaign, brand strategy, media plan, PR activation, social content series), template version, default duration, standard phases, standard milestones, standard task list, recommended team composition by role, and template status (active, deprecated). Enables rapid project setup and consistency across similar engagements.

attributes.name: project_template_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the project template. Primary key.

attributes.name: contract_template_id
attributes.description: External identifier linking this template to the corresponding project template in Workfront project management system, enabling synchronization and system integration.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Username or identifier of the agency leadership or PMO (Project Management Office) member who approved this template for active use, ensuring quality and standardization.

attributes.name: approved_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this template was formally approved for use, following ISO 8601 format (yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ss.SSSXXX), marking the transition to active status.

The SSOT for all incrementality measurement engagements.
products.reference: Incrementality Test / Causal Lift Test / Geo Experiment

attributes.description: Foreign key linking to contract.sow. Business justification: Incrementality tests are analytics deliverables specified in SOWs with defined test designs and budgets. Critical for delivering contracted measurement work and managing test costs.

attributes.name: supplier_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to vendor.supplier. Business justification: Incrementality tests isolate vendor contribution by testing with/without specific vendor inventory (geo-holdout, PSA control) to prove incremental value. Core vendor validation methodology.

attributes.name: control_group_definition
attributes.description: Detailed definition of the control group, including targeting criteria, geographic boundaries, audience segments, or time periods that did NOT receive the media exposure, serving as the counterfactual baseline.

attributes.name: control_group_outcome_value
attributes.description: The observed outcome metric value in the control group during the test period, serving as the counterfactual baseline.

attributes.name: control_group_size
attributes.description: The number of units (users, households, geographies, or time periods) in the control group that did not receive the media exposure.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this incrementality test record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: incremental_cost_per_outcome
attributes.description: The cost per incremental outcome unit, calculated as total media spend divided by the number of incremental outcomes attributable to the media. Represents the true Cost Per Acquisition (CPA) or Cost Per Action (CPA) accounting for baseline conversions.
attributes.references: IAB Measurement Guidelines; Marketing ROI Standards

attributes.name: incremental_lift_estimate
attributes.description: The estimated causal lift (percentage increase) in the outcome metric attributable to the media exposure, calculated as (treatment - control) / control. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.15 for 15% lift).
attributes.references: Causal Inference Standards; IAB Measurement Guidelines

attributes.name: incremental_roas
attributes.description: The incremental revenue generated per dollar of media spend, calculated as incremental revenue divided by media spend. Represents the true Return on Ad Spend (ROAS) accounting for baseline revenue that would have occurred without the media.
attributes.references: IAB Measurement Guidelines; Marketing ROI Standards

attributes.name: is_statistically_significant
attributes.description: Boolean flag indicating whether the incremental lift estimate is statistically significant at the pre-defined confidence level. True if p-value is below the significance threshold.

attributes.name: lift_confidence_interval_lower
attributes.description: The lower bound of the confidence interval for the incremental lift estimate, representing the minimum plausible lift given the data and confidence level.

attributes.name: lift_confidence_interval_upper
attributes.description: The upper bound of the confidence interval for the incremental lift estimate, representing the maximum plausible lift given the data and confidence level.

attributes.name: measurement_window_days
attributes.description: The number of days after exposure during which outcomes are measured and attributed to the test. Defines the conversion window for outcome tracking.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when this incrementality test record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: outcome_metric
attributes.description: The primary business outcome being measured for incremental lift (e.g., conversions, revenue, store visits, app installs, brand awareness, consideration). Defines the dependent variable in the causal analysis.

attributes.name: p_value
attributes.description: The p-value from the hypothesis test of whether the incremental lift is statistically significantly different from zero. Values below the significance threshold (typically 0.05 or 0.10) indicate statistical significance.

attributes.name: power_analysis_confidence_level
attributes.description: The confidence level (1 - alpha) used in power analysis and hypothesis testing, typically 0.90 or 0.95. Defines the probability of correctly rejecting the null hypothesis when the alternative is true.

attributes.name: power_analysis_minimum_detectable_effect
attributes.description: The smallest true effect size (lift percentage) that the test is powered to detect with statistical significance, given the sample size and design. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.05 for 5% lift).

attributes.name: power_analysis_statistical_power
attributes.description: The statistical power (1 - beta) of the test design, representing the probability of detecting a true effect if it exists. Typically targeted at 0.80 or higher.

attributes.name: results_finalized_timestamp
attributes.description: The timestamp when the test results were finalized and approved for reporting to the client. Marks the transition from analysis to delivery.

attributes.name: statistical_methodology
attributes.description: The statistical or econometric method used to estimate causal lift. Difference-in-differences compares pre/post changes between treatment and control; synthetic control constructs weighted control from untreated units; Bayesian causal impact uses time-series forecasting; propensity score matching balances covariates; regression discontinuity exploits threshold assignment; randomized control trial uses random assignment.
attributes.references: Econometric Standards; Causal Inference Best Practices

attributes.name: test_channel
attributes.description: The media channel or tactic being tested for incremental contribution (e.g., display, video, social, search, OOH, CTV, audio). May be a specific channel or a combination.

attributes.name: test_code
attributes.description: Unique business identifier or code assigned to the incrementality test for external reference and tracking.

attributes.name: test_end_date
attributes.description: The date when the incrementality test period concluded. Marks the end of the treatment exposure window.

attributes.name: test_name
attributes.description: Business-friendly name of the incrementality test, used for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: test_notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for additional context, observations, caveats, or learnings from the incrementality test. May include notes on data quality issues, external events during the test period, or recommendations for future tests.

attributes.name: test_objective
attributes.description: The business question or hypothesis that this incrementality test is designed to answer (e.g., 'Does display advertising drive incremental store visits?', 'What is the true lift from our CTV campaign?').

attributes.name: test_start_date
attributes.description: The date when the incrementality test period began. Marks the start of the treatment exposure window.

attributes.name: test_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the incrementality test. Draft indicates planning phase; planned indicates approved and scheduled; in_flight indicates test is actively running; completed indicates test concluded and results available; cancelled indicates test was terminated before completion; failed indicates test did not meet validity criteria.

attributes.name: test_type
attributes.description: The experimental design methodology used for the incrementality test. Geo holdout withholds treatment from specific geographies; audience holdout withholds from specific user segments; switchback alternates treatment over time; synthetic control constructs a counterfactual control group; matched market pairs similar markets; PSA (Public Service Announcement) test uses PSA impressions as control.

attributes.name: treatment_group_definition
attributes.description: Detailed definition of the treatment group, including targeting criteria, geographic boundaries, audience segments, or time periods that received the media exposure being tested.

attributes.name: treatment_group_outcome_value
attributes.description: The observed outcome metric value in the treatment group during the test period (e.g., total conversions, total revenue, average brand lift score).

attributes.name: treatment_group_size
attributes.description: The number of units (users, households, geographies, or time periods) in the treatment group that received the media exposure.

attributes.description: Self-referencing FK on incrementality_test (prior_incrementality_test_id)

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `advertising_ecm`.`_metrics`.`analytics_request`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Core analytics request fulfillment metrics tracking request volume, effort, delivery performance, and client satisfaction across analytics services"
  source: "`advertising_ecm`.`analytics`.`analytics_request`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "request_type"
      expr: request_type
      comment: "Type of analytics request (e.g., ad-hoc analysis, dashboard, insight report)"
    - name: "request_status"
      expr: request_status
      comment: "Current status of the analytics request (e.g., submitted, in progress, completed, cancelled)"
    - name: "priority_tier"
      expr: priority_tier
      comment: "Priority level assigned to the request (e.g., high, medium, low)"
    - name: "deliverable_type"
      expr: deliverable_type
      comment: "Type of deliverable produced (e.g., report, dashboard, dataset)"
    - name: "billable_flag"
      expr: billable_flag
      comment: "Whether the request is billable to the client"
    - name: "client_satisfaction_rating"
      expr: client_satisfaction_rating
      comment: "Client satisfaction rating for completed requests"
    - name: "cancellation_reason"
      expr: cancellation_reason
      comment: "Reason for request cancellation if applicable"
    - name: "requestor_type"
      expr: requestor_type
      comment: "Type of requestor (e.g., internal, external client)"
    - name: "submission_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', submission_timestamp)
      comment: "Month when the request was submitted"
    - name: "requested_delivery_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', requested_delivery_date)
      comment: "Month when delivery was requested"
  measures:
    - name: "total_requests"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total number of analytics requests submitted"
    - name: "total_actual_effort_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_effort_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual effort hours spent fulfilling analytics requests"
    - name: "total_estimated_effort_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(effort_estimate_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total estimated effort hours for analytics requests"
    - name: "avg_actual_effort_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_effort_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual effort hours per analytics request"
    - name: "avg_estimated_effort_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(effort_estimate_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated effort hours per analytics request"
    - name: "effort_variance_hours"
      expr: SUM((CAST(actual_effort_hours AS DOUBLE)) - (CAST(effort_estimate_hours AS DOUBLE)))
      comment: "Total variance between actual and estimated effort hours (positive = over estimate)"
    - name: "distinct_advertisers"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT advertiser_id)
      comment: "Number of distinct advertisers submitting analytics requests"
    - name: "distinct_campaigns"
      expr: COUNT(DISTINCT campaign_id)
      comment: "Number of distinct campaigns associated with analytics requests"
    - name: "billable_requests"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN billable_flag = TRUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Number of billable analytics requests"
$$
metric_views.description: Core analytics request fulfillment metrics tracking request volume, effort, delivery performance, and client satisfaction across analytics services

AS $$

  comment: "Client billing and revenue metrics tracking invoice amounts, payment status, and revenue recognition performance"
  source: "`advertising_ecm`.`finance`.`client_invoice`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "invoice_status"
      expr: invoice_status
      comment: "Current status of the client invoice (e.g., draft, sent, paid, overdue)"
    - name: "invoice_type"
      expr: invoice_type
      comment: "Type of invoice (e.g., standard, credit, adjustment)"
    - name: "fiscal_year"
      expr: YEAR(invoice_date)
      comment: "Fiscal year when the invoice was issued"
    - name: "fiscal_quarter"
      expr: CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(invoice_date))
      comment: "Fiscal quarter when the invoice was issued"
    - name: "fiscal_month"
      expr: DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', invoice_date)
      comment: "Fiscal month when the invoice was issued"
    - name: "payment_terms"
      expr: payment_terms
      comment: "Payment terms agreed with the client (e.g., Net 30, Net 60)"
    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency in which the invoice is denominated"

      expr: CASE WHEN due_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND invoice_status != 'Paid' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the invoice is past its due date and unpaid"

    - name: "total_invoice_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total billed amount across all client invoices"

      expr: SUM(CAST(amount_outstanding AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total outstanding receivables not yet collected from clients"
    - name: "total_amount_paid"

      comment: "Total amount collected from clients"
    - name: "collection_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(amount_paid AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(total_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of billed amounts successfully collected from clients"
    - name: "avg_invoice_value"

    - name: "total_tax_amount"

      comment: "Total tax charged on client invoices"
    - name: "total_discount_amount"

      comment: "Total discounts applied to client invoices"
    - name: "invoice_count"
      expr: COUNT(client_invoice_id)
      comment: "Total number of client invoices issued"
    - name: "days_sales_outstanding"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(COALESCE(payment_received_date, CURRENT_DATE()), invoice_date))
      comment: "Average number of days between invoice issuance and payment receipt"

  source: "`advertising_ecm`.`finance`.`financial_close`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "close_status"
      expr: close_status
      comment: "Status of the financial close process (e.g., in progress, completed, reopened)"
    - name: "close_type"
      expr: close_type
      comment: "Type of financial close (e.g., monthly, quarterly, annual)"
    - name: "fiscal_year"
      expr: fiscal_year
      comment: "Fiscal year for the close period"
    - name: "fiscal_quarter"
      expr: fiscal_quarter
      comment: "Fiscal quarter for the close period"
    - name: "fiscal_period"
      expr: fiscal_period
      comment: "Fiscal period for the close"
    - name: "company_code"
      expr: company_code
      comment: "Company code for the financial close"
    - name: "cfo_sign_off_flag"
      expr: cfo_sign_off_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating whether CFO has signed off on the close"
    - name: "controller_sign_off_flag"
      expr: controller_sign_off_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating whether Controller has signed off on the close"
    - name: "sox_compliance_flag"
      expr: sox_compliance_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating SOX compliance status for the close"
    - name: "audit_ready_flag"
      expr: audit_ready_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the close is audit-ready"
  measures:
    - name: "avg_days_to_close"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(actual_close_date, target_close_date))
      comment: "Average number of days between target and actual close date"
    - name: "close_cycle_time"
      expr: AVG(DATEDIFF(actual_close_date, DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', actual_close_date)))
      comment: "Average number of days from period end to actual close completion"
    - name: "on_time_close_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN actual_close_date <= target_close_date THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(financial_close_id), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of financial closes completed on or before target date"
    - name: "sox_compliance_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN sox_compliance_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(financial_close_id), 0), 2)

    - name: "cfo_approval_rate"

      comment: "Percentage of closes with CFO sign-off"
    - name: "close_count"
      expr: COUNT(financial_close_id)
      comment: "Total number of financial close periods"
$$
metric_views.description: Financial close process metrics tracking close cycle time, compliance flags, and period-end completion status

AS $$

  comment: "Vendor payment and accounts payable metrics tracking amounts owed, payment timing, and cash management"
  source: "`advertising_ecm`.`finance`.`vendor_payable`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "payment_status"
      expr: payment_status
      comment: "Current payment status of the vendor payable (e.g., pending, paid, disputed)"

    - name: "currency_code"
      expr: currency_code
      comment: "Currency in which the payable is denominated"
    - name: "is_overdue"
      expr: CASE WHEN due_date < CURRENT_DATE() AND payment_status != 'Paid' THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the payable is past its due date and unpaid"

    - name: "total_discount_captured"

      comment: "Total early payment discounts captured from vendors"
    - name: "discount_capture_rate"

    - name: "days_payable_outstanding"

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `advertising_ecm`.`_metrics`.`project_change_request`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$
  version: 1.1
  comment: "Change request and scope management metrics tracking change volume, approval rates, cost and timeline impacts, and scope creep"
  source: "`advertising_ecm`.`project`.`change_request`"
  dimensions:
    - name: "change_request_status"
      expr: change_request_status
      comment: "Current status of the change request"
    - name: "change_type"
      expr: change_type
      comment: "Type or category of change"
    - name: "priority"
      expr: priority
      comment: "Priority level of the change request"
    - name: "requestor_type"
      expr: requestor_type
      comment: "Type of requestor (e.g., Client, Internal)"
    - name: "client_approval_required_flag"
      expr: client_approval_required_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating if client approval is required"
    - name: "billing_impact_flag"
      expr: billing_impact_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating if change impacts billing"
    - name: "scope_creep_flag"
      expr: scope_creep_flag
      comment: "Flag indicating if change represents scope creep"
    - name: "impact_cost_currency"
      expr: impact_cost_currency
      comment: "Currency for cost impact amounts"
    - name: "submission_year"
      expr: YEAR(submission_date)
      comment: "Year the change request was submitted"
    - name: "submission_quarter"
      expr: CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(submission_date), '-', YEAR(submission_date))
      comment: "Quarter and year the change request was submitted"
    - name: "approval_year"
      expr: YEAR(approval_date)
      comment: "Year the change request was approved"
  measures:
    - name: "total_change_requests"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of change requests"
    - name: "total_cost_impact"
      expr: SUM(CAST(impact_cost_delta AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total cost impact across all change requests"
    - name: "total_effort_impact_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(impact_effort_hours_delta AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total effort impact in hours across all change requests"
    - name: "avg_cost_impact"
      expr: AVG(CAST(impact_cost_delta AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average cost impact per change request"
    - name: "avg_effort_impact_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(impact_effort_hours_delta AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average effort impact in hours per change request"
    - name: "approved_change_requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN change_request_status = 'Approved' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of approved change requests"
    - name: "rejected_change_requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN change_request_status = 'Rejected' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of rejected change requests"
    - name: "pending_change_requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN change_request_status = 'Pending' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of pending change requests"
    - name: "change_approval_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN change_request_status = 'Approved' THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(CASE WHEN change_request_status IN ('Approved', 'Rejected') THEN 1 END), 0), 2)
      comment: "Change request approval rate (approved / (approved + rejected)) - governance effectiveness metric"
    - name: "scope_creep_requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN scope_creep_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of change requests flagged as scope creep"
    - name: "scope_creep_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN scope_creep_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Scope creep rate (scope creep requests / total requests) - scope control metric"
    - name: "billing_impact_requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN billing_impact_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of change requests with billing impact"
    - name: "client_approval_required_requests"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN client_approval_required_flag = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of change requests requiring client approval"
    - name: "cost_impact_of_approved_changes"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN change_request_status = 'Approved' THEN CAST(impact_cost_delta AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total cost impact of approved change requests - financial exposure metric"
    - name: "effort_impact_of_approved_changes"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN change_request_status = 'Approved' THEN CAST(impact_effort_hours_delta AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total effort impact of approved change requests - resource exposure metric"
    - name: "high_priority_changes"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN priority = 'High' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of high priority change requests"
    - name: "client_initiated_changes"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN requestor_type = 'Client' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of client-initiated change requests"
$$
metric_views.description: Change request and scope management metrics tracking change volume, approval rates, cost and timeline impacts, and scope creep

CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `advertising_ecm`.`_metrics`.`project_initiative`
WITH METRICS
LANGUAGE YAML
AS $$

  dimensions:

    - name: "risk_level"

      comment: "Risk level classification for the initiative"
    - name: "priority"
      expr: priority
      comment: "Priority level of the initiative"
    - name: "delivery_methodology"
      expr: delivery_methodology
      comment: "Delivery methodology used (e.g., Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid)"
    - name: "billing_type"
      expr: billing_type
      comment: "Billing type for the initiative (e.g., Fixed Price, Time & Materials)"
    - name: "owning_department"
      expr: owning_department
      comment: "Department that owns the initiative"
    - name: "is_billable"
      expr: is_billable
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the initiative is billable to client"
    - name: "is_confidential"
      expr: is_confidential
      comment: "Flag indicating whether the initiative is confidential"
    - name: "start_year"
      expr: YEAR(start_date)
      comment: "Year the initiative started"
    - name: "start_quarter"
      expr: CONCAT('Q', QUARTER(start_date), '-', YEAR(start_date))
      comment: "Quarter and year the initiative started"
    - name: "completion_year"
      expr: YEAR(completion_date)
      comment: "Year the initiative was completed"
  measures:
    - name: "total_initiatives"
      expr: COUNT(1)
      comment: "Total count of initiatives"
    - name: "total_budget_amount"
      expr: SUM(CAST(budget_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total budgeted amount across all initiatives"
    - name: "total_actual_cost"
      expr: SUM(CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total actual cost incurred across all initiatives"
    - name: "avg_budget_per_initiative"
      expr: AVG(CAST(budget_amount AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average budget amount per initiative"
    - name: "avg_actual_cost_per_initiative"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual cost per initiative"
    - name: "budget_utilization_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE)) / NULLIF(SUM(CAST(budget_amount AS DOUBLE)), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of budget utilized (actual cost / budget) - key financial efficiency metric"
    - name: "avg_client_satisfaction_score"
      expr: AVG(CAST(client_satisfaction_score AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average client satisfaction score across initiatives - key quality metric"
    - name: "avg_planned_duration_days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(planned_duration_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average planned duration in days"
    - name: "avg_actual_duration_days"
      expr: AVG(CAST(actual_duration_days AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average actual duration in days"
    - name: "initiatives_on_budget"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE) <= CAST(budget_amount AS DOUBLE) THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of initiatives that stayed within budget"
    - name: "initiatives_over_budget"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE) > CAST(budget_amount AS DOUBLE) THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of initiatives that exceeded budget"
    - name: "on_budget_rate"
      expr: ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(actual_cost AS DOUBLE) <= CAST(budget_amount AS DOUBLE) THEN 1 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(1), 0), 2)
      comment: "Percentage of initiatives delivered on or under budget - key delivery performance metric"
    - name: "billable_initiatives_count"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN is_billable = TRUE THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of billable initiatives"
    - name: "billable_revenue_potential"
      expr: SUM(CASE WHEN is_billable = TRUE THEN CAST(budget_amount AS DOUBLE) ELSE 0 END)
      comment: "Total budget amount for billable initiatives - revenue potential metric"
    - name: "high_satisfaction_initiatives"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN CAST(client_satisfaction_score AS DOUBLE) >= 4.0 THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of initiatives with client satisfaction score >= 4.0"
    - name: "at_risk_initiatives"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN health_indicator IN ('Red', 'Yellow') THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of initiatives with Red or Yellow health indicators - risk exposure metric"
    - name: "completed_initiatives"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN initiative_status = 'Completed' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of completed initiatives"
    - name: "active_initiatives"
      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN initiative_status = 'Active' THEN 1 END)
      comment: "Count of currently active initiatives"
$$
metric_views.description: Strategic initiative performance metrics tracking budget utilization, cost variance, duration performance, and project health across campaigns and clients

      expr: COUNT(CASE WHEN escalation_level IS NOT NULL AND escalation_level != '' THEN 1 END)

    - name: "issues_count"

      comment: "Total estimated hours across all tasks"
    - name: "total_logged_hours"
      expr: SUM(CAST(logged_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Total logged hours across all tasks"
    - name: "avg_estimated_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(estimated_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average estimated hours per task"
    - name: "avg_logged_hours"
      expr: AVG(CAST(logged_hours AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average logged hours per task"
    - name: "effort_variance_hours"

      comment: "Effort variance rate ((logged - estimated) / estimated) - estimation accuracy percentage"
    - name: "avg_completion_percentage"
      expr: AVG(CAST(completion_percentage AS DOUBLE))
      comment: "Average completion percentage across tasks"
    - name: "completed_tasks"

      comment: "Count of completed tasks"
    - name: "in_progress_tasks"
